+#!/usr/bin/env python
+"""HI1 minor-face (EM1) reactive-complex seed.
+Search enamine ring/carboxyl conformers; keep those whose carboxyl O-H points to the enamine face
+OPPOSITE to the major complex (dot(hdir,nrm)<0); place the benzaldehyde on that face with the
+Houk-List O-H...O=C H-bond and Burgi-Dunitz angle. Output order = enamine(24)+water(3)+benzaldehyde(14).
+"""
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+NA="C=C(C)N1CCC[C@@H]1C(=O)O"; NB="O=Cc1ccccc1"
+def build(smi,nc,seed):
+    m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=nc,params=ps)
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m)
+    return m
+def coords(m,cid): 
+    c=m.GetConformer(cid); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+def nbrs(m,i): return [a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+def rot(a1,a2):
+    v=np.cross(a1,a2); c=np.dot(a1,a2); s=np.linalg.norm(v)
+    if s<1e-9: return np.eye(3) if c>0 else -np.eye(3)
+    vx=np.array([[0,-v[2],v[1]],[v[2],0,-v[0]],[-v[1],v[0],0]])
+    return np.eye(3)+vx+vx@vx*((1-c)/(s*s))
+mB=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(NB)); AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mB,randomSeed=7); AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mB)
+B=coords(mB,0)
+Bc=[i for i in range(mB.GetNumAtoms()) if mB.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()=="C" and mB.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetHybridization().name=="SP2" and len([j for j in nbrs(mB,i) if mB.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol()=="O"])==1][0]
+Bo=[j for j in nbrs(mB,Bc) if mB.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol()=="O"][0]
+heavyB=[i for i in range(mB.GetNumAtoms()) if mB.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()!="H"]
+m=build(NA,120,11)
+V=[];Npt=400;phi=np.pi*(3-np.sqrt(5))
+for k in range(Npt):
+    z=1-2*(k+0.5)/Npt; rr=np.sqrt(max(0,1-z*z)); th=phi*k
+    V.append(np.array([rr*np.cos(th),rr*np.sin(th),z]))
+V=np.array(V)
+best=None; nneg=0
+for cid in range(m.GetNumConformers()):
+    E=coords(m,cid)
+    try:
+        Ca=[i for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()) if m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()=="C" and m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetHybridization().name=="SP2" and len([j for j in nbrs(m,i) if m.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol()=="H"])==2][0]
+        Cb=[j for j in nbrs(m,Ca) if m.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol()=="C"][0]
+        N=[j for j in nbrs(m,Cb) if m.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol()=="N"][0]
+        Ccooh=OdO=Oh=OhH=None
+        for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()):
+            if m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()=="C":
+                os=[j for j in nbrs(m,i) if m.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol()=="O"]
+                if len(os)==2:
+                    Ccooh=i
+                    for j in os:
+                        if any(m.GetAtomWithIdx(k).GetSymbol()=="H" for k in nbrs(m,j)): Oh=j
+                        else: OdO=j
+        OhH=[k for k in nbrs(m,Oh) if m.GetAtomWithIdx(k).GetSymbol()=="H"][0]
+    except Exception: continue
+    pCa,pCb,pN,pOH,pOHH=E[Ca],E[Cb],E[N],E[Oh],E[OhH]
+    u=pCa-pCb; u/=np.linalg.norm(u); nrm=np.cross(u,pN-pCb); nrm/=np.linalg.norm(nrm)
+    hdir=(pOHH-pOH); hdir/=np.linalg.norm(hdir)
+    if np.dot(hdir,nrm)>-0.05: continue
+    nneg+=1
+    heavyE=[i for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()) if m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()!="H"]
+    pp=np.cross(nrm,u); pp/=np.linalg.norm(pp)
+    if np.dot(pp,pN-pCb)>0: pp=-pp
+    for n1 in V:
+        if np.dot(n1,u)<-0.2: continue
+        if np.dot(n1,pp)<0.1: continue
+        Qc=pCa+3.0*n1
+        w=Qc-pOH; b=w@hdir; cc=w@w-1.22**2; disc=b*b-cc
+        if disc<0: continue
+        for L in (b-np.sqrt(disc),b+np.sqrt(disc)):
+            if not (2.35<=L<=3.25): continue
+            Od_t=pOH+L*hdir
+            ang=np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(np.dot((pCa-Qc)/np.linalg.norm(pCa-Qc),(Od_t-Qc)/np.linalg.norm(Od_t-Qc)),-1,1)))
+            B2=B-B[Bc]; src=B[Bo]-B[Bc]; src/=np.linalg.norm(src)
+            kk=(Od_t-Qc)/np.linalg.norm(Od_t-Qc)
+            R=rot(src,kk); K=np.array([[0,-kk[2],kk[1]],[kk[2],0,-kk[0]],[-kk[1],kk[0],0]])
+            for a2 in np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,36,endpoint=False):
+                Rz=np.eye(3)*np.cos(a2)+np.sin(a2)*K+(1-np.cos(a2))*np.outer(kk,kk)
+                tr=(Rz@R@B2.T).T+Qc
+                mind=min(np.linalg.norm(tr[i]-E[j]) for i in heavyB for j in heavyE if not (i==Bc and j==Ca))
+                if mind<1.95: continue
+                score=-abs(ang-120)-abs(L-2.65)*8.0+min(mind,3.0)*8.0
+                if best is None or score>best[0]:
+                    best=(score,cid,ang,L,mind,Qc,pCa,pCb,pN,nrm,E.copy(),tr,Ccooh,OdO,Oh,OhH,Ca,Cb,N)
+print("conformers with O-H toward the OPPOSITE enamine face:",nneg)
+if best is None:
+    print("NO minor-face seed found"); raise SystemExit(2)
+score,cid,ang,L,mind,Qc,pCa,pCb,pN,nrm,E,tr,Ccooh,OdO,Oh,OhH,Ca,Cb,N=best
+# water near OdO, opposite the carboxyl C (as in the major build)
+dirw=E[OdO]-E[Ccooh]; dirw/=np.linalg.norm(dirw); Ow=E[OdO]+2.85*dirw
+W=np.array([[0.,0.,0.],[0.9572,0.,0.],[-0.2399,0.9270,0.]])
+Rw=rot(np.array([1.,0.,0.]),(E[OdO]-Ow)/np.linalg.norm(E[OdO]-Ow)); water=(Rw@W.T).T+Ow
+def face(cc): return np.dot(cc-pCa,nrm)
+print("best conf %d: ang=%.1f L=%.2f clash=%.2f  face(Cc)=%+.2f  d(Ca-Cc)=%.2f  d(OhH..Od)=%.2f"%(
+    cid,ang,L,mind,face(Qc),np.linalg.norm(Qc-pCa),np.linalg.norm(E[OhH]-tr[Bo])))

+    K=np.array([[0,-k[2],k[1]],[k[2],0,-k[0]],[-k[1],k[0],0]])

+import sys

+import sys

+    anal(p)

+    v=np.cross(b-a,c-a); return v/np.linalg.norm(v)

+Q=P.copy(); Q[27:41]=(R@(P[27:41]-P[0]).T).T+P[0]

+    v=b0-np.dot(b0,b1n)*b1n; w=b2-np.dot(b2,b1n)*b1n

+import sys
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+def load(path):
+    lines=[l for l in open(path).read().splitlines() if l.strip()]
+    nat=int(lines[0]); out=[str(nat), lines[1]]
+    for l in lines[2:2+nat]:
+        t=l.split()
+        out.append("%s %s %s %s"%(t[0],t[1],t[2],t[3]))
+    return "\n".join(out)+"\n"
+
+for p in sys.argv[1:]:
+    m=Chem.MolFromXYZBlock(load(p))
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m,charge=0)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
+    print(p.split('structure_build_')[-1], "->", Chem.MolToSmiles(m,isomericSmiles=True),

+#!/bin/bash
+cd /data/cloudra/workspace/hard_resume_20260930/HG2_gold_20260929/paratera_20260930/ee_syn_explore/xtb_ee_scan
+prev=start.xyz
+: > scan_summary.txt
+for d in 3.4 3.2 3.0 2.8 2.6 2.4 2.2 2.0 1.9; do
+  cat > xc_$d.inp <<'EOF'
+$constrain
+  distance: 2,7,VALUE
+  dihedral: 1,2,3,4,180.0
+  dihedral: 5,6,7,8,180.0
+$end
+EOF
+  sed -i "s/VALUE/$d/" xc_$d.inp
+  xtb $prev --gfn 2 --input xc_$d.inp --opt > opt_$d.log 2>&1
+  if [ -f xtbopt.xyz ]; then cp xtbopt.xyz frame_$d.xyz; prev=xtbopt.xyz; fi
+  e=$(grep 'TOTAL ENERGY' opt_$d.log | tail -1 | awk '{print $4}')
+  echo "$d $e" >> scan_summary.txt
+done
+echo DONE >> scan_summary.txt

+import sys
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+def load(path):
+    lines=[l for l in open(path).read().splitlines() if l.strip()]
+    nat=int(lines[0]); out=[str(nat), lines[1]]
+    for l in lines[2:2+nat]:
+        t=l.split()
+        out.append("%s %s %s %s"%(t[0],t[1],t[2],t[3]))
+    return "\n".join(out)+"\n"
+
+for p in sys.argv[1:]:
+    m=Chem.MolFromXYZBlock(load(p))
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m,charge=0)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)

+import sys
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+def load(path):
+    raw=open(path).read().splitlines()
+    n=int(raw[0].strip()); out=[str(n), raw[1]]
+    for l in raw[2:2+n]:
+        t=l.split(); out.append("%s %s %s %s"%(t[0],t[1],t[2],t[3]))
+    return "\n".join(out)+"\n"
+for p in sys.argv[1:]:
+    m=Chem.MolFromXYZBlock(load(p))
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m,charge=0)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    smi=Chem.MolToSmiles(m, isomericSmiles=True)
+    cip=[(a.GetIdx()+1,a.GetProp('_CIPCode')) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp('_CIPCode')]
+    dbs=[]
+    for b in m.GetBonds():
+        if b.GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE and int(b.GetStereo())!=0:
+            dbs.append((b.GetBeginAtomIdx()+1,b.GetEndAtomIdx()+1,str(b.GetStereo()).replace('STEREO','')))
+    print(p.split('/')[-1], "->", smi, "| CIP:", cip, "| C=C:", dbs)

+import sys

+def load(path):
+    lines=[l for l in open(path).read().splitlines() if l.strip()]

+"""HI1 minor-face (EM1) reactive-complex seed.
+Search enamine ring/carboxyl conformers; keep those whose carboxyl O-H points to the enamine face
+OPPOSITE to the major complex (dot(hdir,nrm)<0); place the benzaldehyde on that face with the
+Houk-List O-H...O=C H-bond and Burgi-Dunitz angle. Output order = enamine(24)+water(3)+benzaldehyde(14).

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

+def build(smi,nc,seed):
+    m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=nc,params=ps)
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m)
+    return m
+def coords(m,cid): 
+    c=m.GetConformer(cid); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+def nbrs(m,i): return [a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+def rot(a1,a2):
+    v=np.cross(a1,a2); c=np.dot(a1,a2); s=np.linalg.norm(v)
+    if s<1e-9: return np.eye(3) if c>0 else -np.eye(3)
+    vx=np.array([[0,-v[2],v[1]],[v[2],0,-v[0]],[-v[1],v[0],0]])
+    return np.eye(3)+vx+vx@vx*((1-c)/(s*s))
+mB=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(NB)); AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mB,randomSeed=7); AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mB)
+B=coords(mB,0)
+Bc=[i for i in range(mB.GetNumAtoms()) if mB.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()=="C" and mB.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetHybridization().name=="SP2" and len([j for j in nbrs(mB,i) if mB.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol()=="O"])==1][0]
+Bo=[j for j in nbrs(mB,Bc) if mB.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol()=="O"][0]
+heavyB=[i for i in range(mB.GetNumAtoms()) if mB.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()!="H"]
+m=build(NA,120,11)
+V=[];Npt=400;phi=np.pi*(3-np.sqrt(5))
+for k in range(Npt):
+    z=1-2*(k+0.5)/Npt; rr=np.sqrt(max(0,1-z*z)); th=phi*k
+    V.append(np.array([rr*np.cos(th),rr*np.sin(th),z]))
+V=np.array(V)
+best=None; nneg=0
+for cid in range(m.GetNumConformers()):
+    E=coords(m,cid)
+    try:
+        Ca=[i for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()) if m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()=="C" and m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetHybridization().name=="SP2" and len([j for j in nbrs(m,i) if m.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol()=="H"])==2][0]
+        Cb=[j for j in nbrs(m,Ca) if m.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol()=="C"][0]
+        N=[j for j in nbrs(m,Cb) if m.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol()=="N"][0]
+        Ccooh=OdO=Oh=OhH=None
+        for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()):
+            if m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()=="C":
+                os=[j for j in nbrs(m,i) if m.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol()=="O"]
+                if len(os)==2:
+                    Ccooh=i
+                    for j in os:
+                        if any(m.GetAtomWithIdx(k).GetSymbol()=="H" for k in nbrs(m,j)): Oh=j
+                        else: OdO=j
+        OhH=[k for k in nbrs(m,Oh) if m.GetAtomWithIdx(k).GetSymbol()=="H"][0]
+    except Exception: continue
+    pCa,pCb,pN,pOH,pOHH=E[Ca],E[Cb],E[N],E[Oh],E[OhH]
+    u=pCa-pCb; u/=np.linalg.norm(u); nrm=np.cross(u,pN-pCb); nrm/=np.linalg.norm(nrm)
+    hdir=(pOHH-pOH); hdir/=np.linalg.norm(hdir)
+    if np.dot(hdir,nrm)>-0.05: continue
+    nneg+=1
+    heavyE=[i for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()) if m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()!="H"]
+    pp=np.cross(nrm,u); pp/=np.linalg.norm(pp)
+    if np.dot(pp,pN-pCb)>0: pp=-pp
+    for n1 in V:
+        if np.dot(n1,u)<-0.2: continue
+        if np.dot(n1,pp)<0.1: continue
+        Qc=pCa+3.0*n1
+        w=Qc-pOH; b=w@hdir; cc=w@w-1.22**2; disc=b*b-cc
+        if disc<0: continue
+        for L in (b-np.sqrt(disc),b+np.sqrt(disc)):
+            if not (2.35<=L<=3.25): continue
+            Od_t=pOH+L*hdir
+            ang=np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(np.dot((pCa-Qc)/np.linalg.norm(pCa-Qc),(Od_t-Qc)/np.linalg.norm(Od_t-Qc)),-1,1)))
+            B2=B-B[Bc]; src=B[Bo]-B[Bc]; src/=np.linalg.norm(src)
+            kk=(Od_t-Qc)/np.linalg.norm(Od_t-Qc)
+            R=rot(src,kk); K=np.array([[0,-kk[2],kk[1]],[kk[2],0,-kk[0]],[-kk[1],kk[0],0]])
+            for a2 in np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,36,endpoint=False):
+                Rz=np.eye(3)*np.cos(a2)+np.sin(a2)*K+(1-np.cos(a2))*np.outer(kk,kk)
+                tr=(Rz@R@B2.T).T+Qc
+                mind=min(np.linalg.norm(tr[i]-E[j]) for i in heavyB for j in heavyE if not (i==Bc and j==Ca))
+                if mind<1.95: continue
+                score=-abs(ang-120)-abs(L-2.65)*8.0+min(mind,3.0)*8.0
+                if best is None or score>best[0]:
+                    best=(score,cid,ang,L,mind,Qc,pCa,pCb,pN,nrm,E.copy(),tr,Ccooh,OdO,Oh,OhH,Ca,Cb,N)
+print("conformers with O-H toward the OPPOSITE enamine face:",nneg)
+if best is None:
+    print("NO minor-face seed found"); raise SystemExit(2)
+score,cid,ang,L,mind,Qc,pCa,pCb,pN,nrm,E,tr,Ccooh,OdO,Oh,OhH,Ca,Cb,N=best
+# water near OdO, opposite the carboxyl C (as in the major build)
+dirw=E[OdO]-E[Ccooh]; dirw/=np.linalg.norm(dirw); Ow=E[OdO]+2.85*dirw
+W=np.array([[0.,0.,0.],[0.9572,0.,0.],[-0.2399,0.9270,0.]])
+Rw=rot(np.array([1.,0.,0.]),(E[OdO]-Ow)/np.linalg.norm(E[OdO]-Ow)); water=(Rw@W.T).T+Ow
+def face(cc): return np.dot(cc-pCa,nrm)
+print("best conf %d: ang=%.1f L=%.2f clash=%.2f  face(Cc)=%+.2f  d(Ca-Cc)=%.2f  d(OhH..Od)=%.2f"%(
+    cid,ang,L,mind,face(Qc),np.linalg.norm(Qc-pCa),np.linalg.norm(E[OhH]-tr[Bo])))
+out=["%d"%(m.GetNumAtoms()+3),"HI1 E2 minor-face (EM1) reactive-complex seed (opposite enamine face, H-bonded)"]
+for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): out.append("%-2s %14.8f %14.8f %14.8f"%(m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol(),*E[i]))
+for i,s in enumerate(["O","H","H"]): out.append("%-2s %14.8f %14.8f %14.8f"%(s,*water[i]))
+for i in range(mB.GetNumAtoms()): out.append("%-2s %14.8f %14.8f %14.8f"%(mB.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol(),*tr[i]))
+open("HI1_gold_20260929/build/twoface_seed.xyz","w").write("\n".join(out)+"\n")
+print("wrote HI1_gold_20260929/build/twoface_seed.xyz  natoms=%d"%(m.GetNumAtoms()+3))

+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m)

+    return np.eye(3)+vx+vx@vx*((1-c)/(s*s))

+P=np.array([[float(x) for x in L[2+i].split()[1:4]] for i in range(n)])

+    v=np.cross(b-a,c-a); return v/np.linalg.norm(v)

+    v=b0-np.dot(b0,b1n)*b1n; w=b2-np.dot(b2,b1n)*b1n

+    return np.degrees(np.arctan2(y,x))

+
+Q=P.copy(); Q[27:41]=refl(P[27:41],P[0],nrm)

+R=np.eye(3)+2*(K@K)   # 180 deg
+Q=P.copy(); Q[27:41]=(R@(P[27:41]-P[0]).T).T+P[0]
+def dih(a,b,c,d):

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+
+# frame 0 coords
+lines = open("HI1_gold_20260929/paratera_20260930/major_spec/clean_rc_build/confs.xyz").read().splitlines()
+n=int(lines[0]); at=[l.split()[0] for l in lines[2:2+n]]
+X=np.array([[float(v) for v in l.split()[1:4]] for l in lines[2:2+n]])
+
+Ca, Oh, Hh, Od, Cc = 0, 10, 23, 27, 28
+# rotate benzaldehyde (27-40) about the Oh...Od axis (through Od)
+A = X[Oh]; B = X[Od]; u=(B-A)/np.linalg.norm(B-A)
+
+def rot(points, center, axis, deg):
+    th=np.radians(deg); k=axis
+    K=np.array([[0,-k[2],k[1]],[k[2],0,-k[0]],[-k[1],k[0],0]])
+    R=np.eye(3)+np.sin(th)*K+(1-np.cos(th))*(K@K)
+    return (points-center)@R.T+center
+
+ben=list(range(27,41))
+best=None
+for deg in range(0,360,5):
+    Xr=X.copy(); Xr[ben]=rot(X[ben], B, u, deg)
+    d=np.linalg.norm(Xr[Ca]-Xr[Cc])
+    # min heavy-heavy contact between benzaldehyde and enamine (heavy atoms: exclude H)
+    heavy=[i for i in range(41) if at[i]!='H']
+    contacts=[np.linalg.norm(Xr[i]-Xr[j]) for i in heavy for j in heavy if i in ben and j not in ben]
+    mc=min(contacts)
+    ang=np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(np.dot(Xr[Oh]-Xr[Hh],Xr[Od]-Xr[Hh])/(np.linalg.norm(Xr[Oh]-Xr[Hh])*np.linalg.norm(Xr[Od]-Xr[Hh])),-1,1)))
+    print(f"deg={deg:4d} d(Ca-Cc)={d:.3f} min_heavy_contact={mc:.3f} ang_OHO={ang:.1f}")
+    if best is None or abs(d-3.8)<abs(best[1]-3.8): best=(deg,d,mc,Xr)
+print("BEST", best[0], round(best[1],3), round(best[2],3))

+import sys, numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+path = sys.argv[1]
+lines = open(path).read().splitlines()
+i = 0
+frames = []
+while i < len(lines):
+    if lines[i].strip()=='':
+        i+=1; continue
+    n = int(lines[i].split()[0]); i+=1
+    comment = lines[i] if i < len(lines) else ''
+    i+=1
+    at=[]; xyz=[]
+    for k in range(n):
+        p=lines[i].split(); i+=1
+        at.append(p[0]); xyz.append([float(p[1]),float(p[2]),float(p[3])])
+    frames.append((comment, at, np.array(xyz)))
+
+def dist(x,a,b): return float(np.linalg.norm(x[a]-x[b]))
+
+for fi,(comment,at,x) in enumerate(frames):
+    block = f"{len(at)}\n{comment}\n" + "\n".join(f"{a} {c[0]:.6f} {c[1]:.6f} {c[2]:.6f}" for a,c in zip(at,x))
+    m = Chem.MolFromXYZBlock(block)
+    try:
+        rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m, charge=0)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"frame {fi}: bond perception failed: {e}")
+        continue
+    Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
+    # enamine alkene CH2 (Ca)
+    pat_ca = Chem.MolFromSmarts("[NX3][CX3]=[CH2]")
+    pat_ald = Chem.MolFromSmarts("[CX3H1]=O")
+    pat_oh = Chem.MolFromSmarts("[OX2H]")
+    mca = m.GetSubstructMatches(pat_ca)
+    ald = m.GetSubstructMatches(pat_ald)
+    oh = m.GetSubstructMatches(pat_oh)
+    # Ca = the CH2 atom (last atom in pattern)
+    ca = mca[0][2] if mca else None
+    cc = ald[0][0] if ald else None
+    od = ald[0][1] if ald else None
+    ohm = oh[0][0] if oh else None
+    # H on Oh
+    hn = [nb.GetIdx() for nb in m.GetAtomWithIdx(ohm).GetNeighbors() if nb.GetSymbol()=='H'] if ohm is not None else []
+    h = hn[0] if hn else None
+    nfrag = len(Chem.GetMolFrags(m))
+    dcc = dist(x,ca,cc) if (ca is not None and cc is not None) else float('nan')
+    doo = dist(x,ohm,od) if (ohm is not None and od is not None) else float('nan')
+    dho = dist(x,h,od) if (h is not None and od is not None) else float('nan')
+    # angle O-H...O
+    ang=float('nan')
+    if ohm is not None and h is not None and od is not None:

+        c=np.dot(v1,v2)/(np.linalg.norm(v1)*np.linalg.norm(v2))

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+
+# frame 0 coords
+lines = open("HI1_gold_20260929/paratera_20260930/major_spec/clean_rc_build/confs.xyz").read().splitlines()
+n=int(lines[0]); at=[l.split()[0] for l in lines[2:2+n]]
+X=np.array([[float(v) for v in l.split()[1:4]] for l in lines[2:2+n]])
+
+Ca, Oh, Hh, Od, Cc = 0, 10, 23, 27, 28
+# rotate benzaldehyde (27-40) about the Oh...Od axis (through Od)
+A = X[Oh]; B = X[Od]; u=(B-A)/np.linalg.norm(B-A)
+
+def rot(points, center, axis, deg):
+    th=np.radians(deg); k=axis
+    K=np.array([[0,-k[2],k[1]],[k[2],0,-k[0]],[-k[1],k[0],0]])
+    R=np.eye(3)+np.sin(th)*K+(1-np.cos(th))*(K@K)
+    return (points-center)@R.T+center
+
+ben=list(range(27,41))
+best=None
+for deg in range(0,360,5):
+    Xr=X.copy(); Xr[ben]=rot(X[ben], B, u, deg)
+    d=np.linalg.norm(Xr[Ca]-Xr[Cc])
+    # min heavy-heavy contact between benzaldehyde and enamine (heavy atoms: exclude H)
+    heavy=[i for i in range(41) if at[i]!='H']
+    contacts=[np.linalg.norm(Xr[i]-Xr[j]) for i in heavy for j in heavy if i in ben and j not in ben]
+    mc=min(contacts)
+    ang=np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(np.dot(Xr[Oh]-Xr[Hh],Xr[Od]-Xr[Hh])/(np.linalg.norm(Xr[Oh]-Xr[Hh])*np.linalg.norm(Xr[Od]-Xr[Hh])),-1,1)))
+    print(f"deg={deg:4d} d(Ca-Cc)={d:.3f} min_heavy_contact={mc:.3f} ang_OHO={ang:.1f}")
+    if best is None or abs(d-3.8)<abs(best[1]-3.8): best=(deg,d,mc,Xr)
+print("BEST", best[0], round(best[1],3), round(best[2],3))
+np.save("/tmp/best_frame.npy", best[3])

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+
+# frame 0 coords
+lines = open("HI1_gold_20260929/paratera_20260930/major_spec/clean_rc_build/confs.xyz").read().splitlines()
+n=int(lines[0]); at=[l.split()[0] for l in lines[2:2+n]]
+X=np.array([[float(v) for v in l.split()[1:4]] for l in lines[2:2+n]])
+
+Ca, Oh, Hh, Od, Cc = 0, 10, 23, 27, 28
+# rotate benzaldehyde (27-40) about the Oh...Od axis (through Od)
+A = X[Oh]; B = X[Od]; u=(B-A)/np.linalg.norm(B-A)
+
+def rot(points, center, axis, deg):
+    th=np.radians(deg); k=axis
+    K=np.array([[0,-k[2],k[1]],[k[2],0,-k[0]],[-k[1],k[0],0]])
+    R=np.eye(3)+np.sin(th)*K+(1-np.cos(th))*(K@K)
+    return (points-center)@R.T+center
+
+ben=list(range(27,41))
+best=None
+for deg in range(0,360,5):
+    Xr=X.copy(); Xr[ben]=rot(X[ben], B, u, deg)
+    d=np.linalg.norm(Xr[Ca]-Xr[Cc])
+    # min heavy-heavy contact between benzaldehyde and enamine (heavy atoms: exclude H)
+    heavy=[i for i in range(41) if at[i]!='H']
+    contacts=[np.linalg.norm(Xr[i]-Xr[j]) for i in heavy for j in heavy if i in ben and j not in ben]
+    mc=min(contacts)
+    ang=np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(np.dot(Xr[Oh]-Xr[Hh],Xr[Od]-Xr[Hh])/(np.linalg.norm(Xr[Oh]-Xr[Hh])*np.linalg.norm(Xr[Od]-Xr[Hh])),-1,1)))

+    if best is None or abs(d-3.8)<abs(best[1]-3.8): best=(deg,d,mc,Xr)

+Ca, Oh, Hh, Od, Cc = 0, 10, 23, 27, 28
+A=X[Oh]; B=X[Od]; u=(B-A)/np.linalg.norm(B-A)
+def rot(points, center, axis, deg):
+    th=np.radians(deg); k=axis
+    K=np.array([[0,-k[2],k[1]],[k[2],0,-k[0]],[-k[1],k[0],0]])
+    R=np.eye(3)+np.sin(th)*K+(1-np.cos(th))*(K@K)
+    return (points-center)@R.T+center
+enam=list(range(0,27))  # enamine + water
+heavy=[i for i in range(41) if at[i]!='H']
+res=[]
+for deg in range(0,360,5):
+    Xr=X.copy(); Xr[enam]=rot(X[enam], A, u, deg)
+    d=np.linalg.norm(Xr[Ca]-Xr[Cc])
+    ang=np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(np.dot(Xr[Oh]-Xr[Hh],Xr[Od]-Xr[Hh])/(np.linalg.norm(Xr[Oh]-Xr[Hh])*np.linalg.norm(Xr[Od]-Xr[Hh])),-1,1)))
+    dh=np.linalg.norm(Xr[Hh]-Xr[Od])
+    # min contact benz(27-40) heavy vs enamine heavy(0-26)
+    mc=min(np.linalg.norm(Xr[i]-Xr[j]) for i in heavy if i in range(27,41) for j in heavy if j<27)
+    res.append((deg,d,dh,ang,mc))
+    print(f"deg={deg:4d} d(Ca-Cc)={d:.3f} d(H..Od)={dh:.3f} angOHO={ang:.1f} minContact={mc:.3f}")
+# best with d in 3.5-4.3 and H-bond<2.0
+cand=[r for r in res if 3.4<=r[1]<=4.4 and r[2]<2.0]
+print("CANDIDATES:", cand)

+import numpy as np, glob
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+import re
+for f in sorted(glob.glob("HI1_gold_20260929/paratera_20260930/major_spec/scan_clean/scan_clean_np8.00*.xyz")):
+    L=open(f).read().splitlines(); n=int(L[0]); at=[l.split()[0] for l in L[2:2+n]]
+    X=np.array([[float(v) for v in l.split()[1:4]] for l in L[2:2+n]])
+    e=re.search(r"E ([-0-9.]+)", L[1]); e=float(e.group(1)) if e else float('nan')
+    Ca,Cc,Od,Oh,Hh,Ccarb=0,28,27,10,23,8
+    d=lambda a,b: float(np.linalg.norm(X[a]-X[b]))
+    m=Chem.MolFromXYZBlock(str(n)+"\n\n"+"\n".join(L[2:2+n]))
+    try:
+        rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m,charge=0); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
+        nfrag=len(Chem.GetMolFrags(m))
+        bonds=m.GetNumBonds()
+    except Exception as ex:
+        nfrag=-1; bonds=-1
+    print("%s E=%.8f d(Ca-Cc)=%.3f d(H..Od)=%.3f d(Oh..Od)=%.3f frags=%d bonds=%d"%(f.split('/')[-1],e,d(Ca,Cc),d(Hh,Od),d(Oh,Od),nfrag,bonds))

+    return np.eye(3)+vx+vx@vx*((1-c)/(s*s))

+P=np.array([[float(x) for x in L[2+i].split()[1:4]] for i in range(n)])
+
+def plane(a,b,c):
+    v=np.cross(b-a,c-a); return v/np.linalg.norm(v)

+

+    return np.eye(3)+vx+vx@vx*((1-c)/(s*s))

+print("wrote HI1_gold_20260929/build/twoface_seed.xyz  natoms=%d"%(m.GetNumAtoms()+3))

+24-26=water, 27=Od(aldehyde),28=Cc, 29-40=benzaldehyde.  Reflect the benzaldehyde through the
+enamine plane, then rigid-rotate the carboxyl+water about the Cring-Ccooh axis to re-form the O-H...Od
+H-bond -> the aldehyde now sits on the opposite (minor) face.

+n=int(L[0].split()[0])
+sym=[L[2+i].split()[0] for i in range(n)]
+P=np.array([[float(x) for x in L[2+i].split()[1:4]] for i in range(n)])
+
+def plane(a,b,c):
+    v=np.cross(b-a,c-a); return v/np.linalg.norm(v)
+nrm=plane(P[0],P[1],P[3])
+
+def refl(pts,p0,nv): return pts-2*np.outer((pts-p0)@nv,nv)

+    b0=p0-p1; b1=p2-p1; b2=p3-p2

+    v=b0-np.dot(b0,b1n)*b1n; w=b2-np.dot(b2,b1n)*b1n
+    x=np.dot(v,w); y=np.dot(np.cross(b1n,v),w)
+    return np.degrees(np.arctan2(y,x))

+    np.linalg.norm(P[28]-P[0]), np.dot(P[28]-P[0],nrm), dihedral(P[1],P[0],P[28],P[27]),
+    np.linalg.norm(P[23]-P[27])))
+
+Q=P.copy(); Q[27:41]=refl(P[27:41],P[0],nrm)
+print("reflected: face(Cc)=%+.3f  d(Ca-Cc)=%.3f  d(OHH..Od)=%.3f"%(
+    np.dot(Q[28]-Q[0],nrm), np.linalg.norm(Q[28]-Q[0]), np.linalg.norm(Q[23]-Q[27])))
+

+grp=[8,9,10,23,24,25,26]

+best=None

+for i in range(n):
+    out.append("%-2s %14.8f %14.8f %14.8f"%(sym[i],*T[i]))

+K=np.array([[0,-ax[2],ax[1]],[ax[2],0,-ax[0]],[-ax[1],ax[0],0]])
+R=np.eye(3)+2*(K@K)   # 180 deg

+def dih(a,b,c,d):

+    v=b0-np.dot(b0,b1n)*b1n; w=b2-np.dot(b2,b1n)*b1n
+    return np.degrees(np.arctan2(np.dot(np.cross(b1n,v),w),np.dot(v,w)))

+    L=open(p).read().splitlines(); n=int(L[0])

+    v1=X[a]-X[b]; v2=X[c]-X[b]
+    return float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(np.dot(v1,v2)/(np.linalg.norm(v1)*np.linalg.norm(v2)),-1,1))))

+aimed at the carboxyl H (a real O-H...O H-bond, not necessarily collinear), with windows on d(H..O),

+    v=np.cross(a1,a2); c=np.dot(a1,a2); s=np.linalg.norm(v)
+    if s<1e-9: return np.eye(3) if c>0 else -np.eye(3)
+    vx=np.array([[0,-v[2],v[1]],[v[2],0,-v[0]],[-v[1],v[0],0]])

+"""Build the HI1 minor-face (EM1) reactive-complex seed from the major-face RC geometry.
+Order (0-based, matches dft/rc/final.xyz): 0=Ca,1=Cb,3=N, 7=Cring,8=Ccooh,9=OdO,10=Oh,23=OhH,
+24-26=water, 27=Od(aldehyde),28=Cc, 29-40=benzaldehyde.  Reflect the benzaldehyde through the
+enamine plane, then rigid-rotate the carboxyl+water about the Cring-Ccooh axis to re-form the O-H...Od
+H-bond -> the aldehyde now sits on the opposite (minor) face.
+"""
+import numpy as np
+RC="HI1_gold_20260929/dft/rc/final.xyz"
+L=open(RC).read().split("\n")
+n=int(L[0].split()[0])
+sym=[L[2+i].split()[0] for i in range(n)]
+P=np.array([[float(x) for x in L[2+i].split()[1:4]] for i in range(n)])
+
+def plane(a,b,c):
+    v=np.cross(b-a,c-a); return v/np.linalg.norm(v)
+nrm=plane(P[0],P[1],P[3])
+
+def refl(pts,p0,nv): return pts-2*np.outer((pts-p0)@nv,nv)
+def dihedral(p0,p1,p2,p3):
+    b0=p0-p1; b1=p2-p1; b2=p3-p2
+    b1n=b1/np.linalg.norm(b1)
+    v=b0-np.dot(b0,b1n)*b1n; w=b2-np.dot(b2,b1n)*b1n
+    x=np.dot(v,w); y=np.dot(np.cross(b1n,v),w)
+    return np.degrees(np.arctan2(y,x))
+
+print("major: d(Ca-Cc)=%.3f  face(Cc)=%+.3f  dih(Cb-Ca-Cc-Od)=%+.1f  d(OHH..Od)=%.3f"%(
+    np.linalg.norm(P[28]-P[0]), np.dot(P[28]-P[0],nrm), dihedral(P[1],P[0],P[28],P[27]),
+    np.linalg.norm(P[23]-P[27])))
+
+Q=P.copy(); Q[27:41]=refl(P[27:41],P[0],nrm)
+print("reflected: face(Cc)=%+.3f  d(Ca-Cc)=%.3f  d(OHH..Od)=%.3f"%(
+    np.dot(Q[28]-Q[0],nrm), np.linalg.norm(Q[28]-Q[0]), np.linalg.norm(Q[23]-Q[27])))
+
+axis=(P[8]-P[7]); axis/=np.linalg.norm(axis)
+grp=[8,9,10,23,24,25,26]
+K=lambda a: np.array([[0,-a[2],a[1]],[a[2],0,-a[0]],[-a[1],a[0],0]])
+best=None
+for deg in np.arange(0,360,2.0):
+    th=np.radians(deg); R=np.eye(3)+np.sin(th)*K(axis)+(1-np.cos(th))*(K(axis)@K(axis))
+    T=Q.copy(); T[grp]=(R@(Q[grp]-P[7]).T).T+P[7]
+    # want O-H...O=C H-bond: H23..Od27 ~1.9, Oh10..Od27 ~2.65
+    err=abs(np.linalg.norm(T[23]-T[27])-1.9)+0.7*abs(np.linalg.norm(T[10]-T[27])-2.65)
+    if best is None or err<best[0]: best=(err,deg,T)
+err,deg,T=best
+print("chosen carboxyl rotation %.0f deg; final d(OHH..Od)=%.3f d(Oh..Od)=%.3f face(Cc)=%+.3f"%(
+    deg, np.linalg.norm(T[23]-T[27]), np.linalg.norm(T[10]-T[27]), np.dot(T[28]-T[0],nrm)))
+out=["%d"%n,"HI1 E2 minor-face (EM1) reactive-complex seed from reflected major RC"]
+for i in range(n):
+    out.append("%-2s %14.8f %14.8f %14.8f"%(sym[i],*T[i]))
+open("HI1_gold_20260929/build/twoface_seed.xyz","w").write("\n".join(out)+"\n")
+print("wrote HI1_gold_20260929/build/twoface_seed.xyz")

+import math

+import math
+def rd(fn):
+    L=open(fn).read().splitlines(); n=int(L[0]); c=[]
+    for i in range(n):
+        p=L[i+2].split(); c.append((float(p[1]),float(p[2]),float(p[3])))
+    return c
+def dih(p0,p1,p2,p3):
+    import numpy as np
+    b0=np.array(p0)-np.array(p1); b1=np.array(p2)-np.array(p1); b2=np.array(p3)-np.array(p2)
+    b1n=b1/np.linalg.norm(b1)
+    v=np.cross(b0,b1n); w=np.cross(b2,b1n)
+    x=np.dot(v,w); y=np.dot(np.cross(b1n,v),w)
+    return math.degrees(math.atan2(y,x))
+base='HI1_gold_20260929/paratera_20260930/major_spec'
+print('file   D(Cb-Ca-Cc-Od) [1-based C2-C1-C29-O28]  Ca-Cc')
+for nm,f in [('RC51 job51_final',base+'/job51_final.xyz'),('ts2_seed',base+'/ts2_seed.xyz')]:
+    c=rd(f); d=dih(c[1],c[0],c[28],c[27]); r=math.dist(c[0],c[28])
+    print(nm, round(d,1), round(r,3))
+for n in range(1,10):
+    c=rd(base+'/scan_clean/scan_clean_np8.%03d.xyz'%n); d=dih(c[1],c[0],c[28],c[27]); r=math.dist(c[0],c[28])
+    print('scan_%03d'%n, round(d,1), round(r,3))
+c=rd(base+'/ts2_orca6/review/frame_last.xyz'); d=dih(c[1],c[0],c[28],c[27]); r=math.dist(c[0],c[28])
+print('job64_final', round(d,1), round(r,3))

+++ b/hard_replacements_20261001/H6PI/_verify_stereo.py
@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+import sys
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+for tag, path in [("reactant","reactant_seed.xyz"),("product","product_cis_seed.xyz")]:
+    mol = Chem.MolFromXYZFile(path)
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(mol, charge=0)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mol, isomericSmiles=True)
+    print(tag, "isomeric_smiles:", smi)
+    # double bond stereo
+    for b in mol.GetBonds():
+        if b.GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE and b.GetStereo()!=Chem.BondStereo.STEREONONE:
+            print("   C%d=C%d"%(b.GetBeginAtomIdx()+1,b.GetEndAtomIdx()+1), b.GetStereo())
+    # CIP
+    for a in mol.GetAtoms():
+        if a.HasProp("_CIPCode"):
+            print("   atom", a.GetIdx()+1, a.GetSymbol(), "CIP", a.GetProp("_CIPCode"))

+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds, AllChem
+import numpy as np
+
+# 1) declared mapped product SMILES
+dec = "[CH3:1][C@H:2]1[CH:3]=[CH:4][CH:5]=[CH:6][C@@H:7]1[CH3:8]"
+m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(dec)
+Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+print("declared mapped SMILES canonical:", Chem.MolToSmiles(m, isomericSmiles=True))
+for a in m.GetAtoms():
+    if a.HasProp("_CIPCode"): print("  declared atom", a.GetIdx()+1, "map", a.GetAtomMapNum(), a.GetProp("_CIPCode"))
+
+# 2) product from 3D seed
+p = Chem.MolFromXYZFile("product_cis_seed.xyz")
+rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(p, charge=0)
+Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(p)
+Chem.AssignStereochemistry(p, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+print("3D product canonical:", Chem.MolToSmiles(p, isomericSmiles=True))
+for a in p.GetAtoms():
+    if a.HasProp("_CIPCode"): print("  3D atom", a.GetIdx()+1, p.GetAtomWithIdx(a.GetIdx()).GetSymbol(), a.GetProp("_CIPCode"))
+
+# 3) facial relationship: C1(methyl) and C8(methyl) vs mean ring plane (ring atoms C2..C7 = idx1..6)
+conf = p.GetConformer()
+ring = [1,2,3,4,5,6]
+pts = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring])
+cen = pts.mean(axis=0)
+u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(pts-cen)
+n = vt[2]; 
+def side(i):
+    return np.dot(np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)))-cen, n)
+print("methyl C1 side = %+.3f ; methyl C8 side = %+.3f ; H on C2 side=%+.3f ; H on C7 side=%+.3f"%(side(0),side(7),side(8),side(15)))
+print("cis?" , (side(0)*side(7))>0)
+
+# 4) cis/trans identity from SMILES: cis-5,6-dimethylcyclohexa-1,3-diene
+for name,smi in [("cis-unspec","CC1C=CC=CC1C"),("R,R","C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@H]1C"),("R,S","C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C")]:
+    mm=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mm,force=True,cleanIt=True)
+    cip=[(a.GetIdx()+1,a.GetProp("_CIPCode")) for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp("_CIPCode")]
+    print(name, Chem.MolToSmiles(mm,isomericSmiles=True), "CIP", cip, "stereocenters", Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mm,useLegacyImplementation=False,includeUnassigned=True))

+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+import numpy as np
+
+def side_test(smi, label):
+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    m = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=42)
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
+    conf=m.GetConformer()
+    # ring atoms = the 6 ring carbons (ring info)
+    ri=m.GetRingInfo()
+    ring=list(ri.AtomRings()[0])
+    pts=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring])
+    cen=pts.mean(axis=0); u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(pts-cen); n=vt[2]
+    def sd(i): return np.dot(np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)))-cen,n)
+    methyls=[a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="C" and a.GetDegree()==1]
+    vals=[round(sd(i),3) for i in methyls]
+    cip=[(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp("_CIPCode")) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp("_CIPCode")]
+    same=(sd(methyls[0])*sd(methyls[1]))>0 if len(methyls)==2 else None
+    print(label, "ring_size",len(ring),"methyls",methyls,"sides",vals,"same_face(cis)=",same,"CIP",cip)
+    print("   canonical:",Chem.MolToSmiles(m,isomericSmiles=False))
+
+side_test("[CH3:1][C@H:2]1[CH:3]=[CH:4][CH:5]=[CH:6][C@@H:7]1[CH3:8]","declared-cis-SMILES")
+side_test("CC1C=CC=CC1C","unspecified")
+side_test("C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@H]1C","tagA")
+side_test("C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C","tagB")

+    print(label, Chem.MolToSmiles(m,isomericSmiles=True))
+reactant_test("[CH3:1]/[CH:2]=[CH:3]/[CH:4]=[CH:5]\\[CH:6]=[CH:7]\\[CH3:8]","reactant-declared")

@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+import numpy as np
+
+def analyze(smi,label,embed=True):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    m=Chem.AddHs(m)
+    if embed:
+        AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,randomSeed=0xf00d)
+        AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
+        Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
+    conf=m.GetConformer()
+    ri=m.GetRingInfo(); ring=list(ri.AtomRings()[0])
+    ringset=set(ring)
+    # methyl carbons = carbon neighbors of ring atoms not in ring
+    methyls=[]
+    ringcarbons=[]
+    for i in ring:
+        a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i)
+        if a.GetSymbol()!="C": continue
+        ringcarbons.append(i)
+        for nb in a.GetNeighbors():
+            if nb.GetIdx() not in ringset and nb.GetSymbol()=="C":
+                methyls.append((i,nb.GetIdx()))
+    pts=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring])
+    cen=pts.mean(axis=0); u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(pts-cen); n=vt[2]
+    def sd(i): return float(np.dot(np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)))-cen,n))
+    print(label)
+    print("  methyls (ringC,methylC):",methyls)
+    if len(methyls)==2:
+        s0=sd(methyls[0][1]); s1=sd(methyls[1][1])
+        print("  methyl sides %+.3f %+.3f -> %s"%(s0,s1,"CIS (same face)" if s0*s1>0 else "TRANS (opposite faces)"))
+    print("  CIP:",[(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp("_CIPCode")) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp("_CIPCode")])
+
+analyze("[CH3:1][C@H:2]1[CH:3]=[CH:4][CH:5]=[CH:6][C@@H:7]1[CH3:8]","DECLARED product SMILES")
+analyze("C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@H]1C","tagA")
+analyze("C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C","tagB")
+analyze("CC1C=CC=CC1C","unspecified")
+
+# and the actual 3D seed file
+m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile("product_cis_seed.xyz")
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m,charge=0)
+Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
+conf=m.GetConformer()
+ri=m.GetRingInfo(); ring=list(ri.AtomRings()[0]); ringset=set(ring)
+methyls=[(i,nb.GetIdx()) for i in ring for nb in m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors() if nb.GetIdx() not in ringset and nb.GetSymbol()=="C"]
+pts=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring]); cen=pts.mean(axis=0); u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(pts-cen); n=vt[2]

+    if a.HasProp("_CIPCode"): print("  declared atom", a.GetIdx()+1, "map", a.GetAtomMapNum(), a.GetProp("_CIPCode"))

+

+    for b in mol.GetBonds():

+    for a in mol.GetAtoms():

+from rdkit import Chem
+
+def canon(smi):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    return Chem.MolToSmiles(m, isomericSmiles=True)
+
+declared="[CH3:1][C@H:2]1[CH:3]=[CH:4][CH:5]=[CH:6][C@@H:7]1[CH3:8]"
+# strip atom maps for a clean comparison
+def strip(smi):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); 
+    for a in m.GetAtoms(): a.SetAtomMapNum(0)
+    return Chem.MolToSmiles(m,isomericSmiles=True)
+
+print("declared  canon:", strip(declared))
+for nm,s in [("tagA","C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@H]1C"),("tagB","C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C"),

+    print(nm, canon(s), " == declared?", canon(s)==strip(declared))
+
+# Now determine cis/trans purely from the graph using a robust geometric-free rule:
+# 1,2-disubstituted ring, cis/trans = whether both substituents are on same face.
+# Use RDKit: build both diastereomers from a fixed SMILES template and use
+# the 'unspecified' skeleton's two distinct canonical forms.
+print()
+print("The two possible diastereomers of 5,6-dimethylcyclohexa-1,3-diene:")
+seen=set()
+for a in ["@","@@"]:
+    for b in ["@","@@"]:
+        s="C[C%sH]1C=CC=C[C%sH]1C"%(a,b)
+        c=canon(s)
+        if c not in seen:
+            seen.add(c); print("  ",c)

+from rdkit import Chem
+
+def canon(m): return Chem.MolToSmiles(m,isomericSmiles=True)
+def invert_all(smi):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        t=a.GetChiralTag()
+        if t==Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW: a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
+        elif t==Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW: a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW)
+    return canon(m)
+
+declared="[CH3:1][C@H:2]1[CH:3]=[CH:4][CH:5]=[CH:6][C@@H:7]1[CH3:8]"
+dc=Chem.MolFromSmiles(declared)
+for a in dc.GetAtoms(): a.SetAtomMapNum(0)
+dcan=canon(dc)
+print("declared canon:", dcan)
+
+cands={
+ "tagA":"C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@H]1C",
+ "tagB":"C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C",
+ "tagD":"C[C@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C",
+ "reflect_declared":invert_all(declared),
+}
+for k,s in cands.items():
+    c=canon(Chem.MolFromSmiles(s))
+    inv=invert_all(s)
+    meso = (inv==c)
+    print(f"{k:18s} {c:28s} mirror={inv:28s} achiral(meso/cis)={meso} ==declared?{c==dcan}")
", "message": ""}

+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+import numpy as np
+
+def analyze(smi,label,embed=True):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    m=Chem.AddHs(m)
+    if embed:
+        AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,randomSeed=0xf00d)
+        AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
+        Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
+    conf=m.GetConformer()
+    ri=m.GetRingInfo(); ring=list(ri.AtomRings()[0])
+    ringset=set(ring)
+    # methyl carbons = carbon neighbors of ring atoms not in ring
+    methyls=[]
+    ringcarbons=[]
+    for i in ring:
+        a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i)
+        if a.GetSymbol()!="C": continue
+        ringcarbons.append(i)
+        for nb in a.GetNeighbors():
+            if nb.GetIdx() not in ringset and nb.GetSymbol()=="C":
+                methyls.append((i,nb.GetIdx()))
+    pts=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring])
+    cen=pts.mean(axis=0); u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(pts-cen); n=vt[2]
+    def sd(i): return float(np.dot(np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)))-cen,n))
+    print(label)
+    print("  methyls (ringC,methylC):",methyls)
+    if len(methyls)==2:
+        s0=sd(methyls[0][1]); s1=sd(methyls[1][1])
+        print("  methyl sides %+.3f %+.3f -> %s"%(s0,s1,"CIS (same face)" if s0*s1>0 else "TRANS (opposite faces)"))
+    print("  CIP:",[(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp("_CIPCode")) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp("_CIPCode")])
+
+analyze("[CH3:1][C@H:2]1[CH:3]=[CH:4][CH:5]=[CH:6][C@@H:7]1[CH3:8]","DECLARED product SMILES")
+analyze("C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@H]1C","tagA")
+analyze("C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C","tagB")
+analyze("CC1C=CC=CC1C","unspecified")
+
+# and the actual 3D seed file
+m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile("product_cis_seed.xyz")
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m,charge=0)

+ri=m.GetRingInfo(); ring=list(ri.AtomRings()[0]); ringset=set(ring)
+methyls=[(i,nb.GetIdx()) for i in ring for nb in m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors() if nb.GetIdx() not in ringset and nb.GetSymbol()=="C"]
+pts=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring]); cen=pts.mean(axis=0); u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(pts-cen); n=vt[2]

+print("3D SEED product_cis_seed.xyz methyls",methyls,"sides %+.3f %+.3f"%(sd(methyls[0][1]),sd(methyls[1][1])))

+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    m = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=42)
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
+    conf=m.GetConformer()
+    # ring atoms = the 6 ring carbons (ring info)
+    ri=m.GetRingInfo()
+    ring=list(ri.AtomRings()[0])
+    pts=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring])

+from rdkit import Chem
+
+def canon(m): return Chem.MolToSmiles(m,isomericSmiles=True)
+def invert_all(smi):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        t=a.GetChiralTag()
+        if t==Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW: a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
+        elif t==Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW: a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW)
+    return canon(m)
+
+declared="[CH3:1][C@H:2]1[CH:3]=[CH:4][CH:5]=[CH:6][C@@H:7]1[CH3:8]"
+dc=Chem.MolFromSmiles(declared)
+for a in dc.GetAtoms(): a.SetAtomMapNum(0)
+dcan=canon(dc)
+print("declared canon:", dcan)
+
+cands={
+ "tagA":"C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@H]1C",
+ "tagB":"C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C",
+ "tagD":"C[C@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C",
+ "reflect_declared":invert_all(declared),
+}
+for k,s in cands.items():
+    c=canon(Chem.MolFromSmiles(s))
+    inv=invert_all(s)
+    meso = (inv==c)
+    print(f"{k:18s} {c:28s} mirror={inv:28s} achiral(meso/cis)={meso} ==declared?{c==dcan}")

+print("declared mapped SMILES canonical:", Chem.MolToSmiles(m, isomericSmiles=True))

+    if a.HasProp("_CIPCode"): print("  declared atom", a.GetIdx()+1, "map", a.GetAtomMapNum(), a.GetProp("_CIPCode"))

+    if a.HasProp("_CIPCode"): print("  3D atom", a.GetIdx()+1, p.GetAtomWithIdx(a.GetIdx()).GetSymbol(), a.GetProp("_CIPCode"))

+conf = p.GetConformer()

+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+import numpy as np
+
+def analyze(smi,label,embed=True):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    m=Chem.AddHs(m)
+    if embed:
+        AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,randomSeed=0xf00d)
+        AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
+        Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
+    conf=m.GetConformer()
+    ri=m.GetRingInfo(); ring=list(ri.AtomRings()[0])
+    ringset=set(ring)
+    # methyl carbons = carbon neighbors of ring atoms not in ring
+    methyls=[]
+    ringcarbons=[]
+    for i in ring:
+        a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i)
+        if a.GetSymbol()!="C": continue
+        ringcarbons.append(i)
+        for nb in a.GetNeighbors():
+            if nb.GetIdx() not in ringset and nb.GetSymbol()=="C":
+                methyls.append((i,nb.GetIdx()))
+    pts=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring])
+    cen=pts.mean(axis=0); u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(pts-cen); n=vt[2]
+    def sd(i): return float(np.dot(np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)))-cen,n))
+    print(label)
+    print("  methyls (ringC,methylC):",methyls)
+    if len(methyls)==2:
+        s0=sd(methyls[0][1]); s1=sd(methyls[1][1])
+        print("  methyl sides %+.3f %+.3f -> %s"%(s0,s1,"CIS (same face)" if s0*s1>0 else "TRANS (opposite faces)"))
+    print("  CIP:",[(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp("_CIPCode")) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp("_CIPCode")])
+
+analyze("[CH3:1][C@H:2]1[CH:3]=[CH:4][CH:5]=[CH:6][C@@H:7]1[CH3:8]","DECLARED product SMILES")

+analyze("C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C","tagB")
+analyze("CC1C=CC=CC1C","unspecified")
+
+# and the actual 3D seed file

+print("3D SEED product_cis_seed.xyz methyls",methyls,"sides %+.3f %+.3f"%(sd(methyls[0][1]),sd(methyls[1][1])))

+from rdkit import Chem

+
+def side_test(smi, label):
+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    m = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=42)
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
+    conf=m.GetConformer()
+    # ring atoms = the 6 ring carbons (ring info)
+    ri=m.GetRingInfo()
+    ring=list(ri.AtomRings()[0])
+    pts=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring])
+    cen=pts.mean(axis=0); u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(pts-cen); n=vt[2]
+    def sd(i): return np.dot(np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)))-cen,n)
+    methyls=[a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="C" and a.GetDegree()==1]
+    vals=[round(sd(i),3) for i in methyls]
+    cip=[(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp("_CIPCode")) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp("_CIPCode")]
+    same=(sd(methyls[0])*sd(methyls[1]))>0 if len(methyls)==2 else None

+from rdkit import Chem
+
+def canon(m): return Chem.MolToSmiles(m,isomericSmiles=True)
+def invert_all(smi):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        t=a.GetChiralTag()
+        if t==Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW: a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
+        elif t==Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW: a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW)
+    return canon(m)
+
+declared="[CH3:1][C@H:2]1[CH:3]=[CH:4][CH:5]=[CH:6][C@@H:7]1[CH3:8]"
+dc=Chem.MolFromSmiles(declared)
+for a in dc.GetAtoms(): a.SetAtomMapNum(0)
+dcan=canon(dc)
+print("declared canon:", dcan)
+
+cands={
+ "tagA":"C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@H]1C",
+ "tagB":"C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C",
+ "tagD":"C[C@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C",
+ "reflect_declared":invert_all(declared),
+}
+for k,s in cands.items():
+    c=canon(Chem.MolFromSmiles(s))
+    inv=invert_all(s)
+    meso = (inv==c)
+    print(f"{k:18s} {c:28s} mirror={inv:28s} achiral(meso/cis)={meso} ==declared?{c==dcan}")

+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds, AllChem
+import numpy as np
+
+# 1) declared mapped product SMILES
+dec = "[CH3:1][C@H:2]1[CH:3]=[CH:4][CH:5]=[CH:6][C@@H:7]1[CH3:8]"
+m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(dec)
+Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+print("declared mapped SMILES canonical:", Chem.MolToSmiles(m, isomericSmiles=True))
+for a in m.GetAtoms():
+    if a.HasProp("_CIPCode"): print("  declared atom", a.GetIdx()+1, "map", a.GetAtomMapNum(), a.GetProp("_CIPCode"))
+
+# 2) product from 3D seed
+p = Chem.MolFromXYZFile("product_cis_seed.xyz")
+rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(p, charge=0)
+Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(p)
+Chem.AssignStereochemistry(p, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+print("3D product canonical:", Chem.MolToSmiles(p, isomericSmiles=True))
+for a in p.GetAtoms():
+    if a.HasProp("_CIPCode"): print("  3D atom", a.GetIdx()+1, p.GetAtomWithIdx(a.GetIdx()).GetSymbol(), a.GetProp("_CIPCode"))
+
+# 3) facial relationship: C1(methyl) and C8(methyl) vs mean ring plane (ring atoms C2..C7 = idx1..6)
+conf = p.GetConformer()
+ring = [1,2,3,4,5,6]
+pts = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring])
+cen = pts.mean(axis=0)
+u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(pts-cen)
+n = vt[2]; 
+def side(i):
+    return np.dot(np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)))-cen, n)
+print("methyl C1 side = %+.3f ; methyl C8 side = %+.3f ; H on C2 side=%+.3f ; H on C7 side=%+.3f"%(side(0),side(7),side(8),side(15)))
+print("cis?" , (side(0)*side(7))>0)
+
+# 4) cis/trans identity from SMILES: cis-5,6-dimethylcyclohexa-1,3-diene
+for name,smi in [("cis-unspec","CC1C=CC=CC1C"),("R,R","C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@H]1C"),("R,S","C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C")]:
+    mm=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mm,force=True,cleanIt=True)
+    cip=[(a.GetIdx()+1,a.GetProp("_CIPCode")) for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp("_CIPCode")]
+    print(name, Chem.MolToSmiles(mm,isomericSmiles=True), "CIP", cip, "stereocenters", Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mm,useLegacyImplementation=False,includeUnassigned=True))

+# H6PI — 准备记录（仅准备，未提交任何计算）
+
+候选：(2E,4Z,6E)-2,4,6-辛三烯 热 6π 电环化 → cis-5,6-二甲基-1,3-环己二烯（meso）

+上位方案：`hard_replacements_20261001/PLAN.md`（H6PI 候选条目）。
+
+---
+
+## 1. 授权范围与边界（严格遵守）
+
+- 只做**第一允许热闭环**（6π 对旋、协调、闭壳层单参考）。
+- **不**构造禁阻（MR/顺旋）对照，**不**探索 1,5-H 迁移，**不**纳入光化学、E/Z 异构化平衡。
+- 方法固定：ORCA 6.1.1，气相，B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP，RIJCOSX/def2-J，TightSCF。
+- 资源：8 CPU，`%maxcore 1536`（8×1536 = 12288 MB 建模内存；提交预留 14000 MB，见下）。
+- **不设** MaxIter，**不设** Cloudra timeout。

+|---|---|
+| 分子式 | C8H12 |
+| 原子数 | 20（8 重原子 + 12 H） |
+| 电荷/自旋 | q = 0, m = 1 |
+| 反应物 | (2E,4Z,6E)-octa-2,4,6-triene |
+| 产物 | cis-5,6-dimethylcyclohexa-1,3-diene（meso） |
+
+## 3. 3D 立体与映射核对（本阶段核心，发现一处必须修正的草案缺陷）
+
+用 RDKit `AssignStereochemistryFrom3D` 从实际 3D 坐标独立读取立体（脚本见 `verification/`）。
+
+### 3.1 反应物 — 通过
+`reactant_seed.xyz` 三处双键 3D 读取为 **E, Z, E**（C2=C3 E，C4=C5 Z，C6=C7 E），与声明一致。链 C1–C2=C3–C4=C5–C6=C7–C8 连通正确，无异常键长/键角。
+

+def side_cis(path,label):
+    m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile(path); rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m,charge=0)

+# H6PI — 准备记录（仅准备，未提交任何计算）
+
+候选：(2E,4Z,6E)-2,4,6-辛三烯 热 6π 电环化 → cis-5,6-二甲基-1,3-环己二烯（meso）
+目录：`hard_replacements_20261001/H6PI/`
+状态：**PREPARATION ONLY — 没有提交任何 QM / xTB / CREST 作业。** 等监工资源与科学准备检查。
+上位方案：`hard_replacements_20261001/PLAN.md`（H6PI 候选条目）。
+
+---
+
+## 1. 授权范围与边界（严格遵守）
+
+- 只做**第一允许热闭环**（6π 对旋、协调、闭壳层单参考）。
+- **不**构造禁阻（MR/顺旋）对照，**不**探索 1,5-H 迁移，**不**纳入光化学、E/Z 异构化平衡。
+- 方法固定：ORCA 6.1.1，气相，B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP，RIJCOSX/def2-J，TightSCF。
+- 资源：8 CPU，`%maxcore 1536`（8×1536 = 12288 MB 建模内存；提交预留 14000 MB，见下）。
+- **不设** MaxIter，**不设** Cloudra timeout。
+- 未提交前不写正式题源/registry；替换须在真实 TS/IRC/0 虚频端点全部通过后生效。
+
+## 2. 体系身份
+
+| 项 | 值 |
+|---|---|
+| 分子式 | C8H12 |
+| 原子数 | 20（8 重原子 + 12 H） |
+| 电荷/自旋 | q = 0, m = 1 |
+| 反应物 | (2E,4Z,6E)-octa-2,4,6-triene |
+| 产物 | cis-5,6-dimethylcyclohexa-1,3-diene（meso） |
+
+## 3. 3D 立体与映射核对（本阶段核心，发现一处必须修正的草案缺陷）
+
+用 RDKit `AssignStereochemistryFrom3D` 从实际 3D 坐标独立读取立体（脚本见 `verification/`）。
+
+### 3.1 反应物 — 通过
+`reactant_seed.xyz` 三处双键 3D 读取为 **E, Z, E**（C2=C3 E，C4=C5 Z，C6=C7 E），与声明一致。链 C1–C2=C3–C4=C5–C6=C7–C8 连通正确，无异常键长/键角。
+
+### 3.2 产物 — **草案是 trans，不是 cis（缺陷）**
+- 声明产物 SMILES `[CH3:1][C@H:2]1[CH:3]=[CH:4][CH:5]=[CH:6][C@@H:7]1[CH3:8]`
+  经规范异构 SMILES + meso 反演检验，实际是**手性 trans 非对映体**（canon `C[C@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C`，(2S,7S)），**不是** meso。
+- 文件 `product_cis_seed.xyz` 的 3D 几何：两甲基 C1/C8 相对环平均面分居两侧（−0.738 / +0.738 Å）→ **trans**。

+# H6PI — 准备记录（仅准备，未提交任何计算）
+
+候选：(2E,4Z,6E)-2,4,6-辛三烯 热 6π 电环化 → cis-5,6-二甲基-1,3-环己二烯（meso）
+目录：`hard_replacements_20261001/H6PI/`
+状态：**PREPARATION ONLY — 没有提交任何 QM / xTB / CREST 作业。** 等监工资源与科学准备检查。
+上位方案：`hard_replacements_20261001/PLAN.md`（H6PI 候选条目）。
+
+---
+
+## 1. 授权范围与边界（严格遵守）
+
+- 只做**第一允许热闭环**（6π 对旋、协调、闭壳层单参考）。
+- **不**构造禁阻（MR/顺旋）对照，**不**探索 1,5-H 迁移，**不**纳入光化学、E/Z 异构化平衡。
+- 方法固定：ORCA 6.1.1，气相，B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP，RIJCOSX/def2-J，TightSCF。
+- 资源：8 CPU，`%maxcore 1536`（8×1536 = 12288 MB 建模内存；提交预留 14000 MB，见下）。
+- **不设** MaxIter，**不设** Cloudra timeout。
+- 未提交前不写正式题源/registry；替换须在真实 TS/IRC/0 虚频端点全部通过后生效。
+
+## 2. 体系身份
+
+| 项 | 值 |
+|---|---|
+| 分子式 | C8H12 |
+| 原子数 | 20（8 重原子 + 12 H） |
+| 电荷/自旋 | q = 0, m = 1 |
+| 反应物 | (2E,4Z,6E)-octa-2,4,6-triene |
+| 产物 | cis-5,6-dimethylcyclohexa-1,3-diene（meso） |
+
+## 3. 3D 立体与映射核对（本阶段核心，发现一处必须修正的草案缺陷）
+
+用 RDKit `AssignStereochemistryFrom3D` 从实际 3D 坐标独立读取立体（脚本见 `verification/`）。
+
+### 3.1 反应物 — 通过
+`reactant_seed.xyz` 三处双键 3D 读取为 **E, Z, E**（C2=C3 E，C4=C5 Z，C6=C7 E），与声明一致。链 C1–C2=C3–C4=C5–C6=C7–C8 连通正确，无异常键长/键角。
+
+### 3.2 产物 — **草案是 trans，不是 cis（缺陷）**
+- 声明产物 SMILES `[CH3:1][C@H:2]1[CH:3]=[CH:4][CH:5]=[CH:6][C@@H:7]1[CH3:8]`
+  经规范异构 SMILES + meso 反演检验，实际是**手性 trans 非对映体**（canon `C[C@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C`，(2S,7S)），**不是** meso。
+- 文件 `product_cis_seed.xyz` 的 3D 几何：两甲基 C1/C8 相对环平均面分居两侧（−0.738 / +0.738 Å）→ **trans**。
+- `GEOMETRY_PREPARATION.json` 声称的 CIP “S,R=cis/meso” 本身是**过期/错误赋值**，两者（SMILES 与 3D seed）实为同一 trans 物种。
+
+判定依据（图论、与嵌入无关）：meso 化合物对“两个手性中心同时反演”不变；cis(meso) 满足，trans(R,R/S,S) 不满足。
+三个立体异构体：cis-meso `C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C`；trans `C[C@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C` 及其镜像。
+
+### 3.3 修正后的 cis/meso 产物（本次准备使用）
+- SMILES（映射，供构建/映射用）：
+  `[CH3:1][C@@H:2]1[CH:3]=[CH:4][CH:5]=[CH:6][C@@H:7]1[CH3:8]`
+- 规范异构 SMILES：`C[C@@H]1C=CC=C[C@@H]1C`（meso）
+- CIP：(2R,7S)；环面侧检验两甲基同侧（−1.662 / −0.422 Å）→ **cis** ✔
+- 3D 重建文件：`ts_prep/product_cis.xyz`（`product_cis_correct.mol` 的干净 xyz，MMFF94 构建）。
+
+### 3.4 原子映射 / 原子顺序（反应物 vs 产物，一致）
+- 重原子按 map 升序：atom 1..8 = map 1..8（C1 甲基、C2..C7 环/链、C8 甲基）。
+- H 按重原子分组顺序追加：3×C1，随后 C2..C7 各 1，3×C8（两文件一致）。
+- ⇒ **全原子恒等映射 [1..20] 有效**，已用于插值。
+- 反应键变化（JSO 声明）：形成 C2–C7；C2=C3、C6=C7 → 单；C3–C4、C5–C6 → 双；C4=C5 → 单。
+
+## 4. 模型选择说明（为何气相、为何单参考）
+
+- 中性烃、无离子/两性离子/强电荷分离、无催化剂/水/质子网络 ⇒ 不触发“裸离子气相”红线，气相合理；文献为溶液实验，其活化参数**仅作背景**，不混入气相电子能 gold。

+- 6π 对旋的立体专一性由端点 E/Z 锁定；反应物为（手性中心意义上）非手性三烯，两种螺旋反应构象给出同一 meso 产物 ⇒ 任一反应构象都通向 **cis**。
+
+## 5. TS 策略 = 最低反应坐标方案
+
+**最低 RC：单坐标 = 成键 C2···C7 距离**（协调、同步闭环；无需第二坐标，因为 IDPP 路径显示两端键变化同步）。
+
+预组织构象（约束 MMFF，RDKit 后端；非 CREST/xTB）：
+- `ts_prep/reactant_cisoid_seed.xyz`：半椅状反应构象，C2···C7 = 3.526 Å，E/Z 保持 E,Z,E。
+- 引导：ring_order = 环原子 [2..7]，distance_filter C2···C7 ∈ [2.4,4.0] Å。
+
+同步性证据（IDPP 插值，12 帧，恒等映射）：
+```
+frame   C2-C7   C2-C3   C3-C4   C4-C5   C5-C6   C6-C7
+  0    3.526   1.341   1.446   1.343   1.446   1.341   (reactant cisoid)
+  6    2.388   1.427   1.380   1.393   1.385   1.427   (TS 候选)
+ 11    1.564   1.516   1.341   1.443   1.341   1.515   (cis 产物)
+```
+C2···C7 单调缩短，末端双键拉长、中间单键缩短，全程同步 ⇒ 协调 6π 闭环图像一致。
+- TS 初猜几何：`ts_prep/interp/img_06.xyz`（C2···C7 = 2.388 Å）。**几何初猜，非鞍点。**
+
+## 6. 已准备的实际输入（ORCA 6.1.1）
+

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+def build(smi, seed=0xf00d):
+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    assert m is not None, smi
+    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, ps)
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=2000)
+    return mh
+
+def plane_signs(mh, ref_idx, probe_pairs):
+    conf = mh.GetConformer()
+    P = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ref_idx])
+    c = P.mean(axis=0); U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(P-c); n = Vt[-1]
+    out={}
+    for name, idxs in probe_pairs.items():
+        q = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in idxs]).mean(axis=0)
+        out[name] = float(np.dot(q-c, n))
+    return out
+
+# ---- anchor: CID 2723766 = ENDO (Carbic anhydride) ----
+anchor = "C1[C@@H]2C=C[C@H]1[C@@H]3[C@H]2C(=O)OC3=O"
+m = build(anchor)
+for a in m.GetAtoms():
+    a.SetAtomMapNum(a.GetIdx()+1)   # so map = idx+1
+conf=m.GetConformer()
+# indices 0-based: 0=methano CH2, 1,4=bridgeheads, 2,3=alkene, 5,6=dienophile C, 7,10 carbonyl C, 9 ring O
+ref=[1,2,3,4,5,6]
+probes={"methano(0)":[0], "anhydride_O(9)":[9], "carbonylC_mid(7,10)":[7,10]}
+print("ANCHOR endo ref6ring plane, signed distances:", plane_signs(m, ref, probes))
+# also ref plane of just bridgeheads+dienophile C (2,4,6,7 => idx1,4,5,6)
+print("ANCHOR endo ref{1,4,5,6} plane:", plane_signs(m, [1,4,5,6], probes))
+# print SMILES of anchor
+print("anchor canonical:", Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
+
+# ---- HDA products (mapped) ----
+endo = "[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]"
+exo  = "[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]"
+for tag,smi in [("endoSMILES",endo),("exoSMILES",exo)]:
+    mm = build(smi)
+    idx = {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    ref = [idx[k] for k in (1,2,4,5,6,7)]
+    probes = {"methanoC3":[idx[3]], "CN_C8":[idx[8]], "N9":[idx[9]]}
+    print(tag, "ref6ring:", plane_signs(mm, ref, probes))
+    # CIP
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mm, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    cip = {a.GetAtomMapNum(): a.GetPropsAsDict().get('_CIPCode','-') for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    print("   CIP by map:", {k:cip[k] for k in sorted(cip) if cip[k]!='-'})

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+def build(smi, seed=0xf00d):
+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    assert m is not None, smi
+    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, ps)
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=2000)
+    return mh
+
+def plane_signs(mh, ref_idx, probe_pairs):
+    conf = mh.GetConformer()
+    P = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ref_idx])
+    c = P.mean(axis=0); U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(P-c); n = Vt[-1]
+    out={}
+    for name, idxs in probe_pairs.items():
+        q = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in idxs]).mean(axis=0)
+        out[name] = float(np.dot(q-c, n))
+    return out
+

+anchor = "C1[C@@H]2C=C[C@H]1[C@@H]3[C@H]2C(=O)OC3=O"
+m = build(anchor)
+for a in m.GetAtoms():
+    a.SetAtomMapNum(a.GetIdx()+1)   # so map = idx+1
+conf=m.GetConformer()

+print("ANCHOR endo ref{1,4,5,6} plane:", plane_signs(m, [1,4,5,6], probes))

+print("anchor canonical:", Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))

+endo = "[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]"
+exo  = "[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]"

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+mol = Chem.MolFromMolFile("hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/verification/pubchem_endo_6541030.sdf", removeHs=False)
+conf = mol.GetConformer()
+smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.Mol(mol))
+print("SMILES:", smi)
+
+# Build graph
+heavy = [a.GetIdx() for a in mol.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomicNum()>1]
+# identify ring atoms in bicyclo[2.2.1]: the 7 skeleton carbons
+ri = mol.GetRingInfo()
+rings = [set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()]
+print("rings:", rings)
+
+# skeleton carbons = carbons in the fused bicyclic system
+allring = set().union(*rings)
+Cs = [i for i in allring if mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6]
+print("skeleton carbons:", Cs, "count", len(Cs))
+
+# one-carbon bridge: carbon in allring with exactly 2 heavy neighbors both in allring and 2 H, and if it's between the two bridgeheads
+def nbrs(i): return [n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+
+# bridgeheads: ring carbons with 3 ring neighbors
+bridgeheads = [i for i in Cs if len([n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring])==3]
+print("bridgeheads:", bridgeheads)
+# one-carbon bridge: ring carbon with 2 ring neighbors that are the bridgeheads
+oneC = None
+for i in Cs:
+    if i in bridgeheads: continue
+    rn = [n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring]
+    if set(rn)==set(bridgeheads):
+        oneC = i
+print("one-carbon bridge (CH2):", oneC, "H count", sum(1 for n in nbrs(oneC) if mol.GetAtomWithIdx(n).GetAtomicNum()==1))
+
+# carboxy carbons: carbon with 2 O neighbors not in ring
+cooh = []
+for a in mol.GetAtoms():
+    if a.GetAtomicNum()!=6: continue
+    if a.GetIdx() in allring: continue
+    on = [n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors() if n.GetAtomicNum()==8]
+    if len(on)==2: cooh.append(a.GetIdx())
+print("carboxy C:", cooh)
+
+# substituent-bearing ring carbons (the ones bonded to cooh)
+sub_bearing = [n for c in cooh for n in nbrs(c) if n in allring]
+print("COOH-bearing ring carbons:", sub_bearing)
+
+# reference plane: bridgeheads + substituent-bearing carbons
+plane_atoms = list(bridgeheads)+list(sub_bearing)
+print("plane atoms:", plane_atoms)
+
+def plane_normal(pts):
+    p = np.array(pts, float); c = p.mean(0)
+    u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(p-c)
+    return vt[2], c
+pts = [conf.GetAtomPosition(i) for i in plane_atoms]
+n,c = plane_normal(pts)
+def sd(i):
+    return float(np.dot(np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(i))-c, n))
+print("signed dist plane(oneC bridge CH2) =", round(sd(oneC),3))
+for i in plane_atoms: print("  plane atom", i, "sd", round(sd(i),4))
+# COOH carbons
+for c in cooh:
+    print("COOH carbon", c, "sd", round(sd(c),3), "-> same side as CH2 bridge?" , (sd(c)*sd(oneC)>0))

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+mol = Chem.MolFromMolFile("hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/verification/pubchem_endo_6541030.sdf", removeHs=False)
+conf = mol.GetConformer()
+smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.Mol(mol))
+print("SMILES:", smi)
+
+# Build graph
+heavy = [a.GetIdx() for a in mol.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomicNum()>1]
+# identify ring atoms in bicyclo[2.2.1]: the 7 skeleton carbons
+ri = mol.GetRingInfo()
+rings = [set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()]
+print("rings:", rings)
+
+# skeleton carbons = carbons in the fused bicyclic system
+allring = set().union(*rings)
+Cs = [i for i in allring if mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6]
+print("skeleton carbons:", Cs, "count", len(Cs))
+
+# one-carbon bridge: carbon in allring with exactly 2 heavy neighbors both in allring and 2 H, and if it's between the two bridgeheads
+def nbrs(i): return [n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+
+# bridgeheads: ring carbons with 3 ring neighbors
+bridgeheads = [i for i in Cs if len([n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring])==3]
+print("bridgeheads:", bridgeheads)
+# one-carbon bridge: ring carbon with 2 ring neighbors that are the bridgeheads
+oneC = None
+for i in Cs:
+    if i in bridgeheads: continue
+    rn = [n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring]
+    if set(rn)==set(bridgeheads):
+        oneC = i
+print("one-carbon bridge (CH2):", oneC, "H count", sum(1 for n in nbrs(oneC) if mol.GetAtomWithIdx(n).GetAtomicNum()==1))
+
+# carboxy carbons: carbon with 2 O neighbors not in ring
+cooh = []
+for a in mol.GetAtoms():
+    if a.GetAtomicNum()!=6: continue
+    if a.GetIdx() in allring: continue
+    on = [n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors() if n.GetAtomicNum()==8]
+    if len(on)==2: cooh.append(a.GetIdx())
+print("carboxy C:", cooh)
+
+# substituent-bearing ring carbons (the ones bonded to cooh)
+sub_bearing = [n for c in cooh for n in nbrs(c) if n in allring]
+print("COOH-bearing ring carbons:", sub_bearing)
+
+# reference plane: bridgeheads + substituent-bearing carbons
+plane_atoms = list(bridgeheads)+list(sub_bearing)
+print("plane atoms:", plane_atoms)
+
+def plane_normal(pts):
+    p = np.array(pts, float); c = p.mean(0)
+    u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(p-c)
+    return vt[2], c
+pts = [conf.GetAtomPosition(i) for i in plane_atoms]
+n,c = plane_normal(pts)
+def sd(i):
+    return float(np.dot(np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(i))-c, n))
+print("signed dist plane(oneC bridge CH2) =", round(sd(oneC),3))
+for i in plane_atoms: print("  plane atom", i, "sd", round(sd(i),4))
+# COOH carbons
+for c in cooh:
+    print("COOH carbon", c, "sd", round(sd(c),3), "-> same side as CH2 bridge?" , (sd(c)*sd(oneC)>0))

+rings = [set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()]

+# skeleton carbons = carbons in the fused bicyclic system

+Cs = [i for i in allring if mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6]
+print("skeleton carbons:", Cs, "count", len(Cs))
+
+# one-carbon bridge: carbon in allring with exactly 2 heavy neighbors both in allring and 2 H, and if it's between the two bridgeheads
+def nbrs(i): return [n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+
+# bridgeheads: ring carbons with 3 ring neighbors
+bridgeheads = [i for i in Cs if len([n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring])==3]
+print("bridgeheads:", bridgeheads)
+# one-carbon bridge: ring carbon with 2 ring neighbors that are the bridgeheads
+oneC = None
+for i in Cs:
+    if i in bridgeheads: continue
+    rn = [n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring]
+    if set(rn)==set(bridgeheads):
+        oneC = i
+print("one-carbon bridge (CH2):", oneC, "H count", sum(1 for n in nbrs(oneC) if mol.GetAtomWithIdx(n).GetAtomicNum()==1))

+    on = [n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors() if n.GetAtomicNum()==8]

+

+    p = np.array(pts, float); c = p.mean(0)
+    u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(p-c)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np, json
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+CP  = "[CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH:4]=[CH:5]1"
+ACN = "[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"
+
+def embed(smi, seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps)==0
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000)
+    return mh
+
+def coords(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+
+def setcoords(m, X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
+
+def mapidx(m):
+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+
+def bestfit_plane_normal(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c, Vt[-1]
+
+cp = embed(CP); acn = embed(ACN)
+ci = mapidx(cp); ai = mapidx(acn)
+Xcp = coords(cp); Xacn = coords(acn)
+
+# --- align cyclopentadiene: ring plane -> z=0, C2..C4 along x, centered at origin ---
+ring = np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in (1,2,3,4,5)])
+cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(ring)
+# build frame: z = n ; x = (C4-C2) projected ; y = z cross x
+x = Xcp[ci[4]] - Xcp[ci[2]]; x = x - np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z = n; y = np.cross(z,x)
+R = np.vstack([x,y,z])   # rows
+mid = 0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]])
+Xcp2 = (Xcp - mid) @ R.T
+# now C2..C4 on x axis; make C2 negative x
+if Xcp2[ci[2],0] > Xcp2[ci[4],0]:
+    Xcp2[:,0]*=-1
+L = abs(Xcp2[ci[4],0]); print("CP C2..C4 half-length L=%.3f  dist=%.3f"%(L, 2*L))
+print("  C3 y after align = %+.3f (methano side)"%Xcp2[ci[3],1])
+
+# --- orient acrylonitrile: C6=C7 along x, plane normal z, place at height h ---
+# dienophile local plane = C6,C7,C8 (sp2 core). normal -> z; C6->C7 -> x
+core = np.array([Xacn[ai[6]], Xacn[ai[7]], Xacn[ai[8]]])
+cen2, n2 = bestfit_plane_normal(core)
+x2 = Xacn[ai[7]] - Xacn[ai[6]]; x2 = x2 - np.dot(x2,n2)*n2; x2/=np.linalg.norm(x2)
+z2 = n2; y2 = np.cross(z2,x2); R2=np.vstack([x2,y2,z2])
+Xa = (Xacn - 0.5*(Xacn[ai[6]]+Xacn[ai[7]])) @ R2.T
+
+def assemble(h, w, cn_sign, forming=None):
+    """place dienophile C6,C7 at (-w,h),( +w,h); CN (+y2 already) choose sign by mirroring y.
+       returns combined mol with coords."""
+    Xa2 = Xa.copy()
+    # center dienophile at its own C6,C7 midpoint already; GLOBAL x offset = 0, y=0, z=h
+    # dienophile local x-axis = C6->C7 ; we want C6 at -w, C7 at +w : scale to bond length then set
+    d67 = np.linalg.norm(Xa2[ai[7]]-Xa2[ai[6]])
+    Xa2[:,0] *= (2*w)/d67
+    Xa2[:,1] *= cn_sign
+    Xa2[:,2] += h
+    comb = Chem.CombineMols(Chem.RemoveHs(cp), Chem.RemoveHs(acn))  # heavy only
+    X = np.vstack([Xcp2, Xa2])
+    setcoords(comb, X)
+    return comb
+
+def mmff_relax(comb, pairs, target, force=100.0, iters=3000):
+    mm = Chem.AddHs(comb, addCoords=True)
+    props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mm); ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mm,props)
+    for (i,j) in pairs: ff.AddDistanceConstraint(i,j,target,target,force)
+    ff.Minimize(maxIts=iters)
+    return mm, ff.CalcEnergy()
+
+def signs(mh, ref_maps, mp, probes):
+    c=mh.GetConformer()
+    idx={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mh.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    P=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[k])) for k in ref_maps]); cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(P)
+    out={}
+    for name,keys in probes.items():
+        q=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[k])) for k in keys]).mean(0)
+        out[name]=float(np.dot(q-cen,n))
+    return out
+
+# Build RC (forming ~3.4) and TS guesses (forming ~2.25), both CN faces
+results={}
+for label, h, w, target in [("RC", 3.20, 0.67, 3.30), ("TS", 2.20, 0.72, 2.30)]:
+    for face, cs in [("cn_pos", +1.0), ("cn_neg", -1.0)]:
+        comb = assemble(h, w, cs)
+        mh, E = mmff_relax(comb, pairs=[(ci[2],ci[6]),(ci[4],ci[7])], target=target)
+        c=mh.GetConformer()
+        idx={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mh.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+        d26=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[2]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[6])))
+        d47=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[4]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[7])))
+        s=signs(mh,(1,2,4,5,6,7),None,{"C3":[3],"C8":[8],"N9":[9]})
+        verdict = "EXO(CN syn C3)" if np.sign(s["C3"])==np.sign(s["N9"]) else "ENDO(CN anti C3)"
+        print("%s %-7s  E=%8.3f  d(C2-C6)=%.3f d(C4-C7)=%.3f  | C3=%+.3f C8=%+.3f N9=%+.3f -> %s"%(
+              label,face,E,d26,d47,s["C3"],s["C8"],s["N9"],verdict))
+        results[(label,face)]=(mh,E,verdict,s)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np, json
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+CP  = "[CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH:4]=[CH:5]1"
+ACN = "[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"
+
+def embed(smi, seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps)==0
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000)
+    return mh
+
+def coords(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+
+def setcoords(m, X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
+
+def mapidx(m):
+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+
+def bestfit_plane_normal(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c, Vt[-1]
+
+cp = embed(CP); acn = embed(ACN)
+ci = mapidx(cp); ai = mapidx(acn)
+Xcp = coords(cp); Xacn = coords(acn)
+
+# --- align cyclopentadiene: ring plane -> z=0, C2..C4 along x, centered at origin ---
+ring = np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in (1,2,3,4,5)])
+cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(ring)
+# build frame: z = n ; x = (C4-C2) projected ; y = z cross x
+x = Xcp[ci[4]] - Xcp[ci[2]]; x = x - np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z = n; y = np.cross(z,x)
+R = np.vstack([x,y,z])   # rows
+mid = 0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]])
+Xcp2 = (Xcp - mid) @ R.T
+# now C2..C4 on x axis; make C2 negative x
+if Xcp2[ci[2],0] > Xcp2[ci[4],0]:
+    Xcp2[:,0]*=-1
+L = abs(Xcp2[ci[4],0]); print("CP C2..C4 half-length L=%.3f  dist=%.3f"%(L, 2*L))
+print("  C3 y after align = %+.3f (methano side)"%Xcp2[ci[3],1])
+
+# --- orient acrylonitrile: C6=C7 along x, plane normal z, place at height h ---
+# dienophile local plane = C6,C7,C8 (sp2 core). normal -> z; C6->C7 -> x
+core = np.array([Xacn[ai[6]], Xacn[ai[7]], Xacn[ai[8]]])
+cen2, n2 = bestfit_plane_normal(core)
+x2 = Xacn[ai[7]] - Xacn[ai[6]]; x2 = x2 - np.dot(x2,n2)*n2; x2/=np.linalg.norm(x2)
+z2 = n2; y2 = np.cross(z2,x2); R2=np.vstack([x2,y2,z2])
+Xa = (Xacn - 0.5*(Xacn[ai[6]]+Xacn[ai[7]])) @ R2.T
+
+def assemble(h, w, cn_sign, forming=None):
+    """place dienophile C6,C7 at (-w,h),( +w,h); CN (+y2 already) choose sign by mirroring y.
+       returns combined mol with coords."""
+    Xa2 = Xa.copy()
+    # center dienophile at its own C6,C7 midpoint already; GLOBAL x offset = 0, y=0, z=h
+    # dienophile local x-axis = C6->C7 ; we want C6 at -w, C7 at +w : scale to bond length then set
+    d67 = np.linalg.norm(Xa2[ai[7]]-Xa2[ai[6]])
+    Xa2[:,0] *= (2*w)/d67
+    Xa2[:,1] *= cn_sign
+    Xa2[:,2] += h
+    comb = Chem.CombineMols(Chem.RemoveHs(cp), Chem.RemoveHs(acn))  # heavy only
+    X = np.vstack([Xcp2, Xa2])
+    setcoords(comb, X)
+    return comb
+
+def mmff_relax(comb, map_pairs, target, force=100.0, iters=3000):
+    mm = Chem.AddHs(comb, addCoords=True)
+    mp = {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mm); ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mm,props)
+    for (i,j) in map_pairs: ff.AddDistanceConstraint(mp[i],mp[j],target,target,force)
+    ff.Minimize(maxIts=iters)
+    return mm, ff.CalcEnergy()
+
+def signs(mh, ref_maps, mp, probes):
+    c=mh.GetConformer()
+    idx={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mh.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    P=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[k])) for k in ref_maps]); cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(P)
+    out={}
+    for name,keys in probes.items():
+        q=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[k])) for k in keys]).mean(0)
+        out[name]=float(np.dot(q-cen,n))
+    return out
+
+# Build RC (forming ~3.4) and TS guesses (forming ~2.25), both CN faces
+results={}
+for label, h, w, target in [("RC", 3.20, 0.67, 3.30), ("TS", 2.20, 0.72, 2.30)]:
+    for face, cs in [("cn_pos", +1.0), ("cn_neg", -1.0)]:
+        comb = assemble(h, w, cs)
+        mh, E = mmff_relax(comb, pairs=[(ci[2],ci[6]),(ci[4],ci[7])], target=target)
+        c=mh.GetConformer()
+        idx={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mh.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+        d26=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[2]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[6])))
+        d47=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[4]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[7])))
+        s=signs(mh,(1,2,4,5,6,7),None,{"C3":[3],"C8":[8],"N9":[9]})
+        verdict = "EXO(CN syn C3)" if np.sign(s["C3"])==np.sign(s["N9"]) else "ENDO(CN anti C3)"
+        print("%s %-7s  E=%8.3f  d(C2-C6)=%.3f d(C4-C7)=%.3f  | C3=%+.3f C8=%+.3f N9=%+.3f -> %s"%(
+              label,face,E,d26,d47,s["C3"],s["C8"],s["N9"],verdict))
+        results[(label,face)]=(mh,E,verdict,s)
"}

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np, json
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+CP  = "[CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH:4]=[CH:5]1"
+ACN = "[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"
+
+def embed(smi, seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps)==0
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000)
+    return mh
+
+def coords(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+
+def setcoords(m, X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
+
+def mapidx(m):
+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+
+def bestfit_plane_normal(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c, Vt[-1]
+
+cp = embed(CP); acn = embed(ACN)
+ci = mapidx(cp); ai = mapidx(acn)
+Xcp = coords(cp); Xacn = coords(acn)
+
+# --- align cyclopentadiene: ring plane -> z=0, C2..C4 along x, centered at origin ---
+ring = np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in (1,2,3,4,5)])
+cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(ring)
+# build frame: z = n ; x = (C4-C2) projected ; y = z cross x
+x = Xcp[ci[4]] - Xcp[ci[2]]; x = x - np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z = n; y = np.cross(z,x)
+R = np.vstack([x,y,z])   # rows
+mid = 0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]])
+Xcp2 = (Xcp - mid) @ R.T
+# now C2..C4 on x axis; make C2 negative x
+if Xcp2[ci[2],0] > Xcp2[ci[4],0]:
+    Xcp2[:,0]*=-1
+L = abs(Xcp2[ci[4],0]); print("CP C2..C4 half-length L=%.3f  dist=%.3f"%(L, 2*L))
+print("  C3 y after align = %+.3f (methano side)"%Xcp2[ci[3],1])
+
+# --- orient acrylonitrile: C6=C7 along x, plane normal z, place at height h ---
+# dienophile local plane = C6,C7,C8 (sp2 core). normal -> z; C6->C7 -> x
+core = np.array([Xacn[ai[6]], Xacn[ai[7]], Xacn[ai[8]]])
+cen2, n2 = bestfit_plane_normal(core)
+x2 = Xacn[ai[7]] - Xacn[ai[6]]; x2 = x2 - np.dot(x2,n2)*n2; x2/=np.linalg.norm(x2)
+z2 = n2; y2 = np.cross(z2,x2); R2=np.vstack([x2,y2,z2])
+Xa = (Xacn - 0.5*(Xacn[ai[6]]+Xacn[ai[7]])) @ R2.T
+
+def assemble(h, w, cn_sign, forming=None):
+    """place dienophile C6,C7 at (-w,h),( +w,h); CN (+y2 already) choose sign by mirroring y.
+       returns combined mol with coords."""
+    Xa2 = Xa.copy()
+    # center dienophile at its own C6,C7 midpoint already; GLOBAL x offset = 0, y=0, z=h
+    # dienophile local x-axis = C6->C7 ; we want C6 at -w, C7 at +w : scale to bond length then set
+    d67 = np.linalg.norm(Xa2[ai[7]]-Xa2[ai[6]])
+    Xa2[:,0] *= (2*w)/d67
+    Xa2[:,1] *= cn_sign
+    Xa2[:,2] += h
+    comb = Chem.CombineMols(Chem.RemoveHs(cp), Chem.RemoveHs(acn))  # heavy only
+    X = np.vstack([Xcp2, Xa2])
+    setcoords(comb, X)
+    return comb
+
+def mmff_relax(comb, map_pairs, target, force=100.0, iters=3000):
+    mm = Chem.AddHs(comb, addCoords=True)
+    mp = {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mm); ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mm,props)
+    for (i,j) in map_pairs: ff.AddDistanceConstraint(mp[i],mp[j],target,target,force)
+    ff.Minimize(maxIts=iters)
+    return mm, ff.CalcEnergy()
+
+def signs(mh, ref_maps, mp, probes):
+    c=mh.GetConformer()
+    idx={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mh.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    P=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[k])) for k in ref_maps]); cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(P)
+    out={}
+    for name,keys in probes.items():
+        q=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[k])) for k in keys]).mean(0)
+        out[name]=float(np.dot(q-cen,n))
+    return out
+
+# Build RC (forming ~3.4) and TS guesses (forming ~2.25), both CN faces
+results={}
+for label, h, w, target in [("RC", 3.20, 0.67, 3.30), ("TS", 2.20, 0.72, 2.30)]:
+    for face, cs in [("cn_pos", +1.0), ("cn_neg", -1.0)]:
+        comb = assemble(h, w, cs)
+        mh, E = mmff_relax(comb, map_pairs=[(2,6),(4,7)], target=target)
+        c=mh.GetConformer()
+        idx={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mh.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+        d26=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[2]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[6])))
+        d47=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[4]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[7])))
+        s=signs(mh,(1,2,4,5,6,7),None,{"C3":[3],"C8":[8],"N9":[9]})
+        verdict = "EXO(CN syn C3)" if np.sign(s["C3"])==np.sign(s["N9"]) else "ENDO(CN anti C3)"
+        print("%s %-7s  E=%8.3f  d(C2-C6)=%.3f d(C4-C7)=%.3f  | C3=%+.3f C8=%+.3f N9=%+.3f -> %s"%(
+              label,face,E,d26,d47,s["C3"],s["C8"],s["N9"],verdict))
+        results[(label,face)]=(mh,E,verdict,s)
"}

+ACN = "[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"
+
+def embed(smi, seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed

+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000)
+    return mh
+
+def coords(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+
+def setcoords(m, X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
+
+def mapidx(m):
+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+
+def bestfit_plane_normal(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c, Vt[-1]
+
+cp = embed(CP); acn = embed(ACN)
+ci = mapidx(cp); ai = mapidx(acn)
+Xcp = coords(cp); Xacn = coords(acn)
+
+# --- align cyclopentadiene: ring plane -> z=0, C2..C4 along x, centered at origin ---
+ring = np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in (1,2,3,4,5)])
+cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(ring)
+# build frame: z = n ; x = (C4-C2) projected ; y = z cross x
+x = Xcp[ci[4]] - Xcp[ci[2]]; x = x - np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z = n; y = np.cross(z,x)
+R = np.vstack([x,y,z])   # rows
+mid = 0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]])
+Xcp2 = (Xcp - mid) @ R.T
+# now C2..C4 on x axis; make C2 negative x
+if Xcp2[ci[2],0] > Xcp2[ci[4],0]:
+    Xcp2[:,0]*=-1
+L = abs(Xcp2[ci[4],0]); print("CP C2..C4 half-length L=%.3f  dist=%.3f"%(L, 2*L))
+print("  C3 y after align = %+.3f (methano side)"%Xcp2[ci[3],1])
+
+# --- orient acrylonitrile: C6=C7 along x, plane normal z, place at height h ---
+# dienophile local plane = C6,C7,C8 (sp2 core). normal -> z; C6->C7 -> x
+core = np.array([Xacn[ai[6]], Xacn[ai[7]], Xacn[ai[8]]])
+cen2, n2 = bestfit_plane_normal(core)
+x2 = Xacn[ai[7]] - Xacn[ai[6]]; x2 = x2 - np.dot(x2,n2)*n2; x2/=np.linalg.norm(x2)
+z2 = n2; y2 = np.cross(z2,x2); R2=np.vstack([x2,y2,z2])
+Xa = (Xacn - 0.5*(Xacn[ai[6]]+Xacn[ai[7]])) @ R2.T
+
+def assemble(h, w, cn_sign, forming=None):

+    Xa2 = Xa.copy()
+    # center dienophile at its own C6,C7 midpoint already; GLOBAL x offset = 0, y=0, z=h
+    # dienophile local x-axis = C6->C7 ; we want C6 at -w, C7 at +w : scale to bond length then set
+    d67 = np.linalg.norm(Xa2[ai[7]]-Xa2[ai[6]])
+    Xa2[:,0] *= (2*w)/d67
+    Xa2[:,1] *= cn_sign

+    X = np.vstack([Xcp2, Xa2])
+    setcoords(comb, X)

+    props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mm); ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mm,props)

+    ff.Minimize(maxIts=iters)

+import numpy as np
