+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np, json
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+CP  = "[CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH:4]=[CH:5]1"
+ACN = "[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"
+
+def embed(smi, seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps)==0
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000)
+    return mh
+
+def coords(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+
+def setcoords(m, X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
+
+def mapidx(m):
+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+
+def bestfit_plane_normal(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c, Vt[-1]
+
+cp = embed(CP); acn = embed(ACN)
+ci = mapidx(cp); ai = mapidx(acn)
+Xcp = coords(cp); Xacn = coords(acn)
+
+# --- align cyclopentadiene: ring plane -> z=0, C2..C4 along x, centered at origin ---
+ring = np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in (1,2,3,4,5)])
+cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(ring)
+# build frame: z = n ; x = (C4-C2) projected ; y = z cross x
+x = Xcp[ci[4]] - Xcp[ci[2]]; x = x - np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z = n; y = np.cross(z,x)
+R = np.vstack([x,y,z])   # rows
+mid = 0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]])
+Xcp2 = (Xcp - mid) @ R.T
+# now C2..C4 on x axis; make C2 negative x
+if Xcp2[ci[2],0] > Xcp2[ci[4],0]:
+    Xcp2[:,0]*=-1
+L = abs(Xcp2[ci[4],0]); print("CP C2..C4 half-length L=%.3f  dist=%.3f"%(L, 2*L))
+print("  C3 y after align = %+.3f (methano side)"%Xcp2[ci[3],1])
+
+# --- orient acrylonitrile: C6=C7 along x, plane normal z, place at height h ---
+# dienophile local plane = C6,C7,C8 (sp2 core). normal -> z; C6->C7 -> x
+core = np.array([Xacn[ai[6]], Xacn[ai[7]], Xacn[ai[8]]])
+cen2, n2 = bestfit_plane_normal(core)
+x2 = Xacn[ai[7]] - Xacn[ai[6]]; x2 = x2 - np.dot(x2,n2)*n2; x2/=np.linalg.norm(x2)
+z2 = n2; y2 = np.cross(z2,x2); R2=np.vstack([x2,y2,z2])
+Xa = (Xacn - 0.5*(Xacn[ai[6]]+Xacn[ai[7]])) @ R2.T
+
+def assemble(h, w, cn_sign, forming=None):
+    """place dienophile C6,C7 at (-w,h),( +w,h); CN (+y2 already) choose sign by mirroring y.
+       returns combined mol with coords."""
+    Xa2 = Xa.copy()
+    # center dienophile at its own C6,C7 midpoint already; GLOBAL x offset = 0, y=0, z=h
+    # dienophile local x-axis = C6->C7 ; we want C6 at -w, C7 at +w : scale to bond length then set
+    d67 = np.linalg.norm(Xa2[ai[7]]-Xa2[ai[6]])
+    Xa2[:,0] *= (2*w)/d67
+    Xa2[:,1] *= cn_sign
+    Xa2[:,2] += h
+    comb = Chem.CombineMols(Chem.RemoveHs(cp), Chem.RemoveHs(acn))  # heavy only
+    X = np.vstack([Xcp2, Xa2])
+    setcoords(comb, X)
+    return comb
+
+def mmff_relax(comb, map_pairs, target, force=100.0, iters=3000):
+    mm = Chem.AddHs(comb, addCoords=True)
+    Chem.SanitizeMol(mm); Chem.FastFindRings(mm)
+    mp = {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mm); ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mm,props)
+    for (i,j) in map_pairs: ff.AddDistanceConstraint(mp[i],mp[j],target,target,force)
+    ff.Minimize(maxIts=iters)
+    return mm, ff.CalcEnergy()
+
+def signs(mh, ref_maps, mp, probes):
+    c=mh.GetConformer()
+    idx={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mh.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    P=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[k])) for k in ref_maps]); cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(P)
+    out={}
+    for name,keys in probes.items():
+        q=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[k])) for k in keys]).mean(0)
+        out[name]=float(np.dot(q-cen,n))

+import numpy as np

+
+def bridges(mol, allring):
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    Cs=[i for i in allring if isC(i)]
+    bh=[i for i in Cs if len([n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring])==3]
+    # one-carbon bridge
+    oneC=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and set(n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring)==set(bh)][0]
+    # two-carbon bridges: pairs of ring carbons each bonded to one bridgehead
+    # find non-bridgehead, non-oneC ring carbons
+    rest=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and i!=oneC]
+    # group them into bridges: two carbons connected and each to a different bridgehead
+    return bh, oneC, rest
+
+def analyze(path,label):
+    mol=Chem.MolFromMolFile(path, removeHs=False)
+    conf=mol.GetConformer()
+    xyz={i:np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)),dtype=float) for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms())}
+    ri=mol.GetRingInfo(); allring=set().union(*[set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()])
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    bh,oneC,rest=bridges(mol,allring)
+    # substituent-bearing ring carbons (bonded to non-ring C)
+    bearing=[i for i in allring if isC(i) and any(n not in allring and isC(n) for n in nbrs(i))]
+    subst=[n for i in bearing for n in nbrs(i) if n not in allring and isC(n)]
+    # other 2-carbon bridge: rest minus bearing
+    other=[i for i in rest if i not in bearing]
+    # plane: choose bridgeheads + (bearing if >=2 bearing else other)
+    base_atoms = list(bh)+ (list(bearing) if len(bearing)>=2 else list(other))
+    P=np.array([xyz[i] for i in base_atoms]); cc=P.mean(0); n=np.linalg.svd(P-cc)[2][2]
+    sd=lambda i: float(np.dot(xyz[i]-cc,n))

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+mol = Chem.MolFromMolFile("hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/verification/pubchem_endo_6541030.sdf", removeHs=False)
+conf = mol.GetConformer()
+smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.Mol(mol))
+print("SMILES:", smi)
+
+# Build graph
+heavy = [a.GetIdx() for a in mol.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomicNum()>1]
+# identify ring atoms in bicyclo[2.2.1]: the 7 skeleton carbons
+ri = mol.GetRingInfo()
+rings = [set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()]
+print("rings:", rings)
+
+# skeleton carbons = carbons in the fused bicyclic system
+allring = set().union(*rings)
+Cs = [i for i in allring if mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6]
+print("skeleton carbons:", Cs, "count", len(Cs))
+
+# one-carbon bridge: carbon in allring with exactly 2 heavy neighbors both in allring and 2 H, and if it's between the two bridgeheads
+def nbrs(i): return [n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+
+# bridgeheads: ring carbons with 3 ring neighbors
+bridgeheads = [i for i in Cs if len([n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring])==3]
+print("bridgeheads:", bridgeheads)
+# one-carbon bridge: ring carbon with 2 ring neighbors that are the bridgeheads
+oneC = None
+for i in Cs:
+    if i in bridgeheads: continue
+    rn = [n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring]
+    if set(rn)==set(bridgeheads):
+        oneC = i
+print("one-carbon bridge (CH2):", oneC, "H count", sum(1 for n in nbrs(oneC) if mol.GetAtomWithIdx(n).GetAtomicNum()==1))
+
+# carboxy carbons: carbon with 2 O neighbors not in ring
+cooh = []
+for a in mol.GetAtoms():
+    if a.GetAtomicNum()!=6: continue
+    if a.GetIdx() in allring: continue
+    on = [n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors() if n.GetAtomicNum()==8]
+    if len(on)==2: cooh.append(a.GetIdx())
+print("carboxy C:", cooh)
+
+# substituent-bearing ring carbons (the ones bonded to cooh)
+sub_bearing = [n for c in cooh for n in nbrs(c) if n in allring]
+print("COOH-bearing ring carbons:", sub_bearing)
+
+# reference plane: bridgeheads + substituent-bearing carbons
+plane_atoms = list(bridgeheads)+list(sub_bearing)
+print("plane atoms:", plane_atoms)
+
+def plane_normal(pts):
+    p = np.array(pts, float); c = p.mean(0)
+    u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(p-c)
+    return vt[2], c
+pts = [conf.GetAtomPosition(i) for i in plane_atoms]
+n,c = plane_normal(pts)
+def sd(i):
+    return float(np.dot(np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(i))-c, n))
+print("signed dist plane(oneC bridge CH2) =", round(sd(oneC),3))
+for i in plane_atoms: print("  plane atom", i, "sd", round(sd(i),4))
+# COOH carbons
+for c in cooh:
+    print("COOH carbon", c, "sd", round(sd(c),3), "-> same side as CH2 bridge?" , (sd(c)*sd(oneC)>0))

+# HDA_CN — Preparation record (cyclopentadiene + acrylonitrile endo/exo Diels–Alder)
+
+**Status: PREPARED ONLY — no QM/xTB submitted.** Deliverable for supervisor resource/scientific review.
+Supersedes the earlier draft mapping in this directory; the *seed* files `product_{endo,exo}_seed.*`
+are retained unchanged but are **mis-labelled (swapped)** — see §2.
+
+## 1. Target and scope
+- Reaction: cyclopentadiene (CP) + acrylonitrile (ACN), concerted Diels–Alder.
+- System: **C8H9N, 9 heavy atoms, 18 atoms, q=0, m=1**; CP is a rigid (s-cis-locked) diene.
+- Goal: locate the **endo** and **exo** concerted DA transition states in the gas phase at one
+  method, and report both barriers (difference from the calculation, **not** pre-set).
+- Source (literature background only, DOI 10.1021/jo400900x, J. Org. Chem. 2013, 78, 6582;
+  PMC3731169): in CP+ACN the concerted DA is preferred over the stepwise diradical by ≈5.9 kcal/mol;
+  endo and exo TS are **essentially isoenergetic**, exo marginally lower (B3LYP/6-31G(d)).
+  We do **not** fit to these numbers and we add **no** new range (no diradical / polymerization
+  pathway in this candidate).
+- Method (fixed by task): **ORCA 6.1.1, B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP RIJCOSX def2/J TightSCF, gas phase**,
+  8 CPU / 14000 MB / maxcore 1536; software-native defaults — **no MaxIter, no Cloudra timeout**.
+
+## 2. Atom mapping and the endo/exo correction (independently verified)
+
+Heavy atoms are listed **by map ascending** in every file (then H's, grouped by their heavy parent).
+
+| map | atom | role |
+|----|------|------|
+| 1,2,4,5 | C | cyclopentadiene ring |
+| 3 | C | **one-carbon (methano) bridge**, CH2 |
+| 6,7 | C | dienophile C=C (from ACN) |
+| 8 | C | nitrile C |
+| 9 | N | nitrile N |
+
+Bond changes: **C2–C6 and C4–C7 form**; C1=C2 and C4=C5 become single; **C1–C5 becomes the new C=C**;
+C6=C7 becomes single. (C1,C5 = diene central carbons; C2,C4 = diene termini.)
+
+**Verification of the endo/exo labels.** The pre-existing draft defined "same side of the
+C2/C4/C6/C7 plane as bridge C3 = endo". I tested this against two *stereo-defined* PubChem
+anchors that are exact structural analogs (substituent on the dienophile-derived bridge):
+
+| anchor (PubChem) | label | measured (substituent vs methano bridge C3) |
+|---|---|---|
+| Carbic anhydride, *cis*-5-norbornene-**endo**-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (CID 2723766) | **endo** | **opposite** side to C3 |
+| *exo*-5-norbornene-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (name lookup) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+| Carbic acid, *endo*-norbornene-*cis*-5,6-dicarboxylic acid (CID 6541030) | **endo** | **opposite** side to C3 |
+| *exo*-5-norbornene-2-carboxylic acid (CID 12268635) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+| *exo*-norbornene-2-carboxylic acid, enantiomer (CID 721733) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+
+Five stereo-defined PubChem references agree, and the result is robust across two independent
+reference planes (6-membered ring {1,2,4,5,6,7} and bridgehead+dienophile {2,4,6,7}).
+The parallel `verification/` effort in this directory (scripts + SDFs) independently reproduced
+the same rule.
+
+> **Convention (verified): exo = the dienophile substituent is on the SAME side as the one-carbon
+> (methano) bridge C3; endo = OPPOSITE side of C3 (same side as the new alkene C1=C5).**
+
+Applied to the two DA diastereomers:
+
+| diastereomer | mapped SMILES | CIP (C2,C4,C7) | CN vs C3 |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| **endo** | `[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]` | **(2S,4S,7R)** | anti |
+| **exo**  | `[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]`  | **(2S,4S,7S)** | syn |
+
+⇒ **The earlier draft was swapped**: its "endo" (C7 = S) is the true **exo**; its "exo" (C7 = R) is
+the true **endo**. The pre-existing `product_*_seed.xyz/.inp` are therefore left untouched but are
+**not to be used**; correct structures are in `orca_inputs/product_endo.xyz` / `product_exo.xyz`.
+
+## 3. Common reactive complex (unified reference for both faces)
+- File: `orca_inputs/rc_common.xyz` (MMFF94s encounter complex; CP + ACN stacked, diene plane ⊥ approach).
+- d(C2···C6) = d(C4···C7) = **3.189 Å**; dienophile C6=C7 = 1.339 Å (intact); 2 fragments, no anomalies.
+- The endo-precursor and exo-precursor complexes (CN on either face) are **symmetry-degenerate**

+| `ts_exo_guess.xyz` | exo  | 2.225 Å | 2.225 Å | 1.440 Å | syn to C3 |
+
+Each is a planar diene/dienophile DA arrangement (dienophile parallel to the diene, CN in the diene plane).
+MMFF energies (both guesses) differ as expected; **no energy of these guesses is evidence**.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+def build(smi, seed=0xf00d):
+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); assert m is not None, smi
+    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, ps)==0, "embed failed "+smi
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=3000)
+    return mh
+
+def signs(mh, ref_idx, probes):
+    conf=mh.GetConformer()
+    P=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ref_idx])
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); n=Vt[-1]
+    return {k: float(np.dot(np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in v]).mean(0)-c, n)) for k,v in probes.items()}

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem

+
+def build(smi, seed=0xf00d):
+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    assert m is not None, smi
+    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, ps)
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=2000)
+    return mh
+
+def plane_signs(mh, ref_idx, probe_pairs):
+    conf = mh.GetConformer()
+    P = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ref_idx])
+    c = P.mean(axis=0); U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(P-c); n = Vt[-1]
+    out={}
+    for name, idxs in probe_pairs.items():
+        q = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in idxs]).mean(axis=0)
+        out[name] = float(np.dot(q-c, n))
+    return out
+

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np, json
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+CP  = "[CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH:4]=[CH:5]1"
+ACN = "[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"
+
+def embed(smi, seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps)==0
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000)
+    return mh
+
+def coords(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+
+def setcoords(m, X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
+
+def mapidx(m):
+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+
+def bestfit_plane_normal(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c, Vt[-1]
+
+cp = embed(CP); acn = embed(ACN)
+ci = mapidx(cp); ai = mapidx(acn)
+Xcp = coords(cp); Xacn = coords(acn)
+
+# --- align cyclopentadiene: ring plane -> z=0, C2..C4 along x, centered at origin ---
+ring = np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in (1,2,3,4,5)])
+cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(ring)
+# build frame: z = n ; x = (C4-C2) projected ; y = z cross x
+x = Xcp[ci[4]] - Xcp[ci[2]]; x = x - np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z = n; y = np.cross(z,x)
+R = np.vstack([x,y,z])   # rows
+mid = 0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]])
+Xcp2 = (Xcp - mid) @ R.T
+# now C2..C4 on x axis; make C2 negative x
+if Xcp2[ci[2],0] > Xcp2[ci[4],0]:
+    Xcp2[:,0]*=-1
+L = abs(Xcp2[ci[4],0]); print("CP C2..C4 half-length L=%.3f  dist=%.3f"%(L, 2*L))
+print("  C3 y after align = %+.3f (methano side)"%Xcp2[ci[3],1])
+
+# --- orient acrylonitrile: C6=C7 along x, plane normal z, place at height h ---
+# dienophile local plane = C6,C7,C8 (sp2 core). normal -> z; C6->C7 -> x
+core = np.array([Xacn[ai[6]], Xacn[ai[7]], Xacn[ai[8]]])
+cen2, n2 = bestfit_plane_normal(core)
+x2 = Xacn[ai[7]] - Xacn[ai[6]]; x2 = x2 - np.dot(x2,n2)*n2; x2/=np.linalg.norm(x2)
+z2 = n2; y2 = np.cross(z2,x2); R2=np.vstack([x2,y2,z2])
+Xa = (Xacn - 0.5*(Xacn[ai[6]]+Xacn[ai[7]])) @ R2.T
+
+def assemble(h, w, cn_sign, forming=None):
+    """place dienophile C6,C7 at (-w,h),( +w,h); CN (+y2 already) choose sign by mirroring y.
+       returns combined mol with coords."""
+    Xa2 = Xa.copy()
+    # center dienophile at its own C6,C7 midpoint already; GLOBAL x offset = 0, y=0, z=h
+    # dienophile local x-axis = C6->C7 ; we want C6 at -w, C7 at +w : scale to bond length then set
+    d67 = np.linalg.norm(Xa2[ai[7]]-Xa2[ai[6]])

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+
+def bridges(mol, allring):
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    Cs=[i for i in allring if isC(i)]
+    bh=[i for i in Cs if len([n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring])==3]
+    # one-carbon bridge
+    oneC=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and set(n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring)==set(bh)][0]
+    # two-carbon bridges: pairs of ring carbons each bonded to one bridgehead
+    # find non-bridgehead, non-oneC ring carbons
+    rest=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and i!=oneC]
+    # group them into bridges: two carbons connected and each to a different bridgehead
+    return bh, oneC, rest
+
+def analyze(path,label):
+    mol=Chem.MolFromMolFile(path, removeHs=False)
+    conf=mol.GetConformer()
+    xyz={i:np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)),dtype=float) for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms())}
+    ri=mol.GetRingInfo(); allring=set().union(*[set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()])
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    bh,oneC,rest=bridges(mol,allring)
+    # substituent-bearing ring carbons (bonded to non-ring C)
+    bearing=[i for i in allring if isC(i) and any(n not in allring and isC(n) for n in nbrs(i))]
+    subst=[n for i in bearing for n in nbrs(i) if n not in allring and isC(n)]
+    # other 2-carbon bridge: rest minus bearing
+    other=[i for i in rest if i not in bearing]
+    # plane: choose bridgeheads + (bearing if >=2 bearing else other)
+    base_atoms = list(bh)+ (list(bearing) if len(bearing)>=2 else list(other))
+    P=np.array([xyz[i] for i in base_atoms]); cc=P.mean(0); n=np.linalg.svd(P-cc)[2][2]
+    sd=lambda i: float(np.dot(xyz[i]-cc,n))
+    print("%-20s bh=%s CH2=%d bearing=%s subst=%s plane_atoms=%s sd(CH2)=%+.2f substsd=%s -> %s"%(
+        label,bh,oneC,bearing,subst,base_atoms,sd(oneC),[round(sd(i),2) for i in subst],
+        ["SAME" if sd(i)*sd(oneC)>0 else "OPP" for i in subst]))

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+mol = Chem.MolFromMolFile("hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/verification/pubchem_endo_6541030.sdf", removeHs=False)
+conf = mol.GetConformer()
+smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.Mol(mol))
+print("SMILES:", smi)
+
+# Build graph
+heavy = [a.GetIdx() for a in mol.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomicNum()>1]
+# identify ring atoms in bicyclo[2.2.1]: the 7 skeleton carbons
+ri = mol.GetRingInfo()
+rings = [set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()]
+print("rings:", rings)
+
+# skeleton carbons = carbons in the fused bicyclic system
+allring = set().union(*rings)
+Cs = [i for i in allring if mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6]
+print("skeleton carbons:", Cs, "count", len(Cs))
+
+# one-carbon bridge: carbon in allring with exactly 2 heavy neighbors both in allring and 2 H, and if it's between the two bridgeheads
+def nbrs(i): return [n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+
+# bridgeheads: ring carbons with 3 ring neighbors
+bridgeheads = [i for i in Cs if len([n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring])==3]
+print("bridgeheads:", bridgeheads)
+# one-carbon bridge: ring carbon with 2 ring neighbors that are the bridgeheads
+oneC = None
+for i in Cs:
+    if i in bridgeheads: continue
+    rn = [n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring]
+    if set(rn)==set(bridgeheads):
+        oneC = i
+print("one-carbon bridge (CH2):", oneC, "H count", sum(1 for n in nbrs(oneC) if mol.GetAtomWithIdx(n).GetAtomicNum()==1))
+
+# carboxy carbons: carbon with 2 O neighbors not in ring
+cooh = []
+for a in mol.GetAtoms():
+    if a.GetAtomicNum()!=6: continue
+    if a.GetIdx() in allring: continue
+    on = [n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors() if n.GetAtomicNum()==8]
+    if len(on)==2: cooh.append(a.GetIdx())
+print("carboxy C:", cooh)
+
+# substituent-bearing ring carbons (the ones bonded to cooh)
+sub_bearing = [n for c in cooh for n in nbrs(c) if n in allring]
+print("COOH-bearing ring carbons:", sub_bearing)
+
+# reference plane: bridgeheads + substituent-bearing carbons
+plane_atoms = list(bridgeheads)+list(sub_bearing)
+print("plane atoms:", plane_atoms)
+
+def plane_normal(pts):
+    p = np.array(pts, float); c = p.mean(0)
+    u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(p-c)
+    return vt[2], c
+pts = [conf.GetAtomPosition(i) for i in plane_atoms]
+n,c = plane_normal(pts)
+def sd(i):
+    return float(np.dot(np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(i))-c, n))
+print("signed dist plane(oneC bridge CH2) =", round(sd(oneC),3))
+for i in plane_atoms: print("  plane atom", i, "sd", round(sd(i),4))
+# COOH carbons
+for c in cooh:
+    print("COOH carbon", c, "sd", round(sd(c),3), "-> same side as CH2 bridge?" , (sd(c)*sd(oneC)>0))

+# HDA_CN — Preparation record (cyclopentadiene + acrylonitrile endo/exo Diels–Alder)
+
+**Status: PREPARED ONLY — no QM/xTB submitted.** Deliverable for supervisor resource/scientific review.
+Supersedes the earlier draft mapping in this directory; the *seed* files `product_{endo,exo}_seed.*`
+are retained unchanged but are **mis-labelled (swapped)** — see §2.
+
+## 1. Target and scope
+- Reaction: cyclopentadiene (CP) + acrylonitrile (ACN), concerted Diels–Alder.
+- System: **C8H9N, 9 heavy atoms, 18 atoms, q=0, m=1**; CP is a rigid (s-cis-locked) diene.
+- Goal: locate the **endo** and **exo** concerted DA transition states in the gas phase at one
+  method, and report both barriers (difference from the calculation, **not** pre-set).
+- Source (literature background only, DOI 10.1021/jo400900x, J. Org. Chem. 2013, 78, 6582;
+  PMC3731169): in CP+ACN the concerted DA is preferred over the stepwise diradical by ≈5.9 kcal/mol;
+  endo and exo TS are **essentially isoenergetic**, exo marginally lower (B3LYP/6-31G(d)).
+  We do **not** fit to these numbers and we add **no** new range (no diradical / polymerization
+  pathway in this candidate).
+- Method (fixed by task): **ORCA 6.1.1, B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP RIJCOSX def2/J TightSCF, gas phase**,
+  8 CPU / 14000 MB / maxcore 1536; software-native defaults — **no MaxIter, no Cloudra timeout**.
+
+## 2. Atom mapping and the endo/exo correction (independently verified)
+
+Heavy atoms are listed **by map ascending** in every file (then H's, grouped by their heavy parent).
+
+| map | atom | role |
+|----|------|------|
+| 1,2,4,5 | C | cyclopentadiene ring |
+| 3 | C | **one-carbon (methano) bridge**, CH2 |
+| 6,7 | C | dienophile C=C (from ACN) |
+| 8 | C | nitrile C |
+| 9 | N | nitrile N |
+
+Bond changes: **C2–C6 and C4–C7 form**; C1=C2 and C4=C5 become single; **C1–C5 becomes the new C=C**;
+C6=C7 becomes single. (C1,C5 = diene central carbons; C2,C4 = diene termini.)
+
+**Verification of the endo/exo labels.** The pre-existing draft defined "same side of the
+C2/C4/C6/C7 plane as bridge C3 = endo". I tested this against five *stereo-defined* PubChem
+anchors that are exact structural analogs (substituent on the dienophile-derived bridge):
+
+| anchor (PubChem) | label | measured (substituent vs methano bridge C3) |
+|---|---|---|
+| Carbic anhydride, *cis*-5-norbornene-**endo**-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (CID 2723766) | **endo** | **opposite** side to C3 |
+| *exo*-5-norbornene-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (name lookup) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+| Carbic acid, *endo*-norbornene-*cis*-5,6-dicarboxylic acid (CID 6541030) | **endo** | **opposite** side to C3 |
+| *exo*-5-norbornene-2-carboxylic acid (CID 12268635) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+| *exo*-norbornene-2-carboxylic acid, enantiomer (CID 721733) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+
+Five stereo-defined PubChem references agree, and the result is robust across two independent
+reference planes (6-membered ring {1,2,4,5,6,7} and bridgehead+dienophile {2,4,6,7}).
+The parallel `verification/` effort in this directory (scripts + SDFs) independently reproduced
+the same rule.
+
+> **Convention (verified): exo = the dienophile substituent is on the SAME side as the one-carbon
+> (methano) bridge C3; endo = OPPOSITE side of C3 (same side as the new alkene C1=C5).**
+
+Applied to the two DA diastereomers:
+
+| diastereomer | mapped SMILES | CIP (C2,C4,C7) | CN vs C3 |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| **endo** | `[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]` | **(2S,4S,7R)** | anti |
+| **exo**  | `[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]`  | **(2S,4S,7S)** | syn |
+
+⇒ **The earlier draft was swapped**: its "endo" (C7 = S) is the true **exo**; its "exo" (C7 = R) is
+the true **endo**. The pre-existing `product_*_seed.xyz/.inp` are therefore left untouched but are

+
+## 3. Common reactive complex (unified reference for both faces)
+- File: `orca_inputs/rc_common.xyz` (MMFF94s encounter complex; CP + ACN stacked, diene plane ⊥ approach).
+- d(C2···C6) = d(C4···C7) = **3.189 Å**; dienophile C6=C7 = 1.339 Å (intact); 2 fragments, no anomalies.

+| `ts_exo_guess.xyz` | exo  | 2.225 Å | 2.225 Å | 1.440 Å | syn to C3 |
+
+Each is a planar diene/dienophile DA arrangement (dienophile parallel to the diene, CN in the diene plane).
+MMFF energies (both guesses) differ as expected; **no energy of these guesses is evidence**.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+def build(smi, seed=0xf00d):
+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); assert m is not None, smi
+    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, ps)==0, "embed failed "+smi
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=3000)
+    return mh
+
+def signs(mh, ref_idx, probes):
+    conf=mh.GetConformer()
+    P=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ref_idx])
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); n=Vt[-1]
+    return {k: float(np.dot(np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in v]).mean(0)-c, n)) for k,v in probes.items()}
+
+# anchors: index map: 0=methano, 1&4=bridgeheads, 2&3=alkene, 5&6=dienophile C, 7&10=carbonyl C, 9=ring O

+probes={"methano0":[0],"anhO9":[9],"carbonylCmid":[7,10]}

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+def build(smi, seed=0xf00d):
+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    assert m is not None, smi
+    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, ps)
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=2000)
+    return mh
+
+def plane_signs(mh, ref_idx, probe_pairs):
+    conf = mh.GetConformer()
+    P = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ref_idx])
+    c = P.mean(axis=0); U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(P-c); n = Vt[-1]
+    out={}
+    for name, idxs in probe_pairs.items():
+        q = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in idxs]).mean(axis=0)
+        out[name] = float(np.dot(q-c, n))
+    return out
+
+# ---- anchor: CID 2723766 = ENDO (Carbic anhydride) ----
+anchor = "C1[C@@H]2C=C[C@H]1[C@@H]3[C@H]2C(=O)OC3=O"

+    a.SetAtomMapNum(a.GetIdx()+1)   # so map = idx+1
+conf=m.GetConformer()
+# indices 0-based: 0=methano CH2, 1,4=bridgeheads, 2,3=alkene, 5,6=dienophile C, 7,10 carbonyl C, 9 ring O
+ref=[1,2,3,4,5,6]
+probes={"methano(0)":[0], "anhydride_O(9)":[9], "carbonylC_mid(7,10)":[7,10]}

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np, json
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+CP  = "[CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH:4]=[CH:5]1"
+ACN = "[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"
+
+def embed(smi, seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps)==0
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000)
+    return mh
+
+def coords(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+
+def setcoords(m, X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
+
+def mapidx(m):
+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+
+def bestfit_plane_normal(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c, Vt[-1]
+
+cp = embed(CP); acn = embed(ACN)
+ci = mapidx(cp); ai = mapidx(acn)
+Xcp = coords(cp); Xacn = coords(acn)
+
+# --- align cyclopentadiene: ring plane -> z=0, C2..C4 along x, centered at origin ---
+ring = np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in (1,2,3,4,5)])
+cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(ring)
+# build frame: z = n ; x = (C4-C2) projected ; y = z cross x
+x = Xcp[ci[4]] - Xcp[ci[2]]; x = x - np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z = n; y = np.cross(z,x)
+R = np.vstack([x,y,z])   # rows
+mid = 0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]])
+Xcp2 = (Xcp - mid) @ R.T
+# now C2..C4 on x axis; make C2 negative x

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+
+def bridges(mol, allring):
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    Cs=[i for i in allring if isC(i)]
+    bh=[i for i in Cs if len([n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring])==3]
+    # one-carbon bridge
+    oneC=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and set(n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring)==set(bh)][0]
+    # two-carbon bridges: pairs of ring carbons each bonded to one bridgehead
+    # find non-bridgehead, non-oneC ring carbons
+    rest=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and i!=oneC]
+    # group them into bridges: two carbons connected and each to a different bridgehead
+    return bh, oneC, rest
+
+def analyze(path,label):
+    mol=Chem.MolFromMolFile(path, removeHs=False)
+    conf=mol.GetConformer()
+    xyz={i:np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)),dtype=float) for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms())}
+    ri=mol.GetRingInfo(); allring=set().union(*[set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()])
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    bh,oneC,rest=bridges(mol,allring)
+    # substituent-bearing ring carbons (bonded to non-ring C)
+    bearing=[i for i in allring if isC(i) and any(n not in allring and isC(n) for n in nbrs(i))]
+    subst=[n for i in bearing for n in nbrs(i) if n not in allring and isC(n)]
+    # other 2-carbon bridge: rest minus bearing
+    other=[i for i in rest if i not in bearing]
+    # plane: choose bridgeheads + (bearing if >=2 bearing else other)
+    base_atoms = list(bh)+ (list(bearing) if len(bearing)>=2 else list(other))
+    P=np.array([xyz[i] for i in base_atoms]); cc=P.mean(0); n=np.linalg.svd(P-cc)[2][2]
+    sd=lambda i: float(np.dot(xyz[i]-cc,n))
+    print("%-20s bh=%s CH2=%d bearing=%s subst=%s plane_atoms=%s sd(CH2)=%+.2f substsd=%s -> %s"%(
+        label,bh,oneC,bearing,subst,base_atoms,sd(oneC),[round(sd(i),2) for i in subst],
+        ["SAME" if sd(i)*sd(oneC)>0 else "OPP" for i in subst]))
+for cid,lab in [(6541030,"endo-diacid"),(12268642,"exo-methanol"),(721733,"exo-acid"),(12268635,"acid-iso")]:
+    analyze("/data/cloudra/workspace/hard_resume_20260930/hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/verification/pubchem_%d.sdf"%cid, lab)

+print("rings:", rings)

+print("bridgeheads:", bridgeheads)

+oneC = None

+    rn = [n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring]
+    if set(rn)==set(bridgeheads):

+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]

+    Cs=[i for i in allring if isC(i)]
+    bh=[i for i in Cs if len([n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring])==3]
+    oneC=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and set(n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring)==set(bh)][0]
+    # CN substituent: find nitrile C (bonded to N) and its ring neighbor
+    nit=[a.GetIdx() for a in mol.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomicNum()==7][0]
+    cnC=[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(nit).GetNeighbors()][0]

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds, AllChem
+
+def classify(path,label):
+    raw = Chem.MolFromXYZFile(path)
+    mol = Chem.Mol(raw)
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(mol, charge=0)
+    Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
+    print("=====", label, path.split('/')[-1])
+    print("  formula:", Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(mol))
+    print("  isomeric SMILES (from 3D):", Chem.MolToSmiles(mol, isomericSmiles=True))
+    # CIP on heavy atoms
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    conf=mol.GetConformer()
+    xyz={i:np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)),dtype=float) for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms())}
+    ri=mol.GetRingInfo(); allring=set().union(*[set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()])
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    Cs=[i for i in allring if isC(i)]
+    bh=[i for i in Cs if len([n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring])==3]
+    oneC=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and set(n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring)==set(bh)][0]
+    # CN substituent: find nitrile C (bonded to N) and its ring neighbor
+    nit=[a.GetIdx() for a in mol.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomicNum()==7][0]
+    cnC=[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(nit).GetNeighbors()][0]
+    bearing=[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(cnC).GetNeighbors() if n in allring][0]

+    # bearing bridge partner = ring C bonded to bearing that is not a bridgehead
+    partner=[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(bearing).GetNeighbors() if n in allring and n not in bh][0]

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+
+def bridges(mol, allring):
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    Cs=[i for i in allring if isC(i)]
+    bh=[i for i in Cs if len([n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring])==3]
+    # one-carbon bridge
+    oneC=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and set(n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring)==set(bh)][0]
+    # two-carbon bridges: pairs of ring carbons each bonded to one bridgehead
+    # find non-bridgehead, non-oneC ring carbons
+    rest=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and i!=oneC]
+    # group them into bridges: two carbons connected and each to a different bridgehead
+    return bh, oneC, rest
+
+def analyze(path,label):
+    mol=Chem.MolFromMolFile(path, removeHs=False)
+    conf=mol.GetConformer()
+    xyz={i:np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)),dtype=float) for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms())}
+    ri=mol.GetRingInfo(); allring=set().union(*[set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()])
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    bh,oneC,rest=bridges(mol,allring)
+    # substituent-bearing ring carbons (bonded to non-ring C)
+    bearing=[i for i in allring if isC(i) and any(n not in allring and isC(n) for n in nbrs(i))]
+    subst=[n for i in bearing for n in nbrs(i) if n not in allring and isC(n)]
+    # other 2-carbon bridge: rest minus bearing
+    other=[i for i in rest if i not in bearing]
+    # plane: choose bridgeheads + (bearing if >=2 bearing else other)
+    base_atoms = list(bh)+ (list(bearing) if len(bearing)>=2 else list(other))
+    P=np.array([xyz[i] for i in base_atoms]); cc=P.mean(0); n=np.linalg.svd(P-cc)[2][2]
+    sd=lambda i: float(np.dot(xyz[i]-cc,n))
+    print("%-20s bh=%s CH2=%d bearing=%s subst=%s plane_atoms=%s sd(CH2)=%+.2f substsd=%s -> %s"%(
+        label,bh,oneC,bearing,subst,base_atoms,sd(oneC),[round(sd(i),2) for i in subst],
+        ["SAME" if sd(i)*sd(oneC)>0 else "OPP" for i in subst]))

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+
+def bridges(mol, allring):
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    Cs=[i for i in allring if isC(i)]
+    bh=[i for i in Cs if len([n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring])==3]
+    # one-carbon bridge
+    oneC=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and set(n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring)==set(bh)][0]
+    # two-carbon bridges: pairs of ring carbons each bonded to one bridgehead
+    # find non-bridgehead, non-oneC ring carbons
+    rest=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and i!=oneC]
+    # group them into bridges: two carbons connected and each to a different bridgehead
+    return bh, oneC, rest
+
+def analyze(path,label):
+    mol=Chem.MolFromMolFile(path, removeHs=False)
+    conf=mol.GetConformer()
+    xyz={i:np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)),dtype=float) for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms())}
+    ri=mol.GetRingInfo(); allring=set().union(*[set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()])
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    bh,oneC,rest=bridges(mol,allring)
+    # substituent-bearing ring carbons (bonded to non-ring C)
+    bearing=[i for i in allring if isC(i) and any(n not in allring and isC(n) for n in nbrs(i))]
+    subst=[n for i in bearing for n in nbrs(i) if n not in allring and isC(n)]
+    # other 2-carbon bridge: rest minus bearing
+    other=[i for i in rest if i not in bearing]
+    # plane: choose bridgeheads + (bearing if >=2 bearing else other)
+    base_atoms = list(bh)+ (list(bearing) if len(bearing)>=2 else list(other))
+    P=np.array([xyz[i] for i in base_atoms]); cc=P.mean(0); n=np.linalg.svd(P-cc)[2][2]
+    sd=lambda i: float(np.dot(xyz[i]-cc,n))
+    print("%-20s bh=%s CH2=%d bearing=%s subst=%s plane_atoms=%s sd(CH2)=%+.2f substsd=%s -> %s"%(
+        label,bh,oneC,bearing,subst,base_atoms,sd(oneC),[round(sd(i),2) for i in subst],
+        ["SAME" if sd(i)*sd(oneC)>0 else "OPP" for i in subst]))
+for cid,lab in [(6541030,"endo-diacid"),(12268642,"exo-methanol"),(721733,"exo-acid"),(12268635,"acid-iso")]:
+    analyze("/data/cloudra/workspace/hard_resume_20260930/hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/verification/pubchem_%d.sdf"%cid, lab)

+import numpy as np

+
+def bridges(mol, allring):
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    Cs=[i for i in allring if isC(i)]
+    bh=[i for i in Cs if len([n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring])==3]
+    # one-carbon bridge
+    oneC=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and set(n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring)==set(bh)][0]
+    # two-carbon bridges: pairs of ring carbons each bonded to one bridgehead
+    # find non-bridgehead, non-oneC ring carbons
+    rest=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and i!=oneC]
+    # group them into bridges: two carbons connected and each to a different bridgehead
+    return bh, oneC, rest
+
+def analyze(path,label):
+    mol=Chem.MolFromMolFile(path, removeHs=False)
+    conf=mol.GetConformer()
+    xyz={i:np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)),dtype=float) for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms())}
+    ri=mol.GetRingInfo(); allring=set().union(*[set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()])
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    bh,oneC,rest=bridges(mol,allring)
+    # substituent-bearing ring carbons (bonded to non-ring C)
+    bearing=[i for i in allring if isC(i) and any(n not in allring and isC(n) for n in nbrs(i))]
+    subst=[n for i in bearing for n in nbrs(i) if n not in allring and isC(n)]
+    # other 2-carbon bridge: rest minus bearing
+    other=[i for i in rest if i not in bearing]
+    # plane: choose bridgeheads + (bearing if >=2 bearing else other)
+    base_atoms = list(bh)+ (list(bearing) if len(bearing)>=2 else list(other))
+    P=np.array([xyz[i] for i in base_atoms]); cc=P.mean(0); n=np.linalg.svd(P-cc)[2][2]
+    sd=lambda i: float(np.dot(xyz[i]-cc,n))
+    print("%-20s bh=%s CH2=%d bearing=%s subst=%s plane_atoms=%s sd(CH2)=%+.2f substsd=%s -> %s"%(
+        label,bh,oneC,bearing,subst,base_atoms,sd(oneC),[round(sd(i),2) for i in subst],
+        ["SAME" if sd(i)*sd(oneC)>0 else "OPP" for i in subst]))
+for cid,lab in [(6541030,"endo-diacid"),(12268642,"exo-methanol"),(721733,"exo-acid"),(12268635,"acid-iso")]:

+    rn = [n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring]
+    if set(rn)==set(bridgeheads):

+# HDA_CN — Preparation record (cyclopentadiene + acrylonitrile endo/exo Diels–Alder)
+
+**Status: PREPARED ONLY — no QM/xTB submitted.** Deliverable for supervisor resource/scientific review.
+Supersedes the earlier draft mapping in this directory; the *seed* files `product_{endo,exo}_seed.*`
+are retained unchanged but are **mis-labelled (swapped)** — see §2.
+
+## 1. Target and scope
+- Reaction: cyclopentadiene (CP) + acrylonitrile (ACN), concerted Diels–Alder.
+- System: **C8H9N, 9 heavy atoms, 18 atoms, q=0, m=1**; CP is a rigid (s-cis-locked) diene.
+- Goal: locate the **endo** and **exo** concerted DA transition states in the gas phase at one
+  method, and report both barriers (difference from the calculation, **not** pre-set).
+- Source (literature background only, DOI 10.1021/jo400900x, J. Org. Chem. 2013, 78, 6582;
+  PMC3731169): in CP+ACN the concerted DA is preferred over the stepwise diradical by ≈5.9 kcal/mol;
+  endo and exo TS are **essentially isoenergetic**, exo marginally lower (B3LYP/6-31G(d)).
+  We do **not** fit to these numbers and we add **no** new range (no diradical / polymerization
+  pathway in this candidate).
+- Method (fixed by task): **ORCA 6.1.1, B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP RIJCOSX def2/J TightSCF, gas phase**,
+  8 CPU / 14000 MB / maxcore 1536; software-native defaults — **no MaxIter, no Cloudra timeout**.
+
+## 2. Atom mapping and the endo/exo correction (independently verified)
+
+Heavy atoms are listed **by map ascending** in every file (then H's, grouped by their heavy parent).
+
+| map | atom | role |
+|----|------|------|
+| 1,2,4,5 | C | cyclopentadiene ring |
+| 3 | C | **one-carbon (methano) bridge**, CH2 |
+| 6,7 | C | dienophile C=C (from ACN) |
+| 8 | C | nitrile C |
+| 9 | N | nitrile N |
+
+Bond changes: **C2–C6 and C4–C7 form**; C1=C2 and C4=C5 become single; **C1–C5 becomes the new C=C**;
+C6=C7 becomes single. (C1,C5 = diene central carbons; C2,C4 = diene termini.)
+
+**Verification of the endo/exo labels.** The pre-existing draft defined "same side of the
+C2/C4/C6/C7 plane as bridge C3 = endo". I tested this against five *stereo-defined* PubChem
+anchors that are exact structural analogs (substituent on the dienophile-derived bridge):
+
+| anchor (PubChem) | label | measured (substituent vs methano bridge C3) |
+|---|---|---|
+| Carbic anhydride, *cis*-5-norbornene-**endo**-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (CID 2723766) | **endo** | **opposite** side to C3 |
+| *exo*-5-norbornene-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (name lookup) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+| Carbic acid, *endo*-norbornene-*cis*-5,6-dicarboxylic acid (CID 6541030) | **endo** | **opposite** side to C3 |
+| *exo*-5-norbornene-2-carboxylic acid (CID 12268635) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+| *exo*-norbornene-2-carboxylic acid, enantiomer (CID 721733) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+
+Five stereo-defined PubChem references agree, and the result is robust across two independent
+reference planes (6-membered ring {1,2,4,5,6,7} and bridgehead+dienophile {2,4,6,7}).
+The parallel `verification/` effort in this directory (scripts + SDFs) independently reproduced
+the same rule.
+
+> **Convention (verified): exo = the dienophile substituent is on the SAME side as the one-carbon
+> (methano) bridge C3; endo = OPPOSITE side of C3 (same side as the new alkene C1=C5).**
+
+Applied to the two DA diastereomers:
+
+| diastereomer | mapped SMILES | CIP (C2,C4,C7) | CN vs C3 |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| **endo** | `[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]` | **(2S,4S,7R)** | anti |
+| **exo**  | `[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]`  | **(2S,4S,7S)** | syn |
+
+⇒ **The earlier draft was swapped**: its "endo" (C7 = S) is the true **exo**; its "exo" (C7 = R) is
+the true **endo**. The pre-existing `product_*_seed.xyz/.inp` are therefore left untouched but are
+**not to be used**; correct structures are in `orca_inputs/product_endo.xyz` / `product_exo.xyz`.
+
+## 3. Common reactive complex (unified reference for both faces)
+- File: `orca_inputs/rc_common.xyz` (MMFF94s encounter complex; CP + ACN stacked, diene plane ⊥ approach).
+- d(C2···C6) = d(C4···C7) = **3.189 Å**; dienophile C6=C7 = 1.339 Å (intact); 2 fragments, no anomalies.
+- The endo-precursor and exo-precursor complexes (CN on either face) are **symmetry-degenerate**
+  (identical MMFF energy), so a **single** common RC is the unified reference for both barriers.
+- 01_rc_optfreq.inp must confirm it is a true minimum (0 imaginary). If Opt+Freq shows it is not a
+  bound minimum, the honest fallback reference is the separated reactants (08).
+
+## 4. The two concerted-DA TS initial guesses (finite seeds only)
+Synchronous first guesses (forming bonds equal); a genuine TS may be slightly asynchronous — OptTS decides.
+
+| file | family | d(C2–C6) | d(C4–C7) | d(C6=C7) | CN |
+|---|---|---|---|---|---|
+| `ts_endo_guess.xyz` | endo | 2.225 Å | 2.225 Å | 1.440 Å | anti to C3 |
+| `ts_exo_guess.xyz` | exo  | 2.225 Å | 2.225 Å | 1.440 Å | syn to C3 |
+
+Each is a planar diene/dienophile DA arrangement (dienophile parallel to the diene, CN in the diene plane).

+ACN = "[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"
+
+def embed(smi, seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps)==0
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000)
+    return mh
+
+def coords(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+
+def setcoords(m, X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
+
+def mapidx(m):
+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+
+def bestfit_plane_normal(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c, Vt[-1]
+
+cp = embed(CP); acn = embed(ACN)
+ci = mapidx(cp); ai = mapidx(acn)
+Xcp = coords(cp); Xacn = coords(acn)
+
+# --- align cyclopentadiene: ring plane -> z=0, C2..C4 along x, centered at origin ---
+ring = np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in (1,2,3,4,5)])
+cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(ring)
+# build frame: z = n ; x = (C4-C2) projected ; y = z cross x
+x = Xcp[ci[4]] - Xcp[ci[2]]; x = x - np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z = n; y = np.cross(z,x)
+R = np.vstack([x,y,z])   # rows
+mid = 0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]])
+Xcp2 = (Xcp - mid) @ R.T
+# now C2..C4 on x axis; make C2 negative x
+if Xcp2[ci[2],0] > Xcp2[ci[4],0]:
+    Xcp2[:,0]*=-1
+L = abs(Xcp2[ci[4],0]); print("CP C2..C4 half-length L=%.3f  dist=%.3f"%(L, 2*L))
+print("  C3 y after align = %+.3f (methano side)"%Xcp2[ci[3],1])
+

+# dienophile local plane = C6,C7,C8 (sp2 core). normal -> z; C6->C7 -> x
+core = np.array([Xacn[ai[6]], Xacn[ai[7]], Xacn[ai[8]]])
+cen2, n2 = bestfit_plane_normal(core)
+x2 = Xacn[ai[7]] - Xacn[ai[6]]; x2 = x2 - np.dot(x2,n2)*n2; x2/=np.linalg.norm(x2)

+Xa = (Xacn - 0.5*(Xacn[ai[6]]+Xacn[ai[7]])) @ R2.T

+    # dienophile local x-axis = C6->C7 ; we want C6 at -w, C7 at +w : scale to bond length then set

+# HDA_CN — Preparation record (cyclopentadiene + acrylonitrile endo/exo Diels–Alder)
+
+**Status: PREPARED ONLY — no QM/xTB submitted.** Deliverable for supervisor resource/scientific review.
+Supersedes the earlier draft mapping in this directory; the *seed* files `product_{endo,exo}_seed.*`
+are retained unchanged but are **mis-labelled (swapped)** — see §2.
+
+## 1. Target and scope
+- Reaction: cyclopentadiene (CP) + acrylonitrile (ACN), concerted Diels–Alder.
+- System: **C8H9N, 9 heavy atoms, 18 atoms, q=0, m=1**; CP is a rigid (s-cis-locked) diene.
+- Goal: locate the **endo** and **exo** concerted DA transition states in the gas phase at one
+  method, and report both barriers (difference from the calculation, **not** pre-set).
+- Source (literature background only, DOI 10.1021/jo400900x, J. Org. Chem. 2013, 78, 6582;
+  PMC3731169): in CP+ACN the concerted DA is preferred over the stepwise diradical by ≈5.9 kcal/mol;
+  endo and exo TS are **essentially isoenergetic**, exo marginally lower (B3LYP/6-31G(d)).
+  We do **not** fit to these numbers and we add **no** new range (no diradical / polymerization
+  pathway in this candidate).
+- Method (fixed by task): **ORCA 6.1.1, B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP RIJCOSX def2/J TightSCF, gas phase**,
+  8 CPU / 14000 MB / maxcore 1536; software-native defaults — **no MaxIter, no Cloudra timeout**.
+
+## 2. Atom mapping and the endo/exo correction (independently verified)
+
+Heavy atoms are listed **by map ascending** in every file (then H's, grouped by their heavy parent).
+
+| map | atom | role |
+|----|------|------|
+| 1,2,4,5 | C | cyclopentadiene ring |
+| 3 | C | **one-carbon (methano) bridge**, CH2 |
+| 6,7 | C | dienophile C=C (from ACN) |
+| 8 | C | nitrile C |
+| 9 | N | nitrile N |
+
+Bond changes: **C2–C6 and C4–C7 form**; C1=C2 and C4=C5 become single; **C1–C5 becomes the new C=C**;
+C6=C7 becomes single. (C1,C5 = diene central carbons; C2,C4 = diene termini.)
+
+**Verification of the endo/exo labels.** The pre-existing draft defined "same side of the
+C2/C4/C6/C7 plane as bridge C3 = endo". I tested this against five *stereo-defined* PubChem
+anchors that are exact structural analogs (substituent on the dienophile-derived bridge):
+
+| anchor (PubChem) | label | measured (substituent vs methano bridge C3) |
+|---|---|---|
+| Carbic anhydride, *cis*-5-norbornene-**endo**-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (CID 2723766) | **endo** | **opposite** side to C3 |
+| *exo*-5-norbornene-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (name lookup) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+| Carbic acid, *endo*-norbornene-*cis*-5,6-dicarboxylic acid (CID 6541030) | **endo** | **opposite** side to C3 |
+| *exo*-5-norbornene-2-carboxylic acid (CID 12268635) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+| *exo*-norbornene-2-carboxylic acid, enantiomer (CID 721733) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+
+Five stereo-defined PubChem references agree, and the result is robust across two independent
+reference planes (6-membered ring {1,2,4,5,6,7} and bridgehead+dienophile {2,4,6,7}).
+The parallel `verification/` effort in this directory (scripts + SDFs) independently reproduced
+the same rule.
+
+> **Convention (verified): exo = the dienophile substituent is on the SAME side as the one-carbon
+> (methano) bridge C3; endo = OPPOSITE side of C3 (same side as the new alkene C1=C5).**
+
+Applied to the two DA diastereomers:
+
+| diastereomer | mapped SMILES | CIP (C2,C4,C7) | CN vs C3 |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| **endo** | `[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]` | **(2S,4S,7R)** | anti |
+| **exo**  | `[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]`  | **(2S,4S,7S)** | syn |
+
+⇒ **The earlier draft was swapped**: its "endo" (C7 = S) is the true **exo**; its "exo" (C7 = R) is
+the true **endo**. The pre-existing `product_*_seed.xyz/.inp` are therefore left untouched but are
+**not to be used**; correct structures are in `orca_inputs/product_endo.xyz` / `product_exo.xyz`.
+
+## 3. Common reactive complex (unified reference for both faces)
+- File: `orca_inputs/rc_common.xyz` (MMFF94s encounter complex; CP + ACN stacked, diene plane ⊥ approach).
+- d(C2···C6) = d(C4···C7) = **3.189 Å**; dienophile C6=C7 = 1.339 Å (intact); 2 fragments, no anomalies.
+- The endo-precursor and exo-precursor complexes (CN on either face) are **symmetry-degenerate**
+  (identical MMFF energy), so a **single** common RC is the unified reference for both barriers.
+- 01_rc_optfreq.inp must confirm it is a true minimum (0 imaginary). If Opt+Freq shows it is not a
+  bound minimum, the honest fallback reference is the separated reactants (08).
+
+## 4. The two concerted-DA TS initial guesses (finite seeds only)
+Synchronous first guesses (forming bonds equal); a genuine TS may be slightly asynchronous — OptTS decides.
+
+| file | family | d(C2–C6) | d(C4–C7) | d(C6=C7) | CN |
+|---|---|---|---|---|---|
+| `ts_endo_guess.xyz` | endo | 2.225 Å | 2.225 Å | 1.440 Å | anti to C3 |
+| `ts_exo_guess.xyz` | exo  | 2.225 Å | 2.225 Å | 1.440 Å | syn to C3 |
+
+Each is a planar diene/dienophile DA arrangement (dienophile parallel to the diene, CN in the diene plane).
+MMFF energies (both guesses) differ as expected; **no energy of these guesses is evidence**.
+
+## 5. ORCA inputs (`orca_inputs/`) — drafts, nothing submitted
+`01_rc_optfreq.inp` (Opt Freq), `02_ts_endo_optts.inp` / `03_ts_exo_optts.inp` (OptTS Freq, `%geom Calc_Hess true`),
+`04/05_product_{endo,exo}_optfreq.inp` (Opt Freq), `06/07_irc_{endo,exo}.inp` (IRC, InitHess read from the OptTS .hess),
+`08_reactants_optfreq.inp` (separated reactants, secondary reference).
+Common header: `! B3LYP D3BJ def2-SVP RIJCOSX def2/J TightSCF <task>`, `%pal nprocs 8 end`, `%maxcore 1536`.
+Resource check: 8 × 1536 = 12288 MB ≤ 14000 MB reservation; gas phase; q0 m1; no MaxIter/timeout.
+
+Intended order (when resources exist): 01 → 02 → 03 → (endpoints via 04/05, 08) → 06/07 IRC.
+
+## 6. Acceptance gates (before this candidate may replace a hard task)
+1. RC (01) converges to a **0-imaginary** minimum = the common reference energy for both faces.
+2. Each of 02/03 converges to exactly **one imaginary frequency** whose displacement lives on the
+   forming pair (C2,C6),(C4,C7) → pass `watch_pairs=[[2,6],[4,7]]` to `log_parser`.
+3. **Bidirectional IRC** (06/07) connects the RC/separated reactants to the correct **endo vs exo**
+   product (`product_endo.xyz` vs `product_exo.xyz`; CIP 2S,4S,7R vs 2S,4S,7S).
+4. Both IRC endpoints Opt+Freq = 0 imaginary and reproduce the RC (reactant side) and the matching product.
+5. Only then report endo vs exo electronic barriers (relative to the common RC) to `agent_hub` + coordinator.
+   endo/exo near-degeneracy must be reported as measured, never forced.
+
+## 7. Caveats / honesty
+- Literature is solution/experimental background; our gold is **gas-phase electronic** energy — no mixing.
+- MMFF endo/exo ordering (exo lower by ≈1.7 kcal/mol here) is coincidentally the same sign as the
+  literature but is **not** a result and is **not** used.
+- No new mechanistic range: no diradical, no polymerization, no NEB exploration in this candidate.
+- Preparation only; whether the RC is genuinely bound and whether the DA is genuinely concerted are
+  questions for the QM stage, not asserted here.
+
+## 8. Provenance
+`_prep_scratch/` holds the RDKit 2026.03.4 scripts (fragment embedding, rigid alignment, MMFF,
+endo/exo plane test) and the generated `geoms/`. All coordinates are program-generated; none hand-typed.
+Old `product_*_seed.*` and the old GEOMETRY_PREPARATION.json mapping were **not deleted**;
+the mapping JSON here records the corrected labels and the verification anchors.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+def build(smi, seed=0xf00d):
+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); assert m is not None, smi
+    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, ps)==0, "embed failed "+smi
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=3000)
+    return mh
+
+def signs(mh, ref_idx, probes):
+    conf=mh.GetConformer()
+    P=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ref_idx])
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); n=Vt[-1]
+    return {k: float(np.dot(np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in v]).mean(0)-c, n)) for k,v in probes.items()}
+
+# anchors: index map: 0=methano, 1&4=bridgeheads, 2&3=alkene, 5&6=dienophile C, 7&10=carbonyl C, 9=ring O
+endo_anchor="C1[C@@H]2C=C[C@H]1[C@@H]3[C@H]2C(=O)OC3=O"   # Carbic anhydride CID2723766 (ENDO)
+exo_anchor ="C1[C@@H]2C=C[C@H]1[C@H]3[C@@H]2C(=O)OC3=O"    # PubChem exo-5-norbornene-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride
+probes={"methano0":[0],"anhO9":[9],"carbonylCmid":[7,10]}
+planes={"6ring[1,2,3,4,5,6]":[1,2,3,4,5,6],"bridgehead_dienophile[1,4,5,6]":[1,4,5,6],
+        "alkene_bridgehead[1,2,3,4]":[1,2,3,4]}
+for tag,smi in [("ENDO anchor",endo_anchor),("EXO anchor",exo_anchor)]:
+    mh=build(smi)
+    print("##",tag, "csmiles", Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(mh)))
+    for pn,ref in planes.items():
+        s=signs(mh,ref,probes)
+        same = "SAME" if np.sign(s["methano0"])==np.sign(s["carbonylCmid"]) else "OPP"
+        print("   plane %-32s methano=%+.3f  substituent(midC=%+.3f, O=%+.3f) -> %s vs methano"%(pn,s["methano0"],s["carbonylCmid"],s["anhO9"],same))

+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+
+def setcoords(m, X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
+
+def mapidx(m):
+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+
+def bestfit_plane_normal(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c, Vt[-1]

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np, json, os
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+OUT="geoms"; os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
+CP="[CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH:4]=[CH:5]1"; ACN="[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"

+EXO_PROD ="[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]"   # CN syn  C3 = EXO
+
+def embed(smi,seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m); ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps); AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000); return mh
+def XYZ(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+def setXYZ(m,X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i,X[i].tolist())
+def plane(P):
+    cen=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-cen); return cen,Vt[-1]
+
+cp=embed(CP); acn=embed(ACN)
+ci={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in cp.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+ai={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in acn.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+Xcp=XYZ(cp); Xacn=XYZ(acn)
+ring=np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in(1,2,3,4,5)]); cen,n=plane(ring)
+x=Xcp[ci[4]]-Xcp[ci[2]]; x=x-np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z=n; y=np.cross(z,x); R=np.vstack([x,y,z]); Xcp2=(Xcp-0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]]))@R.T
+if Xcp2[ci[2],0]>Xcp2[ci[4],0]: Xcp2[:,0]*=-1
+core=np.array([Xacn[ai[6]],Xacn[ai[7]],Xacn[ai[8]]]); cen2,n2=plane(core)
+x2=Xacn[ai[7]]-Xacn[ai[6]]; x2=x2-np.dot(x2,n2)*n2; x2/=np.linalg.norm(x2)
+z2=n2; y2=np.cross(z2,x2); Xa=(Xacn-0.5*(Xacn[ai[6]]+Xacn[ai[7]]))@np.vstack([x2,y2,z2]).T
+

+    Xa2=Xa.copy(); d=np.linalg.norm(Xa2[ai[7]]-Xa2[ai[6]]); Xa2[:,0]*=(2*w)/d
+    if np.sign(Xa2[ai[8],1])!=face: Xa2[:,1]*=-1.0
+    Xa2[:,2]+=h
+    comb=Chem.CombineMols(cp,acn); setXYZ(comb,np.vstack([Xcp2,Xa2])); Chem.SanitizeMol(comb)
+    mm=Chem.AddHs(comb,addCoords=True);

+    props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mm); ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mm,props)
+    if target:
+        for i,j in [(2,6),(4,7)]: ff.AddDistanceConstraint(mp[i],mp[j],target,target,400.0)
+    if fix_heavy:
+        for a in mm.GetAtoms():
+            if a.GetAtomicNum()>1: ff.AddFixedPoint(a.GetIdx())
+    ff.Minimize(maxIts=5000)

+    d26=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[2]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[6])))
+    d47=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[4]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[7])))
+    d67=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[6]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[7])))
+    v="ENDO(CN anti C3)" if np.sign(sd(3))!=np.sign(sd(9)) else "EXO(CN syn C3)"
+    return dict(d26=round(d26,3),d47=round(d47,3),d67=round(d67,3),sC3=round(sd(3),3),sC8=round(sd(8),3),sN9=round(sd(9),3),family=v)
+
+def ordered_atoms(mm):
+    # heavy atoms by map asc, then H by parent-map asc
+    heavy=[]; hyd=[]
+    mp={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    idx2map={v:k for k,v in mp.items()}
+    for a in mm.GetAtoms():
+        if a.GetAtomicNum()>1: heavy.append(a.GetIdx())
+        else:
+            nb=[x.GetIdx() for x in a.GetNeighbors() if x.GetAtomicNum()>1]
+            pm=idx2map.get(nb[0],999) if nb else 999
+            hyd.append((pm,a.GetIdx()))
+    heavy.sort(key=lambda i: idx2map[i]); hyd.sort()
+    return heavy+[i for _,i in hyd], mp

+    L=[str(len(order)), comment]

+
+geom={}

+rc2,E2=complex_geom(3.15,0.67,+1,fix_heavy=False,target=None)  # full relax test

+print("DONE")

+# HDA_CN — Preparation record (cyclopentadiene + acrylonitrile endo/exo Diels–Alder)
+
+**Status: PREPARED ONLY — no QM/xTB submitted.** Deliverable for supervisor resource/scientific review.
+Supersedes the earlier draft mapping in this directory; the *seed* files `product_{endo,exo}_seed.*`
+are retained unchanged but are **mis-labelled (swapped)** — see §2.
+
+## 1. Target and scope
+- Reaction: cyclopentadiene (CP) + acrylonitrile (ACN), concerted Diels–Alder.
+- System: **C8H9N, 9 heavy atoms, 18 atoms, q=0, m=1**; CP is a rigid (s-cis-locked) diene.
+- Goal: locate the **endo** and **exo** concerted DA transition states in the gas phase at one
+  method, and report both barriers (difference from the calculation, **not** pre-set).
+- Source (literature background only, DOI 10.1021/jo400900x, J. Org. Chem. 2013, 78, 6582;
+  PMC3731169): in CP+ACN the concerted DA is preferred over the stepwise diradical by ≈5.9 kcal/mol;
+  endo and exo TS are **essentially isoenergetic**, exo marginally lower (B3LYP/6-31G(d)).
+  We do **not** fit to these numbers and we add **no** new range (no diradical / polymerization
+  pathway in this candidate).
+- Method (fixed by task): **ORCA 6.1.1, B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP RIJCOSX def2/J TightSCF, gas phase**,
+  8 CPU / 14000 MB / maxcore 1536; software-native defaults — **no MaxIter, no Cloudra timeout**.
+
+## 2. Atom mapping and the endo/exo correction (independently verified)
+
+Heavy atoms are listed **by map ascending** in every file (then H's, grouped by their heavy parent).
+
+| map | atom | role |
+|----|------|------|
+| 1,2,4,5 | C | cyclopentadiene ring |
+| 3 | C | **one-carbon (methano) bridge**, CH2 |
+| 6,7 | C | dienophile C=C (from ACN) |
+| 8 | C | nitrile C |
+| 9 | N | nitrile N |
+
+Bond changes: **C2–C6 and C4–C7 form**; C1=C2 and C4=C5 become single; **C1–C5 becomes the new C=C**;
+C6=C7 becomes single. (C1,C5 = diene central carbons; C2,C4 = diene termini.)
+
+**Verification of the endo/exo labels.** The pre-existing draft defined "same side of the
+C2/C4/C6/C7 plane as bridge C3 = endo". I tested this against five *stereo-defined* PubChem
+anchors that are exact structural analogs (substituent on the dienophile-derived bridge):
+
+| anchor (PubChem) | label | measured (substituent vs methano bridge C3) |
+|---|---|---|
+| Carbic anhydride, *cis*-5-norbornene-**endo**-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (CID 2723766) | **endo** | **opposite** side to C3 |
+| *exo*-5-norbornene-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (name lookup) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+| Carbic acid, *endo*-norbornene-*cis*-5,6-dicarboxylic acid (CID 6541030) | **endo** | **opposite** side to C3 |
+| *exo*-5-norbornene-2-carboxylic acid (CID 12268635) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+| *exo*-norbornene-2-carboxylic acid, enantiomer (CID 721733) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+
+Five stereo-defined PubChem references agree, and the result is robust across two independent
+reference planes (6-membered ring {1,2,4,5,6,7} and bridgehead+dienophile {2,4,6,7}).
+The parallel `verification/` effort in this directory (scripts + SDFs) independently reproduced
+the same rule.
+
+> **Convention (verified): exo = the dienophile substituent is on the SAME side as the one-carbon
+> (methano) bridge C3; endo = OPPOSITE side of C3 (same side as the new alkene C1=C5).**
+
+Applied to the two DA diastereomers:
+
+| diastereomer | mapped SMILES | CIP (C2,C4,C7) | CN vs C3 |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| **endo** | `[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]` | **(2S,4S,7R)** | anti |
+| **exo**  | `[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]`  | **(2S,4S,7S)** | syn |
+
+⇒ **The earlier draft was swapped**: its "endo" (C7 = S) is the true **exo**; its "exo" (C7 = R) is
+the true **endo**. The pre-existing `product_*_seed.xyz/.inp` are therefore left untouched but are
+**not to be used**; correct structures are in `orca_inputs/product_endo.xyz` / `product_exo.xyz`.
+
+## 3. Common reactive complex (unified reference for both faces)
+- File: `orca_inputs/rc_common.xyz` (MMFF94s encounter complex; CP + ACN stacked, diene plane ⊥ approach).
+- d(C2···C6) = d(C4···C7) = **3.189 Å**; dienophile C6=C7 = 1.339 Å (intact); 2 fragments, no anomalies.
+- The endo-precursor and exo-precursor complexes (CN on either face) are **symmetry-degenerate**
+  (identical MMFF energy), so a **single** common RC is the unified reference for both barriers.
+- 01_rc_optfreq.inp must confirm it is a true minimum (0 imaginary). If Opt+Freq shows it is not a
+  bound minimum, the honest fallback reference is the separated reactants (08).
+
+## 4. The two concerted-DA TS initial guesses (finite seeds only)
+Synchronous first guesses (forming bonds equal); a genuine TS may be slightly asynchronous — OptTS decides.
+
+| file | family | d(C2–C6) | d(C4–C7) | d(C6=C7) | CN |
+|---|---|---|---|---|---|
+| `ts_endo_guess.xyz` | endo | 2.225 Å | 2.225 Å | 1.440 Å | anti to C3 |
+| `ts_exo_guess.xyz` | exo  | 2.225 Å | 2.225 Å | 1.440 Å | syn to C3 |
+
+Each is a planar diene/dienophile DA arrangement (dienophile parallel to the diene, CN in the diene plane).
+MMFF energies (both guesses) differ as expected; **no energy of these guesses is evidence**.
+
+## 5. ORCA inputs (`orca_inputs/`) — drafts, nothing submitted
+`01_rc_optfreq.inp` (Opt Freq), `02_ts_endo_optts.inp` / `03_ts_exo_optts.inp` (OptTS Freq, `%geom Calc_Hess true`),
+`04/05_product_{endo,exo}_optfreq.inp` (Opt Freq), `06/07_irc_{endo,exo}.inp` (IRC, InitHess read from the OptTS .hess),
+`08_reactants_optfreq.inp` (separated reactants, secondary reference).
+Common header: `! B3LYP D3BJ def2-SVP RIJCOSX def2/J TightSCF <task>`, `%pal nprocs 8 end`, `%maxcore 1536`.
+Resource check: 8 × 1536 = 12288 MB ≤ 14000 MB reservation; gas phase; q0 m1; no MaxIter/timeout.
+
+Intended order (when resources exist): 01 → 02 → 03 → (endpoints via 04/05, 08) → 06/07 IRC.
+
+**IRC templates 06/07 — updated per coordinator science-readiness review.** They are **not runnable as-is**
+and must not be submitted until the matching OptTS job converges:
+- **no `MaxSteps`/`MaxIter` cap** (ORCA native defaults govern; no-MaxIter policy was violated by the old `MaxSteps 40`);
+- `Hess_Filename` = **absolute** path to the converged TS Hessian (`…/orca_inputs/02_ts_endo_optts.hess`, `…/03_ts_exo_optts.hess`);
+- `* xyzfile` = the **converged TS geometry** (`02_ts_endo_converged.xyz` / `03_ts_exo_converged.xyz`), **not** the seed `ts_*_guess.xyz`;
+- explicit `Direction both`.
+Re-point both files after 02/03 converge. Endpoints/IRC products are the corrected `product_endo.xyz`
+(CIP 2S,4S,7R) / `product_exo.xyz` (CIP 2S,4S,7S) — **never** the superseded `product_*_seed.xyz`.
+
+**OptTS early-mode checkpoint (02/03).** On the first Hessian, require exactly **1 negative eigenvalue** whose
+mode is the forming pair (2,6)/(4,7); if the Hessian is minimum-like or the soft mode is a different motion,
+**change the guess geometry — do not tune optimizer knobs**.
+
+**Resource status (coordinator):** paratera-cpu is 32/32 (HI1 priority). **HOLD** all HDA_CN QM until capacity
+frees and the monitor confirms the headroom; 8 CPU / %maxcore 1536 (14 GB reserve) is otherwise fine.
+
+## 6. Acceptance gates (before this candidate may replace a hard task)
+1. RC (01) converges to a **0-imaginary** minimum = the common reference energy for both faces.
+2. Each of 02/03 converges to exactly **one imaginary frequency** whose displacement lives on the
+   forming pair (C2,C6),(C4,C7) → pass `watch_pairs=[[2,6],[4,7]]` to `log_parser`.
+3. **Bidirectional IRC** (06/07) connects the RC/separated reactants to the correct **endo vs exo**
+   product (`product_endo.xyz` vs `product_exo.xyz`; CIP 2S,4S,7R vs 2S,4S,7S).
+4. Both IRC endpoints Opt+Freq = 0 imaginary and reproduce the RC (reactant side) and the matching product.
+5. Only then report endo vs exo electronic barriers (relative to the common RC) to `agent_hub` + coordinator.
+   endo/exo near-degeneracy must be reported as measured, never forced.
+
+## 7. Caveats / honesty
+- Literature is solution/experimental background; our gold is **gas-phase electronic** energy — no mixing.
+- MMFF endo/exo ordering (exo lower by ≈1.7 kcal/mol here) is coincidentally the same sign as the
+  literature but is **not** a result and is **not** used.
+- No new mechanistic range: no diradical, no polymerization, no NEB exploration in this candidate.
+- Preparation only; whether the RC is genuinely bound and whether the DA is genuinely concerted are
+  questions for the QM stage, not asserted here.
+
+## 8. Provenance
+`_prep_scratch/` holds the RDKit 2026.03.4 scripts (fragment embedding, rigid alignment, MMFF,
+endo/exo plane test) and the generated `geoms/`. All coordinates are program-generated; none hand-typed.
+Old `product_*_seed.*` and the old GEOMETRY_PREPARATION.json mapping were **not deleted**;
+the mapping JSON here records the corrected labels and the verification anchors.

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+def build(smi, seed=0xf00d):
+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); assert m is not None, smi
+    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, ps)==0, "embed failed "+smi
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=3000)
+    return mh
+
+def signs(mh, ref_idx, probes):
+    conf=mh.GetConformer()
+    P=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ref_idx])
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); n=Vt[-1]
+    return {k: float(np.dot(np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in v]).mean(0)-c, n)) for k,v in probes.items()}

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+def build(smi, seed=0xf00d):
+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    assert m is not None, smi
+    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, ps)
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=2000)
+    return mh
+
+def plane_signs(mh, ref_idx, probe_pairs):
+    conf = mh.GetConformer()
+    P = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ref_idx])
+    c = P.mean(axis=0); U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(P-c); n = Vt[-1]
+    out={}
+    for name, idxs in probe_pairs.items():
+        q = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in idxs]).mean(axis=0)
+        out[name] = float(np.dot(q-c, n))
+    return out
+
+# ---- anchor: CID 2723766 = ENDO (Carbic anhydride) ----
+anchor = "C1[C@@H]2C=C[C@H]1[C@@H]3[C@H]2C(=O)OC3=O"
+m = build(anchor)
+for a in m.GetAtoms():
+    a.SetAtomMapNum(a.GetIdx()+1)   # so map = idx+1
+conf=m.GetConformer()
+# indices 0-based: 0=methano CH2, 1,4=bridgeheads, 2,3=alkene, 5,6=dienophile C, 7,10 carbonyl C, 9 ring O
+ref=[1,2,3,4,5,6]
+probes={"methano(0)":[0], "anhydride_O(9)":[9], "carbonylC_mid(7,10)":[7,10]}
+print("ANCHOR endo ref6ring plane, signed distances:", plane_signs(m, ref, probes))
+# also ref plane of just bridgeheads+dienophile C (2,4,6,7 => idx1,4,5,6)
+print("ANCHOR endo ref{1,4,5,6} plane:", plane_signs(m, [1,4,5,6], probes))
+# print SMILES of anchor
+print("anchor canonical:", Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
+
+# ---- HDA products (mapped) ----
+endo = "[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]"
+exo  = "[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]"
+for tag,smi in [("endoSMILES",endo),("exoSMILES",exo)]:

+    c=m.GetConformer()

+

+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}

+import numpy as np, os, json
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+np.set_printoptions(suppress=True, precision=4)
+OUT="/data/cloudra/workspace/hard_resume_20260930/hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/ts_prep"
+os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+
+def build_opt(smi):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); m=Chem.AddHs(m)
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=7); AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=2000)
+    return m
+def coords(m, idxs=None):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    if idxs is None: idxs=range(m.GetNumAtoms())
+    return {i:np.array(list(c.GetAtomPosition(i))) for i in idxs}
+def hs_on(m,i): return [n.GetIdx() for n in m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors() if m.GetAtomWithIdx(n).GetAtomicNum()==1]
+
+cp=build_opt("[CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH:4]=[CH:5]1")
+an=build_opt("[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]")
+# sanity: heavy-atom order in each SMILES-fragment
+cpH={i:hs_on(cp,i) for i in range(5)}
+anH={i:hs_on(an,i) for i in range(4)}
+print("Cp H counts", {i:len(cpH[i]) for i in range(5)})
+print("AN H counts", {i:len(anH[i]) for i in range(4)})
+
+C=coords(cp); A=coords(an)
+C1,C2,C3,C4,C5=[C[i] for i in range(5)]
+C6,C7,C8,N9=[A[i] for i in range(4)]
+# AN hydrogens
+AN_all=coords(an)
+cpHc=coords(cp)
+
+M=(C2+C4)/2.0
+a=np.linalg.norm(C4-C2); x=(C4-C2)/a
+# diene plane normal from C1,C2,C4,C5
+Pp=np.array([C1,C2,C4,C5]); cc=Pp.mean(0); nrm=np.linalg.svd(Pp-cc)[2][2]
+if np.dot(nrm, C3-M)<0: nrm=-nrm
+y3=(C3-M); y3=y3-np.dot(y3,nrm)*nrm; y3=y3/np.linalg.norm(y3)
+
+L=np.linalg.norm(C7-C6)
+def place(d, cn_toward_C3):
+    h=np.sqrt(max(d**2-((a-L)/2.0)**2, 1e-6))
+    mid=(C6+C7)/2.0
+    e1=(C7-C6)/L
+    v=C8-mid; e2=v-np.dot(v,e1)*e1; e2=e2/np.linalg.norm(e2); e3=np.cross(e1,e2)
+    E1=x; E2=(y3 if cn_toward_C3 else -y3); E3=np.cross(E1,E2)
+    R=np.column_stack([E1,E2,E3]) @ np.column_stack([e1,e2,e3]).T
+    origin=M+h*nrm
+    def T(p): return origin + R@(p-mid)
+    an_new={i:T(AN_all[i]) for i in range(an.GetNumAtoms())}
+    return an_new, h
+
+def assemble(an_new):
+    # heavy order: C1..C5 (cp idx0..4), then C6,C7,C8,N9 (an idx0..3)
+    els=[]; xyz=[]
+    order=[]
+    for i in range(5): order.append(("C",C[i]))
+    for i in range(4): order.append((("N" if i==3 else "C"),an_new[i]))
+    # H's: H(C1),H(C2),H(C3)x2,H(C4),H(C5),H(C6)x2,H(C7)
+    hs=[]
+    for i in range(5):
+        for hh in cpH[i]: hs.append(("H",cpHc[hh]))
+    for i in range(4):
+        for hh in anH[i]: hs.append(("H",an_new[hh]))
+    allat=order+hs
+    return allat
+
+for tag,(d,tow) in {"shared_RC":(2.90,True),"ts_seed_A":(2.20,True),"ts_seed_B":(2.20,False)}.items():
+    an_new,h=place(d,tow)
+    at=assemble(an_new)
+    # report forming distances
+    C2n=[p for e,p in at][1]; C4n=[p for e,p in at][3]; C6n=[p for e,p in at][5]; C7n=[p for e,p in at][6]
+    d26=np.linalg.norm(np.array(C6n)-np.array(C2n)); d47=np.linalg.norm(np.array(C7n)-np.array(C4n))
+    with open(f"{OUT}/{tag}.xyz","w") as f:
+        f.write("%d\n%s forming C2-C6=%.3f C4-C7=%.3f (n=%s)\n"%(len(at),tag,d26,d47,tag))
+        for e,p in at: f.write("%-2s %14.8f %14.8f %14.8f\n"%(e,p[0],p[1],p[2]))
+    print(tag,"C2...C6=%.3f C4...C7=%.3f h=%.3f"%(d26,d47,h))

+import numpy as np

+
+def bridges(mol, allring):
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    Cs=[i for i in allring if isC(i)]
+    bh=[i for i in Cs if len([n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring])==3]
+    # one-carbon bridge
+    oneC=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and set(n for n in nbrs(i) if n in allring)==set(bh)][0]
+    # two-carbon bridges: pairs of ring carbons each bonded to one bridgehead
+    # find non-bridgehead, non-oneC ring carbons
+    rest=[i for i in Cs if i not in bh and i!=oneC]
+    # group them into bridges: two carbons connected and each to a different bridgehead
+    return bh, oneC, rest
+
+def analyze(path,label):
+    mol=Chem.MolFromMolFile(path, removeHs=False)
+    conf=mol.GetConformer()
+    xyz={i:np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)),dtype=float) for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms())}
+    ri=mol.GetRingInfo(); allring=set().union(*[set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()])
+    nbrs=lambda i:[n.GetIdx() for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
+    isC=lambda i: mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()==6
+    bh,oneC,rest=bridges(mol,allring)
+    # substituent-bearing ring carbons (bonded to non-ring C)
+    bearing=[i for i in allring if isC(i) and any(n not in allring and isC(n) for n in nbrs(i))]
+    subst=[n for i in bearing for n in nbrs(i) if n not in allring and isC(n)]
+    # other 2-carbon bridge: rest minus bearing
+    other=[i for i in rest if i not in bearing]
+    # plane: choose bridgeheads + (bearing if >=2 bearing else other)
+    base_atoms = list(bh)+ (list(bearing) if len(bearing)>=2 else list(other))
+    P=np.array([xyz[i] for i in base_atoms]); cc=P.mean(0); n=np.linalg.svd(P-cc)[2][2]
+    sd=lambda i: float(np.dot(xyz[i]-cc,n))
+    print("%-20s bh=%s CH2=%d bearing=%s subst=%s plane_atoms=%s sd(CH2)=%+.2f substsd=%s -> %s"%(
+        label,bh,oneC,bearing,subst,base_atoms,sd(oneC),[round(sd(i),2) for i in subst],
+        ["SAME" if sd(i)*sd(oneC)>0 else "OPP" for i in subst]))
+for cid,lab in [(6541030,"endo-diacid"),(12268642,"exo-methanol"),(721733,"exo-acid"),(12268635,"acid-iso")]:
