+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np, json, os
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+OUT="geoms"; os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
+CP="[CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH:4]=[CH:5]1"; ACN="[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"
+ENDO_PROD="[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]"  # CN anti C3 = ENDO
+EXO_PROD ="[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]"   # CN syn  C3 = EXO
+
+def embed(smi,seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m); ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps); AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000); return mh
+def XYZ(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+def setXYZ(m,X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i,X[i].tolist())
+def plane(P):
+    cen=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-cen); return cen,Vt[-1]
+
+cp=embed(CP); acn=embed(ACN)
+ci={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in cp.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+ai={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in acn.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+Xcp=XYZ(cp); Xacn=XYZ(acn)
+ring=np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in(1,2,3,4,5)]); cen,n=plane(ring)
+x=Xcp[ci[4]]-Xcp[ci[2]]; x=x-np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z=n; y=np.cross(z,x); R=np.vstack([x,y,z]); Xcp2=(Xcp-0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]]))@R.T
+if Xcp2[ci[2],0]>Xcp2[ci[4],0]: Xcp2[:,0]*=-1
+core=np.array([Xacn[ai[6]],Xacn[ai[7]],Xacn[ai[8]]]); cen2,n2=plane(core)
+x2=Xacn[ai[7]]-Xacn[ai[6]]; x2=x2-np.dot(x2,n2)*n2; x2/=np.linalg.norm(x2)
+z2=n2; y2=np.cross(z2,x2); Xa=(Xacn-0.5*(Xacn[ai[6]]+Xacn[ai[7]]))@np.vstack([x2,y2,z2]).T
+
+def complex_geom(h,w,face,fix_heavy=True,target=None):
+    Xa2=Xa.copy(); d=np.linalg.norm(Xa2[ai[7]]-Xa2[ai[6]]); Xa2[:,0]*=(2*w)/d
+    if np.sign(Xa2[ai[8],1])!=face: Xa2[:,1]*=-1.0
+    Xa2[:,2]+=h
+    comb=Chem.CombineMols(cp,acn); setXYZ(comb,np.vstack([Xcp2,Xa2])); Chem.SanitizeMol(comb)
+    mm=Chem.AddHs(comb,addCoords=True); 
+    if mm.GetNumConformers()==0: AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mm)
+    Chem.SanitizeMol(mm); Chem.FastFindRings(mm)
+    mp={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mm); ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mm,props)
+    if target:
+        for i,j in [(2,6),(4,7)]: ff.AddDistanceConstraint(mp[i],mp[j],target,target,400.0)
+    if fix_heavy:
+        for a in mm.GetAtoms():
+            if a.GetAtomicNum()>1: ff.AddFixedPoint(a.GetIdx())
+    ff.Minimize(maxIts=5000)
+    return mm, float(ff.CalcEnergy())
+
+def report(mm):
+    mp={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}; c=mm.GetConformer()
+    P=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[k])) for k in(1,2,4,5,6,7)]); cen,n=plane(P)
+    sd=lambda k: float(np.dot(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[k]))-cen,n))
+    d26=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[2]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[6])))
+    d47=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[4]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[7])))
+    d67=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[6]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[7])))
+    v="ENDO(CN anti C3)" if np.sign(sd(3))!=np.sign(sd(9)) else "EXO(CN syn C3)"
+    return dict(d26=round(d26,3),d47=round(d47,3),d67=round(d67,3),sC3=round(sd(3),3),sC8=round(sd(8),3),sN9=round(sd(9),3),family=v)
+
+def ordered_atoms(mm):
+    # heavy atoms by map asc, then H by parent-map asc
+    heavy=[]; hyd=[]
+    mp={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    idx2map={v:k for k,v in mp.items()}
+    for a in mm.GetAtoms():
+        if a.GetAtomicNum()>1: heavy.append(a.GetIdx())
+        else:
+            nb=[x.GetIdx() for x in a.GetNeighbors() if x.GetAtomicNum()>1]
+            pm=idx2map.get(nb[0],999) if nb else 999
+            hyd.append((pm,a.GetIdx()))
+    heavy.sort(key=lambda i: idx2map[i]); hyd.sort()
+    return heavy+[i for _,i in hyd], mp
+
+def write_xyz(mm,path,comment):
+    order,mp=ordered_atoms(mm); c=mm.GetConformer()
+    L=[str(len(order)), comment]
+    for i in order:
+        p=c.GetAtomPosition(i); L.append(" %-2s %12.6f %12.6f %12.6f"%(mm.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol(),p.x,p.y,p.z))
+    open(path,"w").write("\n".join(L)+"\n")
+
+geom={}
+rc,E=complex_geom(3.15,0.67,+1,fix_heavy=True,target=3.30)
+rc2,E2=complex_geom(3.15,0.67,+1,fix_heavy=False,target=None)  # full relax test
+geom["rc_fixed"]=report(rc); geom["rc_fullrelax"]=report(rc2)
+print("RC fixed-heavy:",geom["rc_fixed"]); print("RC full-relax:",geom["rc_fullrelax"])
+# choose full relax if it stayed a stacked complex, else fixed
+useFull = geom["rc_fullrelax"]["d26"]>2.5 and geom["rc_fullrelax"]["d47"]>2.5
+rc_final = rc2 if useFull else rc
+write_xyz(rc_final, OUT+"/rc_common.xyz", "HDA_CN common reactive complex  C8H9N q0 m1  (CP+acrylonitrile)  "+("MMFF full-relax" if useFull else "MMFF heavy-fixed"))
+print("RC chosen:", "full-relax" if useFull else "fixed-heavy")
+
+ts_e,_=complex_geom(2.18,0.72,+1,fix_heavy=True,target=2.28); write_xyz(ts_e,OUT+"/ts_endo_guess.xyz","HDA_CN concerted DA TS guess ENDO  C8H9N q0 m1")
+ts_x,_=complex_geom(2.18,0.72,-1,fix_heavy=True,target=2.28); write_xyz(ts_x,OUT+"/ts_exo_guess.xyz","HDA_CN concerted DA TS guess EXO   C8H9N q0 m1")
+print("TS_endo:",report(ts_e)); print("TS_exo:",report(ts_x))
+
+for tag,smi in [("endo",ENDO_PROD),("exo",EXO_PROD)]:
+    m=embed(smi,11); write_xyz(m,OUT+"/product_%s.xyz"%tag,"HDA_CN DA product %s  C8H9N q0 m1"%tag)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
+    cip={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetPropsAsDict().get('_CIPCode','-') for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    print("product_%s CIP base:"%tag, {k:cip[k] for k in sorted(cip) if cip[k]!='-'})
+print("DONE")

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+def load(p):
+    m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile(p)
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m, charge=0)
+    return m
+
+def plane(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c,Vt[-1]
+
+def verdict(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    xyz=lambda i: np.array(list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)))
+    mp={i:i for i in range(9)}  # file order: heavy 0..8 = map 1..9
+    # 6-ring plane maps {1,2,4,5,6,7} -> idx {0,1,3,4,5,6}
+    P=np.array([xyz(i) for i in (0,1,3,4,5,6)]); cen,n=plane(P)
+    sd=lambda i: float(np.dot(xyz(i)-cen,n))
+    s3,s9=sd(2),sd(8)   # C3=idx2, N9=idx8
+    return ("ENDO(CN anti C3)" if np.sign(s3)!=np.sign(s9) else "EXO(CN syn C3)"), round(s3,3), round(s9,3)
+
+def cip(m):
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    res={}
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        code=a.GetPropsAsDict().get('_CIPCode')
+        if code: res[a.GetIdx()]=code
+    # map idx->map number (heavy order)
+    return { (i+1):res[i] for i in sorted(res)}
+
+files=[
+ ("MY product_endo.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/orca_inputs/product_endo.xyz"),

+ ("OLD product_exo_seed.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/product_exo_seed.xyz"),
+]
+for label,p in files:
+    m=load(p)
+    v,s3,s9=verdict(m)
+    print("%-28s CIP(by map)=%s  geo=%s (sC3=%+.3f sN9=%+.3f)"%(label,cip(m),v,s3,s9))

+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+import numpy as np
+def show(tag,path):
+    m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile(path); rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m,charge=0)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m); Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
+    print("==",tag,Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m),isomericSmiles=True))
+    print("   dbl:",[(b.GetBeginAtomIdx()+1,b.GetEndAtomIdx()+1,str(b.GetStereo())) for b in m.GetBonds() if b.GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE])
+    print("   CIP:",[(a.GetIdx()+1,a.GetProp("_CIPCode")) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp("_CIPCode")])
+    ri=m.GetRingInfo(); print("   rings:",[list(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()])
+    conf=m.GetConformer()
+    def d(i,j,k,l):
+        p=[np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(x))) for x in (i,j,k,l)]
+        b1,b2,b3=p[1]-p[0],p[2]-p[1],p[3]-p[2]; n1=np.cross(b1,b2); n2=np.cross(b2,b3)
+        return np.degrees(np.arctan2(np.dot(np.cross(n1,n2),b2/np.linalg.norm(b2)),np.dot(n1,n2)))
+    print("   tau C2-C3-C4-C5=%.1f C4-C5-C6-C7=%.1f  d(C2-C7)=%.3f"%(d(1,2,3,4),d(3,4,5,6),np.linalg.norm(np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(1)))-np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(6))))))

+show("89 product endpoint","hard_replacements_20261001/H6PI/ts_prep/endpoint_product_89.xyz")

+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+import numpy as np
+def show(tag,path):
+    m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile(path); rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m,charge=0)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m); Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
+    print("==",tag,Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m),isomericSmiles=True))
+    print("   dbl:",[(b.GetBeginAtomIdx()+1,b.GetEndAtomIdx()+1,str(b.GetStereo())) for b in m.GetBonds() if b.GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE])
+    print("   CIP:",[(a.GetIdx()+1,a.GetProp("_CIPCode")) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp("_CIPCode")])
+    ri=m.GetRingInfo(); print("   rings:",[list(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()])
+    conf=m.GetConformer()
+    def d(i,j,k,l):
+        p=[np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(x))) for x in (i,j,k,l)]
+        b1,b2,b3=p[1]-p[0],p[2]-p[1],p[3]-p[2]; n1=np.cross(b1,b2); n2=np.cross(b2,b3)

+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+import numpy as np
+def show(tag,path):
+    m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile(path); rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m,charge=0)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m); Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
+    print("==",tag,Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m),isomericSmiles=True))
+    print("   dbl:",[(b.GetBeginAtomIdx()+1,b.GetEndAtomIdx()+1,str(b.GetStereo())) for b in m.GetBonds() if b.GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE])
+    print("   CIP:",[(a.GetIdx()+1,a.GetProp("_CIPCode")) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp("_CIPCode")])
+    ri=m.GetRingInfo(); print("   rings:",[list(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()])
+    conf=m.GetConformer()
+    def d(i,j,k,l):
+        p=[np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(x))) for x in (i,j,k,l)]
+        b1,b2,b3=p[1]-p[0],p[2]-p[1],p[3]-p[2]; n1=np.cross(b1,b2); n2=np.cross(b2,b3)
+        return np.degrees(np.arctan2(np.dot(np.cross(n1,n2),b2/np.linalg.norm(b2)),np.dot(n1,n2)))
+    print("   tau C2-C3-C4-C5=%.1f C4-C5-C6-C7=%.1f  d(C2-C7)=%.3f"%(d(1,2,3,4),d(3,4,5,6),np.linalg.norm(np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(1)))-np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(6))))))

+from rdkit import Chem

+import sys
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+def plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, atom_idx):
+    conf = mol.GetConformer()
+    pts = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring_idx])
+    c = pts.mean(axis=0)
+    # normal via SVD (least-squares plane)
+    u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(pts - c)
+    n = vt[2]
+    p = np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(atom_idx)))
+    return float(np.dot(p - c, n))
+
+def mirror(mol):
+    m = Chem.Mol(mol)
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        if a.GetChiralTag() == Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW:
+            a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
+        elif a.GetChiralTag() == Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW:
+            a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW)
+    return m
+
+def analyze(path, ring_idx=None, methyl_idx=None, tag=""):
+    print("="*70)
+    print("FILE:", path, tag)
+    mol = Chem.MolFromXYZFile(path)
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(mol, charge=0)
+    for a in mol.GetAtoms():
+        a.SetAtomMapNum(0)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
+    smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mol)
+    print("  canonical isomeric SMILES (no atom map):", smi)
+    centers = Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False)
+    print("  chiral centers (unmapped, 0-based idx, CIP):", centers)
+    try:
+        inchi = Chem.MolToInchi(mol)
+    except Exception as e:
+        inchi = "ERR: "+str(e)
+    mir = mirror(mol)
+    try:
+        minchi = Chem.MolToInchi(mir)
+        msmi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mir)
+    except Exception as e:
+        minchi = "ERR: "+str(e); msmi="ERR"
+    print("  InChI          :", inchi)
+    print("  mirror InChI   :", minchi)
+    print("  InChI identical (=> achiral/meso):", inchi == minchi)
+    print("  mirror SMILES  :", msmi)
+    # double bond stereo
+    for b in mol.GetBonds():
+        if b.GetBondTypeAsDouble() == 2.0 and b.GetStereo() != Chem.BondStereo.STEREONONE:
+            print("   C=C stereo:", b.GetBeginAtomIdx(), b.GetEndAtomIdx(), b.GetStereo())
+    if ring_idx is not None:
+        d1 = plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, methyl_idx[0])
+        d2 = plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, methyl_idx[1])
+        print("  ring", ring_idx, "methyl signed dists:", round(d1,3), round(d2,3),
+              "=> same side (cis):" , (d1*d2>0))
+
+base = "hard_replacements_20261001/H6PI/"
+analyze(base+"reactant_seed.xyz", tag="(reactant draft)")
+analyze(base+"product_cis_seed.xyz", ring_idx=[1,2,3,4,5,6], methyl_idx=[0,7], tag="(draft product)")
+analyze(base+"ts_prep/product_cis.xyz", ring_idx=[1,2,3,4,5,6], methyl_idx=[0,7], tag="(corrected product)")

+import sys
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds

+    mol = Chem.MolFromXYZFile(path)

+    dbl=[]
+    for b in mol.GetBonds():
+        if b.GetBondTypeAsDouble()==2.0 and b.GetStereo()!=Chem.BondStereo.STEREONONE:
+            dbl.append((b.GetBeginAtomIdx()+1,b.GetEndAtomIdx()+1,str(b.GetStereo())))

+    print(path)
+    print("  SMILES:", smi)
+    print("  centers:", centers)

+import sys
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+def plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, atom_idx):
+    conf = mol.GetConformer()
+    pts = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring_idx])
+    c = pts.mean(axis=0)
+    # normal via SVD (least-squares plane)
+    u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(pts - c)
+    n = vt[2]
+    p = np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(atom_idx)))
+    return float(np.dot(p - c, n))
+
+def mirror(mol):
+    m = Chem.Mol(mol)
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        if a.GetChiralTag() == Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW:
+            a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
+        elif a.GetChiralTag() == Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW:
+            a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW)
+    return m
+
+def analyze(path, ring_idx=None, methyl_idx=None, tag=""):
+    print("="*70)
+    print("FILE:", path, tag)
+    mol = Chem.MolFromXYZFile(path)
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(mol, charge=0)
+    for a in mol.GetAtoms():
+        a.SetAtomMapNum(0)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
+    smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mol)
+    print("  canonical isomeric SMILES (no atom map):", smi)
+    centers = Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False)
+    print("  chiral centers (unmapped, 0-based idx, CIP):", centers)
+    try:
+        inchi = Chem.MolToInchi(mol)
+    except Exception as e:
+        inchi = "ERR: "+str(e)
+    mir = mirror(mol)
+    try:
+        minchi = Chem.MolToInchi(mir)
+        msmi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mir)
+    except Exception as e:
+        minchi = "ERR: "+str(e); msmi="ERR"
+    print("  InChI          :", inchi)
+    print("  mirror InChI   :", minchi)
+    print("  InChI identical (=> achiral/meso):", inchi == minchi)
+    print("  mirror SMILES  :", msmi)
+    # double bond stereo
+    for b in mol.GetBonds():
+        if b.GetBondTypeAsDouble() == 2.0 and b.GetStereo() != Chem.BondStereo.STEREONONE:
+            print("   C=C stereo:", b.GetBeginAtomIdx(), b.GetEndAtomIdx(), b.GetStereo())
+    if ring_idx is not None:
+        d1 = plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, methyl_idx[0])
+        d2 = plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, methyl_idx[1])
+        print("  ring", ring_idx, "methyl signed dists:", round(d1,3), round(d2,3),
+              "=> same side (cis):" , (d1*d2>0))
+
+base = "hard_replacements_20261001/H6PI/"
+analyze(base+"reactant_seed.xyz", tag="(reactant draft)")
+analyze(base+"product_cis_seed.xyz", ring_idx=[1,2,3,4,5,6], methyl_idx=[0,7], tag="(draft product)")

+import sys
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+def plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, atom_idx):
+    conf = mol.GetConformer()
+    pts = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring_idx])
+    c = pts.mean(axis=0)
+    # normal via SVD (least-squares plane)
+    u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(pts - c)
+    n = vt[2]
+    p = np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(atom_idx)))
+    return float(np.dot(p - c, n))
+
+def mirror(mol):
+    m = Chem.Mol(mol)
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        if a.GetChiralTag() == Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW:
+            a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
+        elif a.GetChiralTag() == Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW:
+            a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW)
+    return m
+
+def analyze(path, ring_idx=None, methyl_idx=None, tag=""):
+    print("="*70)
+    print("FILE:", path, tag)
+    mol = Chem.MolFromXYZFile(path)
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(mol, charge=0)
+    for a in mol.GetAtoms():
+        a.SetAtomMapNum(0)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
+    smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mol)
+    print("  canonical isomeric SMILES (no atom map):", smi)
+    centers = Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False)
+    print("  chiral centers (unmapped, 0-based idx, CIP):", centers)
+    try:
+        inchi = Chem.MolToInchi(mol)
+    except Exception as e:
+        inchi = "ERR: "+str(e)
+    mir = mirror(mol)
+    try:
+        minchi = Chem.MolToInchi(mir)
+        msmi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mir)
+    except Exception as e:
+        minchi = "ERR: "+str(e); msmi="ERR"
+    print("  InChI          :", inchi)
+    print("  mirror InChI   :", minchi)
+    print("  InChI identical (=> achiral/meso):", inchi == minchi)
+    print("  mirror SMILES  :", msmi)
+    # double bond stereo
+    for b in mol.GetBonds():
+        if b.GetBondTypeAsDouble() == 2.0 and b.GetStereo() != Chem.BondStereo.STEREONONE:
+            print("   C=C stereo:", b.GetBeginAtomIdx(), b.GetEndAtomIdx(), b.GetStereo())
+    if ring_idx is not None:
+        d1 = plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, methyl_idx[0])
+        d2 = plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, methyl_idx[1])
+        print("  ring", ring_idx, "methyl signed dists:", round(d1,3), round(d2,3),
+              "=> same side (cis):" , (d1*d2>0))
+
+base = "hard_replacements_20261001/H6PI/"
+analyze(base+"reactant_seed.xyz", tag="(reactant draft)")
+analyze(base+"product_cis_seed.xyz", ring_idx=[1,2,3,4,5,6], methyl_idx=[0,7], tag="(draft product)")

+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+import numpy as np
+m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile("hard_replacements_20261001/H6PI/ts_prep/endpoint_reactant_90.xyz")
+rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m,charge=0); Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m); Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
+print("canon:",Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m),isomericSmiles=True))
+print("dbl:",[(b.GetBeginAtomIdx()+1,b.GetEndAtomIdx()+1,str(b.GetStereo())) for b in m.GetBonds() if b.GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE])
+print("CIP:",[(a.GetIdx()+1,a.GetProp("_CIPCode")) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp("_CIPCode")])
+print("rings:",[list(r) for r in m.GetRingInfo().AtomRings()])
+conf=m.GetConformer()
+def d(i,j,k,l):
+    p=[np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(x))) for x in (i,j,k,l)]
+    b1,b2,b3=p[1]-p[0],p[2]-p[1],p[3]-p[2]; n1=np.cross(b1,b2); n2=np.cross(b2,b3)
+    return np.degrees(np.arctan2(np.dot(np.cross(n1,n2),b2/np.linalg.norm(b2)),np.dot(n1,n2)))

+from rdkit import Chem

+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+import numpy as np
+m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile("hard_replacements_20261001/H6PI/ts_prep/endpoint_reactant_90.xyz")
+rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m,charge=0); Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m); Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
+print("canon:",Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m),isomericSmiles=True))
+print("dbl:",[(b.GetBeginAtomIdx()+1,b.GetEndAtomIdx()+1,str(b.GetStereo())) for b in m.GetBonds() if b.GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE])
+print("CIP:",[(a.GetIdx()+1,a.GetProp("_CIPCode")) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp("_CIPCode")])
+print("rings:",[list(r) for r in m.GetRingInfo().AtomRings()])
+conf=m.GetConformer()
+def d(i,j,k,l):
+    p=[np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(x))) for x in (i,j,k,l)]
+    b1,b2,b3=p[1]-p[0],p[2]-p[1],p[3]-p[2]; n1=np.cross(b1,b2); n2=np.cross(b2,b3)
+    return np.degrees(np.arctan2(np.dot(np.cross(n1,n2),b2/np.linalg.norm(b2)),np.dot(n1,n2)))

+import sys
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+def plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, atom_idx):
+    conf = mol.GetConformer()
+    pts = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring_idx])
+    c = pts.mean(axis=0)
+    # normal via SVD (least-squares plane)
+    u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(pts - c)
+    n = vt[2]
+    p = np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(atom_idx)))
+    return float(np.dot(p - c, n))
+
+def mirror(mol):
+    m = Chem.Mol(mol)
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        if a.GetChiralTag() == Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW:
+            a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
+        elif a.GetChiralTag() == Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW:
+            a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW)
+    return m
+
+def analyze(path, ring_idx=None, methyl_idx=None, tag=""):
+    print("="*70)
+    print("FILE:", path, tag)
+    mol = Chem.MolFromXYZFile(path)
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(mol, charge=0)
+    for a in mol.GetAtoms():
+        a.SetAtomMapNum(0)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
+    smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mol)
+    print("  canonical isomeric SMILES (no atom map):", smi)
+    centers = Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False)
+    print("  chiral centers (unmapped, 0-based idx, CIP):", centers)
+    try:
+        inchi = Chem.MolToInchi(mol)
+    except Exception as e:
+        inchi = "ERR: "+str(e)
+    mir = mirror(mol)
+    try:
+        minchi = Chem.MolToInchi(mir)
+        msmi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mir)
+    except Exception as e:
+        minchi = "ERR: "+str(e); msmi="ERR"
+    print("  InChI          :", inchi)
+    print("  mirror InChI   :", minchi)
+    print("  InChI identical (=> achiral/meso):", inchi == minchi)
+    print("  mirror SMILES  :", msmi)
+    # double bond stereo
+    for b in mol.GetBonds():
+        if b.GetBondTypeAsDouble() == 2.0 and b.GetStereo() != Chem.BondStereo.STEREONONE:
+            print("   C=C stereo:", b.GetBeginAtomIdx(), b.GetEndAtomIdx(), b.GetStereo())
+    if ring_idx is not None:
+        d1 = plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, methyl_idx[0])
+        d2 = plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, methyl_idx[1])
+        print("  ring", ring_idx, "methyl signed dists:", round(d1,3), round(d2,3),
+              "=> same side (cis):" , (d1*d2>0))
+
+base = "hard_replacements_20261001/H6PI/"
+analyze(base+"reactant_seed.xyz", tag="(reactant draft)")
+analyze(base+"product_cis_seed.xyz", ring_idx=[1,2,3,4,5,6], methyl_idx=[0,7], tag="(draft product)")
+analyze(base+"ts_prep/product_cis.xyz", ring_idx=[1,2,3,4,5,6], methyl_idx=[0,7], tag="(corrected product)")

+import sys
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+for path in sys.argv[1:]:
+    mol = Chem.MolFromXYZFile(path)
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(mol, charge=0)
+    for a in mol.GetAtoms(): a.SetAtomMapNum(0)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
+    smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mol)
+    centers = Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False)
+    dbl=[]
+    for b in mol.GetBonds():
+        if b.GetBondTypeAsDouble()==2.0 and b.GetStereo()!=Chem.BondStereo.STEREONONE:
+            dbl.append((b.GetBeginAtomIdx()+1,b.GetEndAtomIdx()+1,str(b.GetStereo())))
+    inchi = Chem.MolToInchi(mol)
+    print(path)
+    print("  SMILES:", smi)
+    print("  centers:", centers)
+    print("  C=C:", dbl)
+    print("  InChI has /m layer:", "/m" in inchi, "|", inchi)

+# HDA_CN — Preparation record (cyclopentadiene + acrylonitrile endo/exo Diels–Alder)
+
+**Status: PREPARED ONLY — no QM/xTB submitted.** Deliverable for supervisor resource/scientific review.
+Supersedes the earlier draft mapping in this directory; the *seed* files `product_{endo,exo}_seed.*`
+are retained unchanged but are **mis-labelled (swapped)** — see §2.
+
+## 1. Target and scope
+- Reaction: cyclopentadiene (CP) + acrylonitrile (ACN), concerted Diels–Alder.
+- System: **C8H9N, 9 heavy atoms, 18 atoms, q=0, m=1**; CP is a rigid (s-cis-locked) diene.
+- Goal: locate the **endo** and **exo** concerted DA transition states in the gas phase at one
+  method, and report both barriers (difference from the calculation, **not** pre-set).
+- Source (literature background only, DOI 10.1021/jo400900x, J. Org. Chem. 2013, 78, 6582;
+  PMC3731169): in CP+ACN the concerted DA is preferred over the stepwise diradical by ≈5.9 kcal/mol;
+  endo and exo TS are **essentially isoenergetic**, exo marginally lower (B3LYP/6-31G(d)).
+  We do **not** fit to these numbers and we add **no** new range (no diradical / polymerization
+  pathway in this candidate).
+- Method (fixed by task): **ORCA 6.1.1, B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP RIJCOSX def2/J TightSCF, gas phase**,
+  8 CPU / 14000 MB / maxcore 1536; software-native defaults — **no MaxIter, no Cloudra timeout**.
+
+## 2. Atom mapping and the endo/exo correction (independently verified)
+
+Heavy atoms are listed **by map ascending** in every file (then H's, grouped by their heavy parent).
+
+| map | atom | role |
+|----|------|------|
+| 1,2,4,5 | C | cyclopentadiene ring |
+| 3 | C | **one-carbon (methano) bridge**, CH2 |
+| 6,7 | C | dienophile C=C (from ACN) |
+| 8 | C | nitrile C |
+| 9 | N | nitrile N |
+
+Bond changes: **C2–C6 and C4–C7 form**; C1=C2 and C4=C5 become single; **C1–C5 becomes the new C=C**;
+C6=C7 becomes single. (C1,C5 = diene central carbons; C2,C4 = diene termini.)
+
+**Verification of the endo/exo labels.** The pre-existing draft defined "same side of the
+C2/C4/C6/C7 plane as bridge C3 = endo". I tested this against five *stereo-defined* PubChem
+anchors that are exact structural analogs (substituent on the dienophile-derived bridge):
+
+| anchor (PubChem) | label | measured (substituent vs methano bridge C3) |
+|---|---|---|
+| Carbic anhydride, *cis*-5-norbornene-**endo**-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (CID 2723766) | **endo** | **opposite** side to C3 |
+| *exo*-5-norbornene-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (name lookup) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+| Carbic acid, *endo*-norbornene-*cis*-5,6-dicarboxylic acid (CID 6541030) | **endo** | **opposite** side to C3 |
+| *exo*-5-norbornene-2-carboxylic acid (CID 12268635) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+| *exo*-norbornene-2-carboxylic acid, enantiomer (CID 721733) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+
+Five stereo-defined PubChem references agree, and the result is robust across two independent
+reference planes (6-membered ring {1,2,4,5,6,7} and bridgehead+dienophile {2,4,6,7}).
+The parallel `verification/` effort in this directory (scripts + SDFs) independently reproduced
+the same rule.

+> **Convention (verified): exo = the dienophile substituent is on the SAME side as the one-carbon
+> (methano) bridge C3; endo = OPPOSITE side of C3 (same side as the new alkene C1=C5).**

+    ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed

+    conf = mh.GetConformer()
+    P = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ref_idx])

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np, json
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+CP  = "[CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH:4]=[CH:5]1"
+ACN = "[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"
+
+def embed(smi, seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps)==0
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000)
+    return mh
+
+def coords(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+
+def setcoords(m, X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
+
+def mapidx(m):
+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+
+def bestfit_plane_normal(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c, Vt[-1]
+
+cp = embed(CP); acn = embed(ACN)
+ci = mapidx(cp); ai = mapidx(acn)
+Xcp = coords(cp); Xacn = coords(acn)
+
+# --- align cyclopentadiene: ring plane -> z=0, C2..C4 along x, centered at origin ---
+ring = np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in (1,2,3,4,5)])
+cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(ring)
+# build frame: z = n ; x = (C4-C2) projected ; y = z cross x
+x = Xcp[ci[4]] - Xcp[ci[2]]; x = x - np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z = n; y = np.cross(z,x)
+R = np.vstack([x,y,z])   # rows
+mid = 0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]])
+Xcp2 = (Xcp - mid) @ R.T
+# now C2..C4 on x axis; make C2 negative x
+if Xcp2[ci[2],0] > Xcp2[ci[4],0]:
+    Xcp2[:,0]*=-1
+L = abs(Xcp2[ci[4],0]); print("CP C2..C4 half-length L=%.3f  dist=%.3f"%(L, 2*L))
+print("  C3 y after align = %+.3f (methano side)"%Xcp2[ci[3],1])
+
+# --- orient acrylonitrile: C6=C7 along x, plane normal z, place at height h ---
+# dienophile local plane = C6,C7,C8 (sp2 core). normal -> z; C6->C7 -> x
+core = np.array([Xacn[ai[6]], Xacn[ai[7]], Xacn[ai[8]]])
+cen2, n2 = bestfit_plane_normal(core)
+x2 = Xacn[ai[7]] - Xacn[ai[6]]; x2 = x2 - np.dot(x2,n2)*n2; x2/=np.linalg.norm(x2)
+z2 = n2; y2 = np.cross(z2,x2); R2=np.vstack([x2,y2,z2])
+Xa = (Xacn - 0.5*(Xacn[ai[6]]+Xacn[ai[7]])) @ R2.T
+
+def assemble(h, w, cn_sign, forming=None):
+    """place dienophile C6,C7 at (-w,h),( +w,h); CN (+y2 already) choose sign by mirroring y.
+       returns combined mol with coords."""
+    Xa2 = Xa.copy()
+    # center dienophile at its own C6,C7 midpoint already; GLOBAL x offset = 0, y=0, z=h
+    # dienophile local x-axis = C6->C7 ; we want C6 at -w, C7 at +w : scale to bond length then set
+    d67 = np.linalg.norm(Xa2[ai[7]]-Xa2[ai[6]])
+    Xa2[:,0] *= (2*w)/d67
+    Xa2[:,1] *= cn_sign
+    Xa2[:,2] += h
+    comb = Chem.CombineMols(Chem.RemoveHs(cp), Chem.RemoveHs(acn))  # heavy only
+    X = np.vstack([Xcp2, Xa2])
+    setcoords(comb, X)
+    return comb
+
+def mmff_relax(comb, map_pairs, target, force=100.0, iters=3000):
+    mm = Chem.AddHs(comb, addCoords=True)
+    Chem.SanitizeMol(mm); Chem.FastFindRings(mm)

+def XYZ(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+def setXYZ(m,X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i,X[i].tolist())

+ring=np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in(1,2,3,4,5)]); cen,n=plane(ring)

+CP="[CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH:4]=[CH:5]1"; ACN="[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"

+EXO_PROD ="[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]"   # CN syn  C3 = EXO
+
+def embed(smi,seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m); ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps); AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000); return mh
+def XYZ(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+def setXYZ(m,X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i,X[i].tolist())
+def plane(P):
+    cen=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-cen); return cen,Vt[-1]
+
+cp=embed(CP); acn=embed(ACN)
+ci={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in cp.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+ai={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in acn.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+Xcp=XYZ(cp); Xacn=XYZ(acn)
+ring=np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in(1,2,3,4,5)]); cen,n=plane(ring)
+x=Xcp[ci[4]]-Xcp[ci[2]]; x=x-np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z=n; y=np.cross(z,x); R=np.vstack([x,y,z]); Xcp2=(Xcp-0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]]))@R.T

+x2=Xacn[ai[7]]-Xacn[ai[6]]; x2=x2-np.dot(x2,n2)*n2; x2/=np.linalg.norm(x2)
+z2=n2; y2=np.cross(z2,x2); Xa=(Xacn-0.5*(Xacn[ai[6]]+Xacn[ai[7]]))@np.vstack([x2,y2,z2]).T
+
+def complex_geom(h,w,face,fix_heavy=True,target=None):
+    Xa2=Xa.copy(); d=np.linalg.norm(Xa2[ai[7]]-Xa2[ai[6]]); Xa2[:,0]*=(2*w)/d
+    if np.sign(Xa2[ai[8],1])!=face: Xa2[:,1]*=-1.0
+    Xa2[:,2]+=h
+    comb=Chem.CombineMols(cp,acn); setXYZ(comb,np.vstack([Xcp2,Xa2])); Chem.SanitizeMol(comb)
+    mm=Chem.AddHs(comb,addCoords=True); 
+    if mm.GetNumConformers()==0: AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mm)
+    Chem.SanitizeMol(mm); Chem.FastFindRings(mm)

+    props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mm); ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mm,props)
+    if target:
+        for i,j in [(2,6),(4,7)]: ff.AddDistanceConstraint(mp[i],mp[j],target,target,400.0)
+    if fix_heavy:
+        for a in mm.GetAtoms():
+            if a.GetAtomicNum()>1: ff.AddFixedPoint(a.GetIdx())
+    ff.Minimize(maxIts=5000)
+    return mm, float(ff.CalcEnergy())
+
+def report(mm):

+    P=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[k])) for k in(1,2,4,5,6,7)]); cen,n=plane(P)
+    sd=lambda k: float(np.dot(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[k]))-cen,n))
+    d26=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[2]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[6])))
+    d47=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[4]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[7])))
+    d67=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[6]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[7])))
+    v="ENDO(CN anti C3)" if np.sign(sd(3))!=np.sign(sd(9)) else "EXO(CN syn C3)"
+    return dict(d26=round(d26,3),d47=round(d47,3),d67=round(d67,3),sC3=round(sd(3),3),sC8=round(sd(8),3),sN9=round(sd(9),3),family=v)
+
+def ordered_atoms(mm):

+    for a in mm.GetAtoms():

+        else:
+            nb=[x.GetIdx() for x in a.GetNeighbors() if x.GetAtomicNum()>1]
+            pm=idx2map.get(nb[0],999) if nb else 999
+            hyd.append((pm,a.GetIdx()))
+    heavy.sort(key=lambda i: idx2map[i]); hyd.sort()
+    return heavy+[i for _,i in hyd], mp
+
+def write_xyz(mm,path,comment):

+    L=[str(len(order)), comment]

+        p=c.GetAtomPosition(i); L.append(" %-2s %12.6f %12.6f %12.6f"%(mm.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol(),p.x,p.y,p.z))
+    open(path,"w").write("\n".join(L)+"\n")
+
+geom={}
+rc,E=complex_geom(3.15,0.67,+1,fix_heavy=True,target=3.30)
+rc2,E2=complex_geom(3.15,0.67,+1,fix_heavy=False,target=None)  # full relax test

+print("TS_endo:",report(ts_e)); print("TS_exo:",report(ts_x))
+
+for tag,smi in [("endo",ENDO_PROD),("exo",EXO_PROD)]:
+    m=embed(smi,11); write_xyz(m,OUT+"/product_%s.xyz"%tag,"HDA_CN DA product %s  C8H9N q0 m1"%tag)

+    print("product_%s CIP base:"%tag, {k:cip[k] for k in sorted(cip) if cip[k]!='-'})
+print("DONE")

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+def load(p):
+    m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile(p)
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m, charge=0)
+    return m
+
+def plane(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c,Vt[-1]
+
+def verdict(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    xyz=lambda i: np.array(list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)))
+    mp={i:i for i in range(9)}  # file order: heavy 0..8 = map 1..9
+    # 6-ring plane maps {1,2,4,5,6,7} -> idx {0,1,3,4,5,6}
+    P=np.array([xyz(i) for i in (0,1,3,4,5,6)]); cen,n=plane(P)
+    sd=lambda i: float(np.dot(xyz(i)-cen,n))
+    s3,s9=sd(2),sd(8)   # C3=idx2, N9=idx8
+    return ("ENDO(CN anti C3)" if np.sign(s3)!=np.sign(s9) else "EXO(CN syn C3)"), round(s3,3), round(s9,3)
+
+def cip(m):
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    res={}
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        code=a.GetPropsAsDict().get('_CIPCode')
+        if code: res[a.GetIdx()]=code
+    # map idx->map number (heavy order)
+    return { (i+1):res[i] for i in sorted(res)}
+
+files=[
+ ("MY product_endo.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/orca_inputs/product_endo.xyz"),
+ ("MY product_exo.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/orca_inputs/product_exo.xyz"),
+ ("OLD product_endo_seed.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/product_endo_seed.xyz"),
+ ("OLD product_exo_seed.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/product_exo_seed.xyz"),
+]
+for label,p in files:
+    m=load(p)
+    v,s3,s9=verdict(m)
+    print("%-28s CIP(by map)=%s  geo=%s (sC3=%+.3f sN9=%+.3f)"%(label,cip(m),v,s3,s9))

+import sys
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+def plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, atom_idx):
+    conf = mol.GetConformer()
+    pts = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring_idx])
+    c = pts.mean(axis=0)
+    # normal via SVD (least-squares plane)
+    u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(pts - c)
+    n = vt[2]
+    p = np.array(list(conf.GetAtomPosition(atom_idx)))
+    return float(np.dot(p - c, n))
+
+def mirror(mol):
+    m = Chem.Mol(mol)
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        if a.GetChiralTag() == Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW:
+            a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
+        elif a.GetChiralTag() == Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW:
+            a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW)
+    return m
+
+def analyze(path, ring_idx=None, methyl_idx=None, tag=""):
+    print("="*70)
+    print("FILE:", path, tag)
+    mol = Chem.MolFromXYZFile(path)
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(mol, charge=0)
+    for a in mol.GetAtoms():
+        a.SetAtomMapNum(0)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
+    smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mol)
+    print("  canonical isomeric SMILES (no atom map):", smi)
+    centers = Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False)
+    print("  chiral centers (unmapped, 0-based idx, CIP):", centers)
+    try:
+        inchi = Chem.MolToInchi(mol)
+    except Exception as e:
+        inchi = "ERR: "+str(e)
+    mir = mirror(mol)
+    try:
+        minchi = Chem.MolToInchi(mir)
+        msmi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mir)
+    except Exception as e:
+        minchi = "ERR: "+str(e); msmi="ERR"
+    print("  InChI          :", inchi)
+    print("  mirror InChI   :", minchi)
+    print("  InChI identical (=> achiral/meso):", inchi == minchi)
+    print("  mirror SMILES  :", msmi)
+    # double bond stereo
+    for b in mol.GetBonds():
+        if b.GetBondTypeAsDouble() == 2.0 and b.GetStereo() != Chem.BondStereo.STEREONONE:
+            print("   C=C stereo:", b.GetBeginAtomIdx(), b.GetEndAtomIdx(), b.GetStereo())
+    if ring_idx is not None:
+        d1 = plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, methyl_idx[0])
+        d2 = plane_signed_dist(mol, ring_idx, methyl_idx[1])
+        print("  ring", ring_idx, "methyl signed dists:", round(d1,3), round(d2,3),
+              "=> same side (cis):" , (d1*d2>0))
+
+base = "hard_replacements_20261001/H6PI/"
+analyze(base+"reactant_seed.xyz", tag="(reactant draft)")
+analyze(base+"product_cis_seed.xyz", ring_idx=[1,2,3,4,5,6], methyl_idx=[0,7], tag="(draft product)")
+analyze(base+"ts_prep/product_cis.xyz", ring_idx=[1,2,3,4,5,6], methyl_idx=[0,7], tag="(corrected product)")

+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+

+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
+
+def mapidx(m):
+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+
+def bestfit_plane_normal(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c, Vt[-1]

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+def load(p):
+    m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile(p)
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m, charge=0)
+    return m
+
+def plane(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c,Vt[-1]
+
+def verdict(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    xyz=lambda i: np.array(list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)))
+    mp={i:i for i in range(9)}  # file order: heavy 0..8 = map 1..9
+    # 6-ring plane maps {1,2,4,5,6,7} -> idx {0,1,3,4,5,6}
+    P=np.array([xyz(i) for i in (0,1,3,4,5,6)]); cen,n=plane(P)
+    sd=lambda i: float(np.dot(xyz(i)-cen,n))
+    s3,s9=sd(2),sd(8)   # C3=idx2, N9=idx8
+    return ("ENDO(CN anti C3)" if np.sign(s3)!=np.sign(s9) else "EXO(CN syn C3)"), round(s3,3), round(s9,3)
+
+def cip(m):
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    res={}
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        code=a.GetPropsAsDict().get('_CIPCode')
+        if code: res[a.GetIdx()]=code
+    # map idx->map number (heavy order)
+    return { (i+1):res[i] for i in sorted(res)}
+
+files=[
+ ("MY product_endo.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/orca_inputs/product_endo.xyz"),
+ ("MY product_exo.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/orca_inputs/product_exo.xyz"),
+ ("OLD product_endo_seed.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/product_endo_seed.xyz"),
+ ("OLD product_exo_seed.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/product_exo_seed.xyz"),
+]
+for label,p in files:
+    m=load(p)
+    v,s3,s9=verdict(m)
+    print("%-28s CIP(by map)=%s  geo=%s (sC3=%+.3f sN9=%+.3f)"%(label,cip(m),v,s3,s9))

+from rdkit import Chem

+    flat=Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.MolFromSmiles(Chem.MolToSmiles(m,isomericSmiles=False)))
+    print(tag,"|",Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m),"| flat-canon:",flat,"| InChIKey:",Chem.MolToInchiKey(m))
+    # nitrile attachment: which ring-bridge does the CN carbon attach to?
+    m2=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); ri=m2.GetRingInfo()
+    for a in m2.GetAtoms():
+        if a.GetSymbol()=="C" and any(n.GetSymbol()=="N" and m2.GetBondBetweenAtoms(a.GetIdx(),n.GetIdx()).GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.TRIPLE for n in a.GetNeighbors()):

+            ringnb=[x for x in nb if any(x in r for r in ri.AtomRings())]
+            ringdeg=[len([y for y in m2.GetAtomWithIdx(x).GetNeighbors() if any(y.GetIdx() in r for r in ri.AtomRings())]) for x in ringnb]
+            print("   nitrile C idx",a.GetIdx(),"attached to ring atom(s)",ringnb,"ring-degree(s)",ringdeg)

+# HDA_CN — Preparation record (cyclopentadiene + acrylonitrile endo/exo Diels–Alder)
+
+**Status: PREPARED ONLY — no QM/xTB submitted.** Deliverable for supervisor resource/scientific review.
+Supersedes the earlier draft mapping in this directory; the *seed* files `product_{endo,exo}_seed.*`
+are retained unchanged but are **mis-labelled (swapped)** — see §2.
+
+## 1. Target and scope
+- Reaction: cyclopentadiene (CP) + acrylonitrile (ACN), concerted Diels–Alder.
+- System: **C8H9N, 9 heavy atoms, 18 atoms, q=0, m=1**; CP is a rigid (s-cis-locked) diene.
+- Goal: locate the **endo** and **exo** concerted DA transition states in the gas phase at one
+  method, and report both barriers (difference from the calculation, **not** pre-set).
+- Source (literature background only, DOI 10.1021/jo400900x, J. Org. Chem. 2013, 78, 6582;
+  PMC3731169): in CP+ACN the concerted DA is preferred over the stepwise diradical by ≈5.9 kcal/mol;
+  endo and exo TS are **essentially isoenergetic**, exo marginally lower (B3LYP/6-31G(d)).
+  We do **not** fit to these numbers and we add **no** new range (no diradical / polymerization
+  pathway in this candidate).
+- Method (fixed by task): **ORCA 6.1.1, B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP RIJCOSX def2/J TightSCF, gas phase**,
+  8 CPU / 14000 MB / maxcore 1536; software-native defaults — **no MaxIter, no Cloudra timeout**.
+
+## 2. Atom mapping and the endo/exo correction (independently verified)
+
+Heavy atoms are listed **by map ascending** in every file (then H's, grouped by their heavy parent).
+
+| map | atom | role |
+|----|------|------|
+| 1,2,4,5 | C | cyclopentadiene ring |
+| 3 | C | **one-carbon (methano) bridge**, CH2 |
+| 6,7 | C | dienophile C=C (from ACN) |
+| 8 | C | nitrile C |
+| 9 | N | nitrile N |
+
+Bond changes: **C2–C6 and C4–C7 form**; C1=C2 and C4=C5 become single; **C1–C5 becomes the new C=C**;
+C6=C7 becomes single. (C1,C5 = diene central carbons; C2,C4 = diene termini.)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+def build(smi, seed=0xf00d):
+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    assert m is not None, smi
+    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, ps)
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=2000)
+    return mh
+
+def plane_signs(mh, ref_idx, probe_pairs):
+    conf = mh.GetConformer()
+    P = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ref_idx])
+    c = P.mean(axis=0); U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(P-c); n = Vt[-1]
+    out={}
+    for name, idxs in probe_pairs.items():
+        q = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in idxs]).mean(axis=0)
+        out[name] = float(np.dot(q-c, n))
+    return out

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np, json
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+CP  = "[CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH:4]=[CH:5]1"
+ACN = "[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"
+
+def embed(smi, seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps)==0
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000)
+    return mh
+
+def coords(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+
+def setcoords(m, X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
+
+def mapidx(m):
+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+
+def bestfit_plane_normal(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c, Vt[-1]
+
+cp = embed(CP); acn = embed(ACN)
+ci = mapidx(cp); ai = mapidx(acn)
+Xcp = coords(cp); Xacn = coords(acn)
+
+# --- align cyclopentadiene: ring plane -> z=0, C2..C4 along x, centered at origin ---
+ring = np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in (1,2,3,4,5)])
+cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(ring)
+# build frame: z = n ; x = (C4-C2) projected ; y = z cross x
+x = Xcp[ci[4]] - Xcp[ci[2]]; x = x - np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z = n; y = np.cross(z,x)
+R = np.vstack([x,y,z])   # rows
+mid = 0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]])
+Xcp2 = (Xcp - mid) @ R.T
+# now C2..C4 on x axis; make C2 negative x
+if Xcp2[ci[2],0] > Xcp2[ci[4],0]:
+    Xcp2[:,0]*=-1
+L = abs(Xcp2[ci[4],0]); print("CP C2..C4 half-length L=%.3f  dist=%.3f"%(L, 2*L))
+print("  C3 y after align = %+.3f (methano side)"%Xcp2[ci[3],1])
+
+# --- orient acrylonitrile: C6=C7 along x, plane normal z, place at height h ---
+# dienophile local plane = C6,C7,C8 (sp2 core). normal -> z; C6->C7 -> x
+core = np.array([Xacn[ai[6]], Xacn[ai[7]], Xacn[ai[8]]])
+cen2, n2 = bestfit_plane_normal(core)
+x2 = Xacn[ai[7]] - Xacn[ai[6]]; x2 = x2 - np.dot(x2,n2)*n2; x2/=np.linalg.norm(x2)
+z2 = n2; y2 = np.cross(z2,x2); R2=np.vstack([x2,y2,z2])
+Xa = (Xacn - 0.5*(Xacn[ai[6]]+Xacn[ai[7]])) @ R2.T
+
+def assemble(h, w, cn_sign, forming=None):
+    """place dienophile C6,C7 at (-w,h),( +w,h); CN (+y2 already) choose sign by mirroring y.
+       returns combined mol with coords."""
+    Xa2 = Xa.copy()
+    # center dienophile at its own C6,C7 midpoint already; GLOBAL x offset = 0, y=0, z=h
+    # dienophile local x-axis = C6->C7 ; we want C6 at -w, C7 at +w : scale to bond length then set
+    d67 = np.linalg.norm(Xa2[ai[7]]-Xa2[ai[6]])
+    Xa2[:,0] *= (2*w)/d67
+    Xa2[:,1] *= cn_sign
+    Xa2[:,2] += h
+    comb = Chem.CombineMols(Chem.RemoveHs(cp), Chem.RemoveHs(acn))  # heavy only
+    X = np.vstack([Xcp2, Xa2])
+    setcoords(comb, X)
+    return comb
+
+def mmff_relax(comb, map_pairs, target, force=100.0, iters=3000):
+    mm = Chem.AddHs(comb, addCoords=True)
+    Chem.SanitizeMol(mm); Chem.FastFindRings(mm)
+    mp = {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mm); ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mm,props)
+    for (i,j) in map_pairs: ff.AddDistanceConstraint(mp[i],mp[j],target,target,force)
+    ff.Minimize(maxIts=iters)
+    return mm, ff.CalcEnergy()
+
+def signs(mh, ref_maps, mp, probes):
+    c=mh.GetConformer()
+    idx={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mh.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    P=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[k])) for k in ref_maps]); cen, n = bestfit_plane_normal(P)
+    out={}
+    for name,keys in probes.items():
+        q=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[k])) for k in keys]).mean(0)
+        out[name]=float(np.dot(q-cen,n))
+    return out
+
+# Build RC (forming ~3.4) and TS guesses (forming ~2.25), both CN faces
+results={}

+        c=mh.GetConformer()
+        idx={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mh.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+        d26=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[2]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[6])))
+        d47=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[4]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(idx[7])))
+        s=signs(mh,(1,2,4,5,6,7),None,{"C3":[3],"C8":[8],"N9":[9]})
+        verdict = "EXO(CN syn C3)" if np.sign(s["C3"])==np.sign(s["N9"]) else "ENDO(CN anti C3)"
+        print("%s %-7s  E=%8.3f  d(C2-C6)=%.3f d(C4-C7)=%.3f  | C3=%+.3f C8=%+.3f N9=%+.3f -> %s"%(
+              label,face,E,d26,d47,s["C3"],s["C8"],s["N9"],verdict))
+        results[(label,face)]=(mh,E,verdict,s)

+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

+OUT="geoms"; os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
+CP="[CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH:4]=[CH:5]1"; ACN="[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"
+ENDO_PROD="[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]"  # CN anti C3 = ENDO
+EXO_PROD ="[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]"   # CN syn  C3 = EXO
+
+def embed(smi,seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m); ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps); AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000); return mh
+def XYZ(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+def setXYZ(m,X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i,X[i].tolist())
+def plane(P):
+    cen=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-cen); return cen,Vt[-1]
+
+cp=embed(CP); acn=embed(ACN)
+ci={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in cp.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+ai={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in acn.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+Xcp=XYZ(cp); Xacn=XYZ(acn)
+ring=np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in(1,2,3,4,5)]); cen,n=plane(ring)
+x=Xcp[ci[4]]-Xcp[ci[2]]; x=x-np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z=n; y=np.cross(z,x); R=np.vstack([x,y,z]); Xcp2=(Xcp-0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]]))@R.T

+core=np.array([Xacn[ai[6]],Xacn[ai[7]],Xacn[ai[8]]]); cen2,n2=plane(core)
+x2=Xacn[ai[7]]-Xacn[ai[6]]; x2=x2-np.dot(x2,n2)*n2; x2/=np.linalg.norm(x2)
+z2=n2; y2=np.cross(z2,x2); Xa=(Xacn-0.5*(Xacn[ai[6]]+Xacn[ai[7]]))@np.vstack([x2,y2,z2]).T
+

+    Xa2=Xa.copy(); d=np.linalg.norm(Xa2[ai[7]]-Xa2[ai[6]]); Xa2[:,0]*=(2*w)/d
+    if np.sign(Xa2[ai[8],1])!=face: Xa2[:,1]*=-1.0
+    Xa2[:,2]+=h
+    comb=Chem.CombineMols(cp,acn); setXYZ(comb,np.vstack([Xcp2,Xa2])); Chem.SanitizeMol(comb)

+    Chem.SanitizeMol(mm); Chem.FastFindRings(mm)

+        for i,j in [(2,6),(4,7)]: ff.AddDistanceConstraint(mp[i],mp[j],target,target,400.0)
+    if fix_heavy:
+        for a in mm.GetAtoms():
+            if a.GetAtomicNum()>1: ff.AddFixedPoint(a.GetIdx())
+    ff.Minimize(maxIts=5000)
+    return mm, float(ff.CalcEnergy())
+
+def report(mm):
+    mp={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}; c=mm.GetConformer()
+    P=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[k])) for k in(1,2,4,5,6,7)]); cen,n=plane(P)
+    sd=lambda k: float(np.dot(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[k]))-cen,n))
+    d26=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[2]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[6])))
+    d47=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[4]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[7])))
+    d67=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[6]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[7])))
+    v="ENDO(CN anti C3)" if np.sign(sd(3))!=np.sign(sd(9)) else "EXO(CN syn C3)"
+    return dict(d26=round(d26,3),d47=round(d47,3),d67=round(d67,3),sC3=round(sd(3),3),sC8=round(sd(8),3),sN9=round(sd(9),3),family=v)
+

+    mp={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}

+            pm=idx2map.get(nb[0],999) if nb else 999
+            hyd.append((pm,a.GetIdx()))
+    heavy.sort(key=lambda i: idx2map[i]); hyd.sort()

+

+

+print("TS_endo:",report(ts_e)); print("TS_exo:",report(ts_x))
+
+for tag,smi in [("endo",ENDO_PROD),("exo",EXO_PROD)]:
+    m=embed(smi,11); write_xyz(m,OUT+"/product_%s.xyz"%tag,"HDA_CN DA product %s  C8H9N q0 m1"%tag)

+    print("product_%s CIP base:"%tag, {k:cip[k] for k in sorted(cip) if cip[k]!='-'})
+print("DONE")

+def plane(P):
+    cen=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-cen); return cen,Vt[-1]
+def order_maps(mm):
+    mp={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    i2m={v:k for k,v in mp.items()}; heavy=[];hyd=[]
+    for a in mm.GetAtoms():
+        if a.GetAtomicNum()>1: heavy.append(a.GetIdx())
+        else:
+            nb=[x.GetIdx() for x in a.GetNeighbors() if x.GetAtomicNum()>1]
+            hyd.append((i2m.get(nb[0],999) if nb else 999,a.GetIdx()))
+    heavy.sort(key=lambda i:i2m[i]); hyd.sort()
+    return heavy+[i for _,i in hyd], i2m
+def table(mm):
+    order,i2m=order_maps(mm); rows=[]; n=0

+        a=mm.GetAtomWithIdx(i); n+=1
+        rows.append({"index_1":n,"element":a.GetSymbol(),"map":i2m.get(i,0),
+                     "parent_map":(i2m.get([x.GetIdx() for x in a.GetNeighbors() if x.GetAtomicNum()>1][0],0) if a.GetAtomicNum()==1 else 0)})
+    return rows,order,i2m
+

+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mm,cleanIt=True,force=True)

+    return res

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+def load(p):
+    m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile(p)
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m, charge=0)
+    return m
+
+def plane(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c,Vt[-1]
+
+def verdict(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    xyz=lambda i: np.array(list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)))
+    mp={i:i for i in range(9)}  # file order: heavy 0..8 = map 1..9
+    # 6-ring plane maps {1,2,4,5,6,7} -> idx {0,1,3,4,5,6}
+    P=np.array([xyz(i) for i in (0,1,3,4,5,6)]); cen,n=plane(P)
+    sd=lambda i: float(np.dot(xyz(i)-cen,n))
+    s3,s9=sd(2),sd(8)   # C3=idx2, N9=idx8
+    return ("ENDO(CN anti C3)" if np.sign(s3)!=np.sign(s9) else "EXO(CN syn C3)"), round(s3,3), round(s9,3)
+
+def cip(m):
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    res={}
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        code=a.GetPropsAsDict().get('_CIPCode')
+        if code: res[a.GetIdx()]=code
+    # map idx->map number (heavy order)
+    return { (i+1):res[i] for i in sorted(res)}
+
+files=[
+ ("MY product_endo.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/orca_inputs/product_endo.xyz"),
+ ("MY product_exo.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/orca_inputs/product_exo.xyz"),
+ ("OLD product_endo_seed.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/product_endo_seed.xyz"),
+ ("OLD product_exo_seed.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/product_exo_seed.xyz"),
+]
+for label,p in files:
+    m=load(p)
+    v,s3,s9=verdict(m)
+    print("%-28s CIP(by map)=%s  geo=%s (sC3=%+.3f sN9=%+.3f)"%(label,cip(m),v,s3,s9))

+import sys
+from rdkit import Chem
+import networkx as nx
+def analyze(tag,smi):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); ri=m.GetRingInfo()
+    rings=[set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()]
+    # atoms in >1 ring (bicyclic core)
+    core={}
+    for r in rings:
+        for a in r: core[a]=core.get(a,0)+1
+    coreatoms={a for a,c in core.items() if c>=2}
+    G=nx.Graph()
+    for b in m.GetBonds():
+        i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx()
+        if i in coreatoms and j in coreatoms: G.add_edge(i,j)
+    bh=[a for a in coreatoms if G.degree(a)==3]
+    # CN carbon of nitrile
+    nC=None
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        if a.GetSymbol()=="C":
+            for n in a.GetNeighbors():
+                if n.GetSymbol()=="N" and m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(a.GetIdx(),n.GetIdx()).GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.TRIPLE:
+                    nC=a.GetIdx()
+    # bridges: simple paths between the two bridgeheads
+    import itertools
+    b1,b2=bh
+    paths=list(nx.all_simple_paths(G,b1,b2))
+    print(tag, "| ring-#atoms for CN-bearing atom:", core.get(nC,0), "| bridgeheads", bh)
+    for p in paths:
+        inner=p[1:-1]
+        bears = nC in inner
+        print("    bridge atoms",p,"len(inner)=",len(inner), ("<== bears CN" if bears else ""))
+analyze("B3-declared", "N#C[C@H]1[C@@H]2C=C[C@H]1CC2")
+analyze("our-endo(QM)", "N#C[C@H]1C[C@H]2C=C[C@@H]1C2")

+    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps)==0

+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])

+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
+
+def mapidx(m):
+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}

+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c, Vt[-1]

+z = n; y = np.cross(z,x)

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+def load(p):
+    m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile(p)
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m, charge=0)
+    return m
+
+def plane(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c,Vt[-1]
+
+def verdict(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    xyz=lambda i: np.array(list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)))
+    mp={i:i for i in range(9)}  # file order: heavy 0..8 = map 1..9
+    # 6-ring plane maps {1,2,4,5,6,7} -> idx {0,1,3,4,5,6}
+    P=np.array([xyz(i) for i in (0,1,3,4,5,6)]); cen,n=plane(P)
+    sd=lambda i: float(np.dot(xyz(i)-cen,n))
+    s3,s9=sd(2),sd(8)   # C3=idx2, N9=idx8
+    return ("ENDO(CN anti C3)" if np.sign(s3)!=np.sign(s9) else "EXO(CN syn C3)"), round(s3,3), round(s9,3)
+
+def cip(m):
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    res={}
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        code=a.GetPropsAsDict().get('_CIPCode')
+        if code: res[a.GetIdx()]=code
+    # map idx->map number (heavy order)
+    return { (i+1):res[i] for i in sorted(res)}
+
+files=[
+ ("MY product_endo.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/orca_inputs/product_endo.xyz"),
+ ("MY product_exo.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/orca_inputs/product_exo.xyz"),
+ ("OLD product_endo_seed.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/product_endo_seed.xyz"),
+ ("OLD product_exo_seed.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/product_exo_seed.xyz"),
+]
+for label,p in files:
+    m=load(p)
+    v,s3,s9=verdict(m)
+    print("%-28s CIP(by map)=%s  geo=%s (sC3=%+.3f sN9=%+.3f)"%(label,cip(m),v,s3,s9))

+import re
+L='.cloudra/calc-64.out.log'
+pat=re.compile(r'^\s*(\d+)\.\s+([BAD])\(([^)]*)\)\s+([-\d.]+)\s+([-\d.]+)\s+([-\d.]+)\s+([-\d.]+)(?:\s+([-\d.]+))?\s*$')
+cyc=None; comp={}; cur=[]
+for ln in open(L,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace'):
+    m=re.search(r'GEOMETRY OPTIMIZATION CYCLE\s+(\d+)',ln)
+    if m:
+        if cur: comp[cyc]=cur
+        cyc=int(m.group(1)); cur=[]
+    g=pat.match(ln.rstrip('\n'))
+    if g and g.group(8) is not None:
+        cur.append((g.group(1)+'.'+g.group(2)+'('+re.sub(r'\s+',' ',g.group(3).strip())+')', round(float(g.group(8)),2)))
+if cur: comp[cyc]=cur
+for c in [2,10,26,50,70,94]:
+    print('cycle',c,'->',comp.get(c))
+agg={}; cnt={}
+for c in sorted(comp):
+    for k,v in comp[c]:
+        agg[k]=max(agg.get(k,0),v); cnt[k]=cnt.get(k,0)+1
+print('TOP coords by max |comp|:');
+for k,v in sorted(agg.items(),key=lambda x:-x[1])[:8]: print('  ',k, v, 'seen',cnt[k],'cycles')

+from rdkit import Chem
+import networkx as nx
+def graph(smi):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); G=nx.Graph()
+    for a in m.GetAtoms(): G.add_node(a.GetIdx(), el=a.GetSymbol())
+    for b in m.GetBonds(): G.add_edge(b.GetBeginAtomIdx(), b.GetEndAtomIdx(), order=int(b.GetBondTypeAsDouble()))
+    return G, m
+B3="N#C[C@H]1[C@@H]2C=C[C@H]1CC2"
+EN="N#C[C@H]1C[C@H]2C=C[C@@H]1C2"
+def node_match(a,b): return a["el"]==b["el"]
+def edge_match(a,b): return a["order"]==b["order"]
+g1,_=graph(B3); g2,_=graph(EN)
+iso=nx.is_isomorphic(g1,g2,node_match=node_match,edge_match=edge_match)
+print("B3 vs our-QM-endo same constitution (graph isomorphic, ignoring stereo)?", iso)
+print("B3  flat:", Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.MolFromSmiles(Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.MolFromSmiles(B3),isomericSmiles=False))))
+print("ours flat:", Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.MolFromSmiles(Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.MolFromSmiles(EN),isomericSmiles=False))))
+# also: which bridge bears CN — count ring sizes around CN carbon via simple analysis
+for tag,smi in [("B3",B3),("ours",EN)]:
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); ri=m.GetRingInfo()
+    nC=[a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="C" and any(n.GetSymbol()=="N" and m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(a.GetIdx(),n.GetIdx()).GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.TRIPLE for n in a.GetNeighbors())][0]
+    ringC=[n.GetIdx() for n in m.GetAtomWithIdx(nC).GetNeighbors() if any(n.GetIdx() in r for r in ri.AtomRings())]
+    print(tag,"CN-C ring-neighbours:",ringC)
", "message": ""}

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np

+
+def build(smi, seed=0xf00d):
+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)

+    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, ps)
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=2000)
+    return mh
+
+def plane_signs(mh, ref_idx, probe_pairs):
+    conf = mh.GetConformer()
+    P = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ref_idx])
+    c = P.mean(axis=0); U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(P-c); n = Vt[-1]
+    out={}
+    for name, idxs in probe_pairs.items():
+        q = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in idxs]).mean(axis=0)
+        out[name] = float(np.dot(q-c, n))

+import sys
+from rdkit import Chem
+import networkx as nx
+def analyze(tag,smi):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); ri=m.GetRingInfo()
+    rings=[set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()]
+    # atoms in >1 ring (bicyclic core)
+    core={}
+    for r in rings:
+        for a in r: core[a]=core.get(a,0)+1
+    coreatoms={a for a,c in core.items() if c>=2}
+    G=nx.Graph()
+    for b in m.GetBonds():
+        i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx()
+        if i in coreatoms and j in coreatoms: G.add_edge(i,j)
+    bh=[a for a in coreatoms if G.degree(a)==3]
+    # CN carbon of nitrile
+    nC=None
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        if a.GetSymbol()=="C":
+            for n in a.GetNeighbors():

+    b1,b2=bh
+    paths=list(nx.all_simple_paths(G,b1,b2))

+    for p in paths:

+def embed(smi, seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m)

+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+
+def setcoords(m, X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i, X[i].tolist())
+
+def mapidx(m):
+    return {a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+
+def bestfit_plane_normal(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c, Vt[-1]
+

+    # dienophile local x-axis = C6->C7 ; we want C6 at -w, C7 at +w : scale to bond length then set

+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

+CP="[CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH:4]=[CH:5]1"; ACN="[CH2:6]=[CH:7][C:8]#[N:9]"
+ENDO_PROD="[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]"  # CN anti C3 = ENDO
+EXO_PROD ="[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]"   # CN syn  C3 = EXO
+
+def embed(smi,seed=7):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); mh=Chem.AddHs(m); ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps); AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000); return mh
+def XYZ(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer(); return np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
+def setXYZ(m,X):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i,X[i].tolist())
+def plane(P):
+    cen=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-cen); return cen,Vt[-1]
+
+cp=embed(CP); acn=embed(ACN)
+ci={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in cp.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+ai={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in acn.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+Xcp=XYZ(cp); Xacn=XYZ(acn)
+ring=np.array([Xcp[ci[k]] for k in(1,2,3,4,5)]); cen,n=plane(ring)
+x=Xcp[ci[4]]-Xcp[ci[2]]; x=x-np.dot(x,n)*n; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
+z=n; y=np.cross(z,x); R=np.vstack([x,y,z]); Xcp2=(Xcp-0.5*(Xcp[ci[2]]+Xcp[ci[4]]))@R.T
+if Xcp2[ci[2],0]>Xcp2[ci[4],0]: Xcp2[:,0]*=-1
+core=np.array([Xacn[ai[6]],Xacn[ai[7]],Xacn[ai[8]]]); cen2,n2=plane(core)
+x2=Xacn[ai[7]]-Xacn[ai[6]]; x2=x2-np.dot(x2,n2)*n2; x2/=np.linalg.norm(x2)
+z2=n2; y2=np.cross(z2,x2); Xa=(Xacn-0.5*(Xacn[ai[6]]+Xacn[ai[7]]))@np.vstack([x2,y2,z2]).T
+
+def complex_geom(h,w,face,fix_heavy=True,target=None):
+    Xa2=Xa.copy(); d=np.linalg.norm(Xa2[ai[7]]-Xa2[ai[6]]); Xa2[:,0]*=(2*w)/d
+    if np.sign(Xa2[ai[8],1])!=face: Xa2[:,1]*=-1.0
+    Xa2[:,2]+=h
+    comb=Chem.CombineMols(cp,acn); setXYZ(comb,np.vstack([Xcp2,Xa2])); Chem.SanitizeMol(comb)

+    if target:
+        for i,j in [(2,6),(4,7)]: ff.AddDistanceConstraint(mp[i],mp[j],target,target,400.0)
+    if fix_heavy:
+        for a in mm.GetAtoms():
+            if a.GetAtomicNum()>1: ff.AddFixedPoint(a.GetIdx())
+    ff.Minimize(maxIts=5000)

+
+def report(mm):

+    P=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[k])) for k in(1,2,4,5,6,7)]); cen,n=plane(P)
+    sd=lambda k: float(np.dot(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[k]))-cen,n))
+    d26=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[2]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[6])))
+    d47=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[4]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[7])))
+    d67=np.linalg.norm(np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[6]))-np.array(c.GetAtomPosition(mp[7])))
+    v="ENDO(CN anti C3)" if np.sign(sd(3))!=np.sign(sd(9)) else "EXO(CN syn C3)"
+    return dict(d26=round(d26,3),d47=round(d47,3),d67=round(d67,3),sC3=round(sd(3),3),sC8=round(sd(8),3),sN9=round(sd(9),3),family=v)
+

+    heavy=[]; hyd=[]

+        else:
+            nb=[x.GetIdx() for x in a.GetNeighbors() if x.GetAtomicNum()>1]
+            pm=idx2map.get(nb[0],999) if nb else 999
+            hyd.append((pm,a.GetIdx()))
+    heavy.sort(key=lambda i: idx2map[i]); hyd.sort()
+    return heavy+[i for _,i in hyd], mp

+
+geom={}
+rc,E=complex_geom(3.15,0.67,+1,fix_heavy=True,target=3.30)

+

+print("TS_endo:",report(ts_e)); print("TS_exo:",report(ts_x))
+
+for tag,smi in [("endo",ENDO_PROD),("exo",EXO_PROD)]:
+    m=embed(smi,11); write_xyz(m,OUT+"/product_%s.xyz"%tag,"HDA_CN DA product %s  C8H9N q0 m1"%tag)

+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps); AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=5000); return mh
+def plane(P):
+    cen=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-cen); return cen,Vt[-1]
+def order_maps(mm):
+    mp={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in mm.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
+    i2m={v:k for k,v in mp.items()}; heavy=[];hyd=[]
+    for a in mm.GetAtoms():
+        if a.GetAtomicNum()>1: heavy.append(a.GetIdx())
+        else:
+            nb=[x.GetIdx() for x in a.GetNeighbors() if x.GetAtomicNum()>1]
+            hyd.append((i2m.get(nb[0],999) if nb else 999,a.GetIdx()))
+    heavy.sort(key=lambda i:i2m[i]); hyd.sort()
+    return heavy+[i for _,i in hyd], i2m
+def table(mm):
+    order,i2m=order_maps(mm); rows=[]; n=0

+        a=mm.GetAtomWithIdx(i); n+=1

+                     "parent_map":(i2m.get([x.GetIdx() for x in a.GetNeighbors() if x.GetAtomicNum()>1][0],0) if a.GetAtomicNum()==1 else 0)})
+    return rows,order,i2m

+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
+
+def load(p):
+    m=Chem.MolFromXYZFile(p)
+    rdDetermineBonds.DetermineBonds(m, charge=0)
+    return m
+
+def plane(P):
+    c=P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c); return c,Vt[-1]
+
+def verdict(m):
+    c=m.GetConformer()
+    xyz=lambda i: np.array(list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)))
+    mp={i:i for i in range(9)}  # file order: heavy 0..8 = map 1..9
+    # 6-ring plane maps {1,2,4,5,6,7} -> idx {0,1,3,4,5,6}
+    P=np.array([xyz(i) for i in (0,1,3,4,5,6)]); cen,n=plane(P)
+    sd=lambda i: float(np.dot(xyz(i)-cen,n))
+    s3,s9=sd(2),sd(8)   # C3=idx2, N9=idx8
+    return ("ENDO(CN anti C3)" if np.sign(s3)!=np.sign(s9) else "EXO(CN syn C3)"), round(s3,3), round(s9,3)
+
+def cip(m):
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
+    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
+    res={}
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        code=a.GetPropsAsDict().get('_CIPCode')
+        if code: res[a.GetIdx()]=code
+    # map idx->map number (heavy order)
+    return { (i+1):res[i] for i in sorted(res)}
+
+files=[
+ ("MY product_endo.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/orca_inputs/product_endo.xyz"),
+ ("MY product_exo.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/orca_inputs/product_exo.xyz"),
+ ("OLD product_endo_seed.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/product_endo_seed.xyz"),
+ ("OLD product_exo_seed.xyz","hard_replacements_20261001/HDA_CN/product_exo_seed.xyz"),
+]
+for label,p in files:
+    m=load(p)
+    v,s3,s9=verdict(m)
+    print("%-28s CIP(by map)=%s  geo=%s (sC3=%+.3f sN9=%+.3f)"%(label,cip(m),v,s3,s9))

+- Goal: locate the **endo** and **exo** concerted DA transition states in the gas phase at one
+  method, and report both barriers (difference from the calculation, **not** pre-set).
+- Source (literature background only, DOI 10.1021/jo400900x, J. Org. Chem. 2013, 78, 6582;
+  PMC3731169): in CP+ACN the concerted DA is preferred over the stepwise diradical by ≈5.9 kcal/mol;
+  endo and exo TS are **essentially isoenergetic**, exo marginally lower (B3LYP/6-31G(d)).
+  We do **not** fit to these numbers and we add **no** new range (no diradical / polymerization
+  pathway in this candidate).

+  8 CPU / 14000 MB / maxcore 1536; software-native defaults — **no MaxIter, no Cloudra timeout**.

+Heavy atoms are listed **by map ascending** in every file (then H's, grouped by their heavy parent).

+| map | atom | role |
+|----|------|------|
+| 1,2,4,5 | C | cyclopentadiene ring |
+| 3 | C | **one-carbon (methano) bridge**, CH2 |
+| 6,7 | C | dienophile C=C (from ACN) |
+| 8 | C | nitrile C |
+| 9 | N | nitrile N |
+
+Bond changes: **C2–C6 and C4–C7 form**; C1=C2 and C4=C5 become single; **C1–C5 becomes the new C=C**;
+C6=C7 becomes single. (C1,C5 = diene central carbons; C2,C4 = diene termini.)

+**Verification of the endo/exo labels.** The pre-existing draft defined "same side of the
+C2/C4/C6/C7 plane as bridge C3 = endo". I tested this against five *stereo-defined* PubChem
+anchors that are exact structural analogs (substituent on the dienophile-derived bridge):
+
+| anchor (PubChem) | label | measured (substituent vs methano bridge C3) |
+|---|---|---|
+| Carbic anhydride, *cis*-5-norbornene-**endo**-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (CID 2723766) | **endo** | **opposite** side to C3 |
+| *exo*-5-norbornene-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride (name lookup) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+| Carbic acid, *endo*-norbornene-*cis*-5,6-dicarboxylic acid (CID 6541030) | **endo** | **opposite** side to C3 |
+| *exo*-5-norbornene-2-carboxylic acid (CID 12268635) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+| *exo*-norbornene-2-carboxylic acid, enantiomer (CID 721733) | **exo** | **same** side as C3 |
+
+Five stereo-defined PubChem references agree, and the result is robust across two independent
+reference planes (6-membered ring {1,2,4,5,6,7} and bridgehead+dienophile {2,4,6,7}).
+The parallel `verification/` effort in this directory (scripts + SDFs) independently reproduced
+the same rule.
+
+> **Convention (verified): exo = the dienophile substituent is on the SAME side as the one-carbon
+> (methano) bridge C3; endo = OPPOSITE side of C3 (same side as the new alkene C1=C5).**

+Applied to the two DA diastereomers:

+| diastereomer | mapped SMILES | CIP (C2,C4,C7) | CN vs C3 |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| **endo** | `[CH:1]1=[CH:5][C@@H:4]2[CH2:3][C@H:2]1[CH2:6][C@@H:7]2[C:8]#[N:9]` | **(2S,4S,7S)** | anti |

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import numpy as np
+from rdkit import Chem
+from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
+
+def build(smi, seed=0xf00d):
+    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    assert m is not None, smi
+    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
+    ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=seed
+    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, ps)
+    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=2000)
+    return mh
+
+def plane_signs(mh, ref_idx, probe_pairs):
+    conf = mh.GetConformer()
+    P = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ref_idx])
+    c = P.mean(axis=0); U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(P-c); n = Vt[-1]
+    out={}
+    for name, idxs in probe_pairs.items():
+        q = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in idxs]).mean(axis=0)
+        out[name] = float(np.dot(q-c, n))
+    return out
+
+# ---- anchor: CID 2723766 = ENDO (Carbic anhydride) ----
+anchor = "C1[C@@H]2C=C[C@H]1[C@@H]3[C@H]2C(=O)OC3=O"

+    a.SetAtomMapNum(a.GetIdx()+1)   # so map = idx+1
+conf=m.GetConformer()
+# indices 0-based: 0=methano CH2, 1,4=bridgeheads, 2,3=alkene, 5,6=dienophile C, 7,10 carbonyl C, 9 ring O
+ref=[1,2,3,4,5,6]
+probes={"methano(0)":[0], "anhydride_O(9)":[9], "carbonylC_mid(7,10)":[7,10]}

+from rdkit import Chem

+def analyze(tag,smi):
+    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); ri=m.GetRingInfo()
+    rings=[set(r) for r in ri.AtomRings()]
+    # atoms in >1 ring (bicyclic core)
+    core={}
+    for r in rings:
+        for a in r: core[a]=core.get(a,0)+1
+    coreatoms={a for a,c in core.items() if c>=2}
+    G=nx.Graph()
+    for b in m.GetBonds():
+        i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx()
+        if i in coreatoms and j in coreatoms: G.add_edge(i,j)
+    bh=[a for a in coreatoms if G.degree(a)==3]
+    # CN carbon of nitrile
+    nC=None
+    for a in m.GetAtoms():
+        if a.GetSymbol()=="C":
+            for n in a.GetNeighbors():
+                if n.GetSymbol()=="N" and m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(a.GetIdx(),n.GetIdx()).GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.TRIPLE:
+                    nC=a.GetIdx()
+    # bridges: simple paths between the two bridgeheads
+    import itertools
+    b1,b2=bh
+    paths=list(nx.all_simple_paths(G,b1,b2))
+    print(tag, "| ring-#atoms for CN-bearing atom:", core.get(nC,0), "| bridgeheads", bh)
+    for p in paths:
+        inner=p[1:-1]
+        bears = nC in inner
+        print("    bridge atoms",p,"len(inner)=",len(inner), ("<== bears CN" if bears else ""))
